4.38.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
ṣaṣṭhīvidhānamadhunā kathayasva janārdana ..
sarvavyādhipraśamanaṃ sarvakarmaphalapradam .. .. 1 ..
4.38.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
षष्ठीविधानमधुना कथयस्व जनार्दन ॥
सर्वव्याधिप्रशमनं सर्वकर्मफलप्रदम् ॥ ॥ 1 ॥
4.38.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Now describe the procedure for the Ṣaṣṭhī [observance], O Janārdana, / which alleviates all diseases and grants the fruit of all deeds.

4.38.s:
śrutaṃ mayā pūjyamāno bhānuḥ sarvaṃ prayacchati ..
divākarārādhanaṃ me tasmātkathaya keśava .. 2 ..
4.38.d:
श्रुतं मया पूज्यमानो भानुः सर्वं प्रयच्छति ॥
दिवाकराराधनं मे तस्मात्कथय केशव ॥ 2 ॥
4.38.m: I have heard that the sun, when worshipped, bestows everything; / therefore describe to me the adoration of Divākara, O Keśava.

4.38.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
viśoka ṣaṣṭhīmatulāṃ vakṣyāmi manujottama. ..
yāmupoṣya naraḥ śokaṃ na kadācidiha jāyate.. 3 ..
4.38.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
विशोक षष्ठीमतुलां वक्ष्यामि मनुजोत्तम॥।
यामुपोष्य नरः शोकं न कदाचिदिह जायते॥ 3 ॥
4.38.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / I shall describe the incomparable Viśokaṣaṣṭhī, O best of men, / fasting on which, a man never experiences grief in this world.

4.38.s:
māghe kṛṣṇatilaiḥ snātaḥ pañcamyāṃ śuklapakṣataḥ..
kṛtāhāraḥ kṛśasyā daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam..
upavāsavrataṃ kṛtvā brahmacārī bhavenniśi..
tataḥ prabhāte cotthāya kṛtasnānastataḥ śuciḥ..5..
4.38.d:
माघे कृष्णतिलैः स्नातः पञ्चम्यां शुक्लपक्षतः॥
कृताहारः कृशस्या दंतधावनपूर्वकम्॥
उपवासव्रतं कृत्वा ब्रह्मचारी भवेन्निशि॥
ततः प्रभाते चोत्थाय कृतस्नानस्ततः शुचिः॥5॥
4.38.m: In the month of Māgha, having bathed with black sesame on the fifth of the bright fortnight, / having eaten lean food after cleaning the teeth, / having undertaken the fast-observance, he should be celibate at night; / then, having risen in the morning and bathed, and thus become pure,

4.38.s:
kṛtvā tu kāñcanaṃ padmamarko'yamiti pūjayet ..
karavīreṇa raktena raktavastrayugena ca .. 6 ..
4.38.d:
कृत्वा तु काञ्चनं पद्ममर्कोऽयमिति पूजयेत् ॥
करवीरेण रक्तेन रक्तवस्त्रयुगेन च ॥ 6 ॥
4.38.m: having made a golden lotus, he should worship it [saying], “This is Arka,” / with red oleander and a pair of red garments:

4.38.s:
yathā viśokaṃ bhavanaṃ tvayaivādityasarvadā ..
tathā viśokatāṃ me syāttvadbhaktirjanmajanmani .. 7 ..
4.38.d:
यथा विशोकं भवनं त्वयैवादित्यसर्वदा ॥
तथा विशोकतां मे स्यात्त्वद्भक्तिर्जन्मजन्मनि ॥ 7 ॥
4.38.m: “Just as your abode, O Āditya, is always sorrowless (viśoka), / so may there be freedom from sorrow for me, and devotion to you in birth after birth.”

4.38.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjya ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu śaktyā saṃpūjayeddvijān ..
suptvā saṃprāśya gomūtramutthāya kṛtaniścayaḥ .. 8 ..
4.38.d:
एवं संपूज्य षष्ठ्यां तु शक्त्या संपूजयेद्द्विजान् ॥
सुप्त्वा संप्राश्य गोमूत्रमुत्थाय कृतनिश्चयः ॥ 8 ॥
4.38.m: Having thus worshipped on the sixth [tithi], he should worship brāhmaṇas according to his means; / having slept, having sipped cow urine, and having risen resolute,

4.38.s:
saṃpūjya vipramaṃtreṇa guḍapātrasamanvitaḥ ..
susūkṣmavastrayugalaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet .. 9 ..
4.38.d:
संपूज्य विप्रमंत्रेण गुडपात्रसमन्वितः ॥
सुसूक्ष्मवस्त्रयुगलं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥ 9 ॥
4.38.m: having worshipped the brāhmaṇa with a mantra, accompanied by a vessel of jaggery, / he should offer a pair of very fine garments to the brāhmaṇa.

4.38.s:
atailalavaṇaṃ bhuktvā saptamyāṃ maunasaṃyutaḥ ..
tataḥ purāṇaśravaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā .. 4.38.10 ..
4.38.d:
अतैललवणं भुक्त्वा सप्तम्यां मौनसंयुतः ॥
ततः पुराणश्रवणं कर्तव्यं भूतिमिच्छता ॥ 4.38.10 ॥
4.38.m: Having eaten food without oil or salt on the seventh [tithi] while maintaining silence, / the hearing of the Purāṇa should then be performed by one desiring prosperity.

4.38.s:
anena vidhinā sarvamubhayorapi pakṣayoḥ ..
kuryādyāvatpunarmāghaśuklapakṣasya saptamī .. 11 ..
4.38.d:
अनेन विधिना सर्वमुभयोरपि पक्षयोः ॥
कुर्याद्यावत्पुनर्माघशुक्लपक्षस्य सप्तमी ॥ 11 ॥
4.38.m: According to this procedure, he should perform everything on both fortnights, / until the seventh [tithi] of the bright fortnight of Māgha comes again.

4.38.s:
vratāṃte kalaśaṃ dadyātsuvarṇakamalānvitam ..
śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ tadvatkapilāṃ ca payasvinīm .. 12 ..
4.38.d:
व्रतांते कलशं दद्यात्सुवर्णकमलान्वितम् ॥
शय्यां सोपस्करां तद्वत्कपिलां च पयस्विनीम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.38.m: At the conclusion of the votive observance, he should give a water-pot accompanied by a golden lotus, / likewise a bed with furnishings, and a brown cow yielding milk.

4.38.s:
anena vidhinā yastu vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ..
viśokaṣaṣṭhīṃ kurute sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 13 ..
4.38.d:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु वित्तशाठ्यविवर्जितः ॥
विशोकषष्ठीं कुरुते स याति परमां गतिम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.38.m: He who, free from stinginess with wealth, performs the Viśokaṣaṣṭhī / according to this procedure, attains the supreme state.

4.38.s:
yāvajjanmasahasrāṇāṃ sāgrakoṭiśataṃ bhavet ..
tāvanna śokamabhyeti rogadaurgatyavarjitaḥ .. 14 ..
4.38.d:
यावज्जन्मसहस्राणां साग्रकोटिशतं भवेत् ॥
तावन्न शोकमभ्येति रोगदौर्गत्यवर्जितः ॥ 14 ॥
4.38.m: As long as a hundred crore of thousands of births may be, / for that long he does not encounter sorrow, freed from disease and misfortune.

4.38.s:
yaṃyaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ taṃtaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam ..
niṣkāmaṃ kurute yastu sa paraṃ brahma gacchati. .. 15. ..
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi ṣaṣṭhīṃ śokavināśinīm..
sopīṃdralokamāpnoti na duḥkhī jāyate kvacit .. 16 ..
4.38.d:
यंयं प्रार्थयते कामं तंतं प्राप्नोति पुष्कलम् ॥
निष्कामं कुरुते यस्तु स परं ब्रह्म गच्छति॥। 15॥।
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि षष्ठीं शोकविनाशिनीम्॥
सोपींद्रलोकमाप्नोति न दुःखी जायते क्वचित् ॥ 16 ॥
4.38.m:
Whatever desire one prays for, that very desire one obtains abundantly; / but whoever performs it free from desire goes to the supreme Brahman.
Whoever reads or listens to this grief-destroying ṣaṣṭhī, / he too attains the realm of Indra and is never anywhere made miserable.

4.38.s:
ye bhāskaraṃ dinakaraṃ karavīrapuṣpaiḥ saṃpūjayaṃtyabhinamaṃti kṛtopavāsā ..
te duḥkhaśokarahitāḥ sahitāḥ suhṛdbhirbhūmau vihṛtya ravilokamavāpnuvaṃti .. 17 ..
kamalaṣaṣṭhīvratavarṇanam
4.38.d:
ये भास्करं दिनकरं करवीरपुष्पैः संपूजयंत्यभिनमंति कृतोपवासा ॥
ते दुःखशोकरहिताः सहिताः सुहृद्भिर्भूमौ विहृत्य रविलोकमवाप्नुवंति ॥ 17 ॥
कमलषष्ठीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.38.m:
Those who, having fasted, worship the Illuminator, the Day-Maker, with oleander flowers and bow down to him, / freed from misery and sorrow, enjoying themselves on earth with their friends, attain the realm of the Sun.
Description of the Kamalaṣaṣṭhī Votive Observance

4.39.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
anyāmapi pravakṣyāmi padmaṣaṣṭhī śubhāṃ tathā..
yāmupoṣya naraḥ pāpavimuktaḥ svargabhāgbhavet .. 1 ..
4.39.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अन्यामपि प्रवक्ष्यामि पद्मषष्ठी शुभां तथा॥
यामुपोष्य नरः पापविमुक्तः स्वर्गभाग्भवेत् ॥ 1 ॥
4.39.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
I shall also declare another auspicious Padmaṣaṣṭhī, / by fasting on which a man is freed from sin and shares in heaven.

4.39.s:
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi pañcamyāṃ niyatavrataḥ ..
ṣaṣṭhīmupoṣya kamalaṃ kārayitvā sukāñcanam .. 2 ..
4.39.d:
मार्गशीर्षे शुभे मासि पञ्चम्यां नियतव्रतः ॥
षष्ठीमुपोष्य कमलं कारयित्वा सुकाञ्चनम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.39.m: In the auspicious month of Mārgaśīrṣa, restrained in vows on the fifth lunar day, / having fasted on the sixth lunar day and having had a lotus made of fine gold,

4.39.s:
śarkarāsaṃyutaṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine ..
rūpaṃ ca kāṃcanaṃ kṛtvā phalasyaikasya dharmavit .. 3 ..
4.39.d:
शर्करासंयुतं दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाय कुटुंबिने ॥
रूपं च कांचनं कृत्वा फलस्यैकस्य धर्मवित् ॥ 3 ॥
4.39.m: together with sugar, one should give it to a householder brāhmaṇa; / and having made a golden replica of a single fruit, knowing duty,

4.39.s:
dadyātprātaḥ kṛtasnāno bhānurme prīyatāmiti ..
bhaktyā tu viprānsaṃpūjya saptamyāṃ kṣīrabhojanam .. 4 ..
4.39.d:
दद्यात्प्रातः कृतस्नानो भानुर्मे प्रीयतामिति ॥
भक्त्या तु विप्रान्संपूज्य सप्तम्यां क्षीरभोजनम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.39.m: having bathed in the morning, one should give it, saying: 'May the Sun be pleased with me.' / Then, having faithfully worshipped the priests, eating a meal of milk on the seventh lunar day,

4.39.s:
kṛtvā kuryātphalatyāgaṃ yā ca syātkṛṣṇasaptamī ..
etāmupoṣya vidhivadanenaiva krameṇa tu.. 5 ..
4.39.d:
कृत्वा कुर्यात्फलत्यागं या च स्यात्कृष्णसप्तमी ॥
एतामुपोष्य विधिवदनेनैव क्रमेण तु॥ 5 ॥
4.39.m: having done so, one should renounce fruit; and on whichever dark seventh lunar day it is, / having fasted on this according to rule and in this very sequence,

4.39.s:
tadvai haimaṃ phalaṃ dattvā suvarṇa kamalānvitam..
śarkarāpātrasaṃyuktaṃ vastramālāsamanvitam .. 6 ..
4.39.d:
तद्वै हैमं फलं दत्त्वा सुवर्ण कमलान्वितम्॥
शर्करापात्रसंयुक्तं वस्त्रमालासमन्वितम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.39.m: having indeed given that golden fruit along with a gold lotus, / accompanied by a vessel of sugar and endowed with cloth and garlands,

4.39.s:
ṣaṣṭhyorubhayormahārāja yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ tataḥ ..
upoṣya dadyātkramaśaḥ sūryamaṃtrānudīrayet .. 7 ..
4.39.d:
षष्ठ्योरुभयोर्महाराज यावत्संवत्सरं ततः ॥
उपोष्य दद्यात्क्रमशः सूर्यमंत्रानुदीरयेत् ॥ 7 ॥
4.39.m: on both sixth lunar days, O great king, then for the duration of a year, / having fasted, one should successively give [these gifts] and recite the Sun mantras:

4.39.s:
bhānurarko ravirbrahmā sūryaḥ śukro hariḥ śivaḥ ..
śrīmānvibhāvasustvaṣṭā varuṇaḥ prīyatāmiti .. 8 ..
4.39.d:
भानुरर्को रविर्ब्रह्मा सूर्यः शुक्रो हरिः शिवः ॥
श्रीमान्विभावसुस्त्वष्टा वरुणः प्रीयतामिति ॥ 8 ॥
4.39.m: 'May Bhānu, Arka, Ravi, Brahmā, Sūrya, Śukra, Hari, Śiva, / the glorious Vibhāvasu, Tvaṣṭṛ, and Varuṇa be pleased.'

4.39.s:
pratimāsaṃ ca saptamyāmekaikaṃ nāma kīrtayet ..
pratipakṣaṃ phalatyāgametatkurvansamācaret .. 9 ..
4.39.d:
प्रतिमासं च सप्तम्यामेकैकं नाम कीर्तयेत् ॥
प्रतिपक्षं फलत्यागमेतत्कुर्वन्समाचरेत् ॥ 9 ॥
4.39.m: And every month on the seventh lunar day, one should recite one name at a time; / performing this, one should observe the renunciation of fruit in every fortnight.
At the conclusion of the votive observance, one should worship a brāhmaṇa couple with clothes and ornaments; / one should give a pot of sugar together with a golden lotus and fruit, [saying:]

4.39.s:
yathā phalakaro māsastvadbhaktānāṃ sadā rave ..
tathānaṃtaphalāvāptirastu janmanijanmani ..11..
4.39.d:
यथा फलकरो मासस्त्वद्भक्तानां सदा रवे ॥
तथानंतफलावाप्तिरस्तु जन्मनिजन्मनि ॥11॥
4.39.m: 'Just as the month is always fruit-bearing for your devotees, O Sun, / likewise may there be attainment of endless fruit in birth after birth.'

4.39.s:
imāmanaṃtaphaladāṃ phalaṣaṣṭhīṃ karoti yaḥ ..
sa sarvapāpanirmuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate ..12..
4.39.d:
इमामनंतफलदां फलषष्ठीं करोति यः ॥
स सर्वपापनिर्मुक्तः सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥12॥
4.39.m: Whoever observes this Phalaṣaṣṭhī, which grants endless fruit, / he is freed from all sins and is magnified in the realm of the Sun.

4.39.s:
surāpānādikaṃ kiñcidyadatrāmutra vā kṛtam ..
tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati ..13..
4.39.d:
सुरापानादिकं किञ्चिद्यदत्रामुत्र वा कृतम् ॥
तत्सर्वं नाशमायाति सूर्यलोकं स गच्छति ॥13॥
4.39.m: Whatever liquor-drinking and the like he has done here or elsewhere, / all that is destroyed, and he goes to the realm of the Sun.

4.39.s:
bhūtānbhavyāṃśca puruṣāṃstārayedekaviṃśatim ..
śṛṇuyādyaḥ paṭhedvāpi sopi kalyāṇabhāgbhavet..14..
4.39.d:
भूतान्भव्यांश्च पुरुषांस्तारयेदेकविंशतिम् ॥
शृणुयाद्यः पठेद्वापि सोपि कल्याणभाग्भवेत्॥14॥
4.39.m: He delivers twenty-one past and future generations; / whoever listens to or reads this also shares in auspiciousness.

4.39.s:
haimaṃ phalaṃ sakamalaṃ kalaśaṃ sitāyā ṣaṣṭhīmupoṣya vidhivaddvijapuṃgavāya ..
dadyātsurāsuraśiromaṇighṛṣṭapādaṃ bhānuṃ praṇamya phalasiddhimupaiti martyaḥ ..15..
maṃdāraṣaṣṭhīvratavarṇanam
4.39.d:
हैमं फलं सकमलं कलशं सिताया षष्ठीमुपोष्य विधिवद्द्विजपुंगवाय ॥
दद्यात्सुरासुरशिरोमणिघृष्टपादं भानुं प्रणम्य फलसिद्धिमुपैति मर्त्यः ॥15॥
मंदारषष्ठीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.39.m:
Having fasted on the bright sixth lunar day and according to rule given to an eminent twice-born a golden fruit along with a lotus and a water jar of white [sugar], / after bowing down to the Sun, whose feet are rubbed by the crest-jewels of gods and demons, a mortal attains success in his fruits.
Description of the Mandāraṣaṣṭhī Votive Observance

4.40.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm ..
sarvakāmapradāṃ puṇyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ mandārasaṃjñitām .. 1 ..
4.40.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीम् ॥
सर्वकामप्रदां पुण्यां षष्ठीं मन्दारसंज्ञिताम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.40.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Now hereafter I shall fully proclaim the sacred sixth lunar day named Mandāra, / which destroys all sins and grants all desires.

4.40.s:
māghasyāmalapakṣe tu pañcamyāṃ laghubhuṅnaraḥ ..
daṃtakāṣṭhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā ṣaṣṭhīmupavasedbudhaḥ ..
viprānsaṃpūjya vidhivanmaṃdāraṃ prāśayenniśi..2..
4.40.d:
माघस्यामलपक्षे तु पञ्चम्यां लघुभुङ्नरः ॥
दंतकाष्ठं ततः कृत्वा षष्ठीमुपवसेद्बुधः ॥
विप्रान्संपूज्य विधिवन्मंदारं प्राशयेन्निशि॥2॥
4.40.m: In the bright fortnight of Māgha, on the fifth lunar day, a man eating lightly, / then having used a tooth-stick, the wise man should fast on the sixth lunar day; / having worshipped the priests according to rule, he should consume a mandāra [flower] at night.

4.40.s:
tataḥ prabhāte cotthāya kṛtasnānaḥ punardvijān..
bhojayecchaktitaḥ kṛtvā maṃdārakusumāṣṭakam..3..
4.40.d:
ततः प्रभाते चोत्थाय कृतस्नानः पुनर्द्विजान्॥
भोजयेच्छक्तितः कृत्वा मंदारकुसुमाष्टकम्॥3॥
4.40.m: Then, rising in the morning and having bathed, he should again feed the twice-born / according to his capacity, having made eight mandāra flowers

4.40.s:
sauvarṇaṃ puruṣaṃ tadvatpadmahastaṃ suśobhanam ..
padmaṃ kṛṣṇatilaiḥ kṛtvā tāmrapātre'ṣṭapatrakam .. 4 ..
4.40.d:
सौवर्णं पुरुषं तद्वत्पद्महस्तं सुशोभनम् ॥
पद्मं कृष्णतिलैः कृत्वा ताम्रपात्रेऽष्टपत्रकम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.40.m: and likewise a golden man with a lotus in his hand, exceedingly beautiful; / having fashioned an eight-petalled lotus with black sesame seeds in a copper vessel,

4.40.s:
pūjya maṃdārakusumairbhāskarāyeti pūrvataḥ ..
namaskāreṇa tadvacca sūryāyetyanale dale .. ..5..
4.40.d:
पूज्य मंदारकुसुमैर्भास्करायेति पूर्वतः ॥
नमस्कारेण तद्वच्च सूर्यायेत्यनले दले ॥ ॥5॥
4.40.m: having worshipped with mandāra flowers saying 'To Bhāskara' on the east, / and likewise with an obeisance saying 'To Sūrya' on the fire petal,

4.40.s:
dakṣiṇe tadvadarkāya tathāryamṇe ca nairṛte..
paścime vasudhātre ca vāyavye caṇḍabhānave ..6..
4.40.d:
दक्षिणे तद्वदर्काय तथार्यम्णे च नैरृते॥
पश्चिमे वसुधात्रे च वायव्ये चण्डभानवे ॥6॥
4.40.m: similarly 'To Arka' on the south, and 'To Aryaman' in the southwest, / and 'To Vasudhātṛ' on the west, and 'To Caṇḍabhānu' in the northwest,

4.40.s:
pūṣṇe hyuttarataḥ pūjya ānaṃdāyetyataḥ param..
karṇikāyāṃ tu puruṣaḥ pūjyaḥ sarvātmaneti ca .. 7 ..
4.40.d:
पूष्णे ह्युत्तरतः पूज्य आनंदायेत्यतः परम्॥
कर्णिकायां तु पुरुषः पूज्यः सर्वात्मनेति च ॥ 7 ॥
4.40.m: having worshipped 'To Pūṣan' on the north, and after that 'To Ānanda'; / then on the pericarp the Man is to be worshipped saying 'To the Self of All',

4.40.s:
śuklavastraiḥ samāveṣṭya bhakṣyairmālyaphalādibhiḥ ..
evamabhyarcya tatsarvaṃ dadyādvedavide punaḥ ..
bhuṃjītātailalavaṇaṃ vāgyataḥ prāṅmukho gṛhī .. 8 ..
4.40.d:
शुक्लवस्त्रैः समावेष्ट्य भक्ष्यैर्माल्यफलादिभिः ॥
एवमभ्यर्च्य तत्सर्वं दद्याद्वेदविदे पुनः ॥
भुंजीतातैललवणं वाग्यतः प्राङ्मुखो गृही ॥ 8 ॥
4.40.m: having wrapped [him] in white garments, with eatables, garlands, fruits, and the like; / having thus worshipped, he should give all that again to a knower of the Veda; / the householder, restraining his speech and facing east, should eat without oil or salt.

4.40.s:
anena vidhinā sarvaṃ saptamyāṃ māsimāsi ca ..
kuryātsaṃvatsaraṃ yāvadvittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ .. 9 ..
4.40.d:
अनेन विधिना सर्वं सप्तम्यां मासिमासि च ॥
कुर्यात्संवत्सरं यावद्वित्तशाठ्यविवर्जितः ॥ 9 ॥
4.40.m: According to this rule, month by month on the seventh lunar day, / he should perform everything for the duration of a year, free from financial deceit.

4.40.s:
etadeva vratāṃte tu nidhāya kalaśopari ..
gobhirvibhavataḥ sārddhaṃ dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā .. 4.40.10 ..
4.40.d:
एतदेव व्रतांते तु निधाय कलशोपरि ॥
गोभिर्विभवतः सार्द्धं दातव्यं भूतिमिच्छता ॥ 4.40.10 ॥
4.40.m: At the conclusion of the votive observance, placing this very [offering] upon a pot, / it should be given along with cows according to one's wealth by one desiring prosperity:

4.40.s:
namo maṃdāranāthāya maṃdārabhavanāya ca ..
tvaṃ ca vai tārayasvāsmānasmātsaṃsārakardamāt .. 11 ..
4.40.d:
नमो मंदारनाथाय मंदारभवनाय च ॥
त्वं च वै तारयस्वास्मानस्मात्संसारकर्दमात् ॥ 11 ॥
4.40.m: 'Obeisance to the Lord of Mandāra and to the Abode of Mandāra! / And do you deliver us from this mire of worldly existence!'

4.40.s:
anena vidhinā yastu kuryānmaṃdārakaṃ vratam ..
vipāpmā sa sukhī martyaḥ kalpaṃ ca divi modate .. 12 ..
4.40.d:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु कुर्यान्मंदारकं व्रतम् ॥
विपाप्मा स सुखी मर्त्यः कल्पं च दिवि मोदते ॥ 12 ॥
4.40.m: Whoever performs the Mandāraka votive observance according to this rule, / that mortal, sinless and happy, rejoices in heaven for an eon.
Taking up this lamp with its good wick [piercing] the darkness that is the mass of sins, / a man, as he walks, does not stumble in the night of worldly existence.

4.40.s:
maṃdāraṣaṣṭhīṃ vikhyātāmīpsitārthaphalapradām ..
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi sopi pāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 14 ..
4.40.d:
मंदारषष्ठीं विख्यातामीप्सितार्थफलप्रदाम् ॥
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि सोपि पापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥ 14 ॥
4.40.m: Whoever reads or listens to this renowned Mandāraṣaṣṭhī, / which grants the fruit of desired aims, he too is freed from sins.

4.40.s:
ṣaṣṭhīmupoṣya tilapaṅkajakarṇikāyāṃ saṃpūjya bhāskaramaho suravṛkṣapuṣpaiḥ ..
yatprāpnuvaṃti puruṣā na hi tatkadācidgobhūhiraṇyatiladāḥ padamāpnuvanti .. 15 ..
lalitāṣaṣṭhīvratavarṇanam
4.40.d:
षष्ठीमुपोष्य तिलपङ्कजकर्णिकायां संपूज्य भास्करमहो सुरवृक्षपुष्पैः ॥
यत्प्राप्नुवंति पुरुषा न हि तत्कदाचिद्गोभूहिरण्यतिलदाः पदमाप्नुवन्ति ॥ 15 ॥
ललिताषष्ठीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.40.m:
Having fasted on the sixth lunar day, having worshipped the Sun on the pericarp of a sesame lotus with celestial tree flowers, / the state which men attain—those who give cattle, land, gold, and sesame never reach that state!
Description of the Lalitāṣaṣṭhī Votive Observance

4.41.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
bhadra bhādrapade māsi śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ..
yoṣitsuveṣā subhagā sarvalokamanoharā .. 1 ..
4.41.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
भद्र भाद्रपदे मासि शुक्लषष्ठ्यां युधिष्ठिर ॥
योषित्सुवेषा सुभगा सर्वलोकमनोहरा ॥ 1 ॥
4.41.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
O gentle one, in the month of Bhādrapada, on the bright sixth lunar day, Yudhiṣṭhira, / a woman well dressed, fortunate, charming to all the world,

4.41.s:
prātaḥ snānaṃ mahānadyāṃ kṛtvā saṃgṛhya vālukām ..
nave vaṃśamaye pātre yāyādgṛhamataṃdritā .. 2 ..
4.41.d:
प्रातः स्नानं महानद्यां कृत्वा संगृह्य वालुकाम् ॥
नवे वंशमये पात्रे यायाद्गृहमतंद्रिता ॥ 2 ॥
4.41.m: having bathed in the morning in a great river and gathered sand / in a fresh bamboo vessel, should go home without indolence.

4.41.s:
sopavāsā prayatnena devīṃ tatra prapūjayet ..
kṛtvā vastragṛhaṃ ramyaṃ dīpanetrapaṭāvṛtam .. 3 ..
4.41.d:
सोपवासा प्रयत्नेन देवीं तत्र प्रपूजयेत् ॥
कृत्वा वस्त्रगृहं रम्यं दीपनेत्रपटावृतम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.41.m: Fasting, she should diligently worship the goddess there, / having made a lovely cloth pavilion covered with a screen adorned with lamp-patterns;

4.41.s:
tatra saṃsthāpya tāṃ devīṃ puṣpaiḥ saṃpūjayennavaiḥ ..
dhyātvā lalitikāṃ gaurīṃ tapovananivāsinīm .. 4 ..
4.41.d:
तत्र संस्थाप्य तां देवीं पुष्पैः संपूजयेन्नवैः ॥
ध्यात्वा ललितिकां गौरीं तपोवननिवासिनीम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.41.m: having installed that goddess there, she should worship her with fresh flowers, / meditating on Lalitikā Gaurī who dwells in the penance grove.

4.41.s:
maṃtreṇānena kusumaiścaṃpakasya suśobhanaiḥ ..
caṃpakaṃ karavīraṃ ca nemāliṃ mālatīṃ tathā ..
nīlotpalaṃ ketakīṃ ca saṃgṛhya tagaraṃ tathā .. 5 ..
4.41.d:
मंत्रेणानेन कुसुमैश्चंपकस्य सुशोभनैः ॥
चंपकं करवीरं च नेमालिं मालतीं तथा ॥
नीलोत्पलं केतकीं च संगृह्य तगरं तथा ॥ 5 ॥
4.41.m: With this mantra, and with very lovely campaka flowers— / having gathered campaka, karavīra, nemāli, mālatī, / blue lotus, ketakī, and tagara—

4.41.s:
ekaikasya tvaṣṭaśatamaṣṭāviṃśatireva vā ..
akṣataiḥ kalikā grāhyāstaistu devīṃ samarcayet .. 6 ..
4.41.d:
एकैकस्य त्वष्टशतमष्टाविंशतिरेव वा ॥
अक्षतैः कलिका ग्राह्यास्तैस्तु देवीं समर्चयेत् ॥ 6 ॥
4.41.m: one hundred and eight, or twenty-eight, / buds along with unbroken grains are to be taken of each; with these she should worship the goddess:

4.41.s:
gaṃgādvāre kuśāvarte bilvake nīlaparvate ..
snātvā kanakhale tīrthe haraṃ labdhavatī vrajet .. 7 ..
4.41.d:
गंगाद्वारे कुशावर्ते बिल्वके नीलपर्वते ॥
स्नात्वा कनखले तीर्थे हरं लब्धवती व्रजेत् ॥ 7 ॥
4.41.m: “Having bathed at Gaṅgādvāra, Kuśāvarta, Bilvaka, Nīlaparvata, / and at the Kanakhala tīrtha, she who attained Hara should go [home]!”

4.41.s:
lalite lalite devi saukhyasaubhāgyadāyini ..
yā saubhāgyasamutpannā tasyai devyai namonamaḥ ..
evamabhyarcya vidhinā naivedyaṃ purato nyaset .. 8 ..
4.41.d:
ललिते ललिते देवि सौख्यसौभाग्यदायिनि ॥
या सौभाग्यसमुत्पन्ना तस्यै देव्यै नमोनमः ॥
एवमभ्यर्च्य विधिना नैवेद्यं पुरतो न्यसेत् ॥ 8 ॥
4.41.m: “O Lalitā, O Lalitā, O goddess, granter of happiness and good fortune! / Homage, homage to that goddess who arose for good fortune!” / Having worshipped her thus according to rule, she should place food offerings before her:
along with ash gourds, karkaṭī clusters, karkoṭas, and bitter gourds; / with things marked with ghee, unbroken grains, [ornaments for] the limbs, lamps, incense, red lac, and the like;
along with jaggery incense, sohālaka cakes, karambaka sweets, / jaggery-sweets, karṇaveṣṭa cakes, modakas, and face-modakas.

4.41.s:
evamabhyarcya vidhivadrātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tataḥ ..
gītavādyanaṭacchatraprekṣaṇīyaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ ..
sakhībhiḥ sahitā sādhvī tāṃ rātrīṃ praśamannayet .. 11 ..
4.41.d:
एवमभ्यर्च्य विधिवद्रात्रौ जागरणं ततः ॥
गीतवाद्यनटच्छत्रप्रेक्षणीयैः सुशोभनैः ॥
सखीभिः सहिता साध्वी तां रात्रीं प्रशमन्नयेत् ॥ 11 ॥
4.41.m: Having worshipped thus according to rule, then keeping vigil at night / with songs, musical instruments, actors, royal parasols, and very lovely spectacles, / the virtuous woman, accompanied by her female friends, should pass that night peacefully.

4.41.s:
na ca sammīlayennetre nārī yāmacatuṣṭayam ..
durbhagā durgatā vaṃdhyā netrasaṃmīlanādbha vet .. 12 ..
4.41.d:
न च सम्मीलयेन्नेत्रे नारी यामचतुष्टयम् ॥
दुर्भगा दुर्गता वंध्या नेत्रसंमीलनाद्भ वेत् ॥ 12 ॥
4.41.m: And the woman must not close her eyes for four watches [of the night]. / From closing her eyes she would become unfortunate, destitute, and barren.

4.41.s:
evaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā saptamyāṃ saritaṃ nayet ..
gandhapuṣpairathābhyarcya gītavādyapuraḥsaram .. 13 ..
4.41.d:
एवं जागरणं कृत्वा सप्तम्यां सरितं नयेत् ॥
गन्धपुष्पैरथाभ्यर्च्य गीतवाद्यपुरःसरम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.41.m: Having thus kept vigil, on the seventh [lunar day] she should take [the image] to a river. / Then, having worshipped it with perfume and flowers, preceded by singing and instrumental music,

4.41.s:
tacca dadyāddvijeṃdrāya naivadyādi narottama ..
snātvā gṛhamupāgamya hutvā vaiśvānaraṃ kramāt ..
devānpitṝnmanuṣyāṃśca pūjayitvā suvāsinīm .. 14 ..
4.41.d:
तच्च दद्याद्द्विजेंद्राय नैवद्यादि नरोत्तम ॥
स्नात्वा गृहमुपागम्य हुत्वा वैश्वानरं क्रमात् ॥
देवान्पितॄन्मनुष्यांश्च पूजयित्वा सुवासिनीम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.41.m: she should give that food offering and the rest to an eminent brahmin, O best of men. / Having bathed, returned home, and offered oblations to Vaiśvānara in due order, / having worshipped the gods, ancestors, men, and a married woman,

4.41.s:
kumārikā bhojanīyā brāhmaṇā daśapaṃca ca ..
bhakṣyabhojyairbahuvidhairdeyā tebhyaḥ sudakṣiṇā ..
lalitā prītiyuktā'stu ityuktvā tānvisarjayet .. 15 ..
4.41.d:
कुमारिका भोजनीया ब्राह्मणा दशपंच च ॥
भक्ष्यभोज्यैर्बहुविधैर्देया तेभ्यः सुदक्षिणा ॥
ललिता प्रीतियुक्ताऽस्तु इत्युक्त्वा तान्विसर्जयेत् ॥ 15 ॥
4.41.m: a maiden is to be fed, and fifteen brahmins. / A generous priestly fee is to be given to them along with various kinds of foods and delicacies. / Saying, “May Lalitā be pleased,” she should dismiss them.

4.41.s:
yaḥ kaścidācaredetadbhaktyā lalitikāvratam ..
naro vā yadi vā nārī tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 16 ..
4.41.d:
यः कश्चिदाचरेदेतद्भक्त्या ललितिकाव्रतम् ॥
नरो वा यदि वा नारी तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु ॥ 16 ॥
4.41.m: Whoever performs this Lalitikā observance with devotion, / whether a man or a woman, hear the meritorious fruit of it:

4.41.s:
tannāsti mānuṣe loke tasya yannopapadyate ..
sukhasaubhāgyasaṃyuktā gaurīlokamavāpnuyāt .. 17 ..
4.41.d:
तन्नास्ति मानुषे लोके तस्य यन्नोपपद्यते ॥
सुखसौभाग्यसंयुक्ता गौरीलोकमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 17 ॥
4.41.m: there is nothing in the world of men that does not accrue to them; / endowed with happiness and good fortune, she will attain the world of Gaurī.

4.41.s:
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ jalāṃtaragatā varavaṃśapātre saṃgṛhya pūjayati yā sikatāḥ krameṇa ..
naktaṃ ca jāgaramanuddhatagītanṛtyaiḥ kṛtvā hyasau tribhuvane laliteva bhāti ..18..
kārtikeyapūjāvarṇanam
4.41.d:
षष्ठ्यां जलांतरगता वरवंशपात्रे संगृह्य पूजयति या सिकताः क्रमेण ॥
नक्तं च जागरमनुद्धतगीतनृत्यैः कृत्वा ह्यसौ त्रिभुवने ललितेव भाति ॥18॥
कार्तिकेयपूजावर्णनम्
4.41.m:
She who, having entered into the water on the sixth [lunar day], takes sand in an excellent bamboo vessel and worships it in due order, / and who keeps vigil at night with quiet singing and dancing, truly shines in the three worlds like Lalitā.
Description of the worship of Kārttikeya.

4.42.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
yeyaṃ mārgaśire māsi ṣaṣṭhī bharatasattama ..
puṇyā pāpaharā dhanyā śivā śāntā gṛhapriyā .. 1 ..
4.42.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
येयं मार्गशिरे मासि षष्ठी भरतसत्तम ॥
पुण्या पापहरा धन्या शिवा शान्ता गृहप्रिया ॥ 1 ॥
4.42.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / That sixth [lunar day] which occurs in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, O best of the Bharatas, / is holy, sin-destroying, auspicious, benevolent, peaceful, and dear to households.

4.42.s:
nihatya tārakaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ guhastārakarājavat ..
rarāja tena dayitā kārttikeśasya sā tithiḥ ..
snānadānādikaṃ karma tasyāmakṣayamucyate ..2..
4.42.d:
निहत्य तारकं षष्ठ्यां गुहस्तारकराजवत् ॥
रराज तेन दयिता कार्त्तिकेशस्य सा तिथिः ॥
स्नानदानादिकं कर्म तस्यामक्षयमुच्यते ॥2॥
4.42.m: Having slain Tāraka on the sixth [lunar day], Guha shone like the king of the stars (the moon). / Therefore that lunar day is dear to the lord Kārttika; / rites such as bathing and gift-giving performed on it are said to bear imperishable [fruit].

4.42.s:
yasyāṃ paśyaṃti gāṃgeyaṃ dakṣiṇāpathamāśritam ..
brahmahatyādipāpaiste mucyaṃte nātra saṃśaya. .. 3 ..
4.42.d:
यस्यां पश्यंति गांगेयं दक्षिणापथमाश्रितम् ॥
ब्रह्महत्यादिपापैस्ते मुच्यंते नात्र संशय॥। 3 ॥
4.42.m: Those who behold Gāṅgeya residing in Dakṣiṇāpatha on that [day] / are freed from sins such as killing a brahmin; of this there is no doubt.

4.42.s:
tasmādasyāṃ sopavāsaḥ kumāraṃ svarṇasaṃbhavam..
rājataṃ vā mahārāja mṛnmayaṃ vāpi kārayet .. 4 ..
4.42.d:
तस्मादस्यां सोपवासः कुमारं स्वर्णसंभवम्॥
राजतं वा महाराज मृन्मयं वापि कारयेत् ॥ 4 ॥
4.42.m: Therefore, fasting on this [day], one should have Kumāra made / of gold or silver, O great king, or even of clay.

4.42.s:
aparāhṇe tataḥ snātvā samācamya yatavratī ..
padmāsanastho gāṅgeyaṃ dhyāyaṃstiṣṭhetsamādhinā .. 5 ..
4.42.d:
अपराह्णे ततः स्नात्वा समाचम्य यतव्रती ॥
पद्मासनस्थो गाङ्गेयं ध्यायंस्तिष्ठेत्समाधिना ॥ 5 ॥
4.42.m: Then, having bathed in the afternoon and performed sipping of water, the observer of the vow, / seated in the lotus posture, should remain in absorption, meditating upon Gāṅgeya.

4.42.s:
brāhmaṇastu tato vidvāngṛhītvā karakaṃ navam ..
pātayettasya śirasi dhārāṃ vai dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ .. 6 ..
4.42.d:
ब्राह्मणस्तु ततो विद्वान्गृहीत्वा करकं नवम् ॥
पातयेत्तस्य शिरसि धारां वै दक्षिणामुखः ॥ 6 ॥
4.42.m: Then a learned brahmin, taking a new water vessel, / facing south, should pour a continuous stream upon his head:

4.42.s:
candramaṇḍalabhūtānāṃ bhavabhūtipavitritā ..
gaṃgākumāradhāreyaṃ patitā tava mastake..7..
4.42.d:
चन्द्रमण्डलभूतानां भवभूतिपवित्रिता ॥
गंगाकुमारधारेयं पतिता तव मस्तके॥7॥
4.42.m: “This stream of Gaṅgā-Kumāra, which belongs to the orb of the moon / and is purified by the glory of Bhava (Śiva), has fallen upon your head!”

4.42.s:
evaṃ snātvā samabhyarcya bhāskaraṃ bhuvanādhipa ..
puṣpadhūpādinā paścātpūjayetkṛttikāsutam .. 8 ..
4.42.d:
एवं स्नात्वा समभ्यर्च्य भास्करं भुवनाधिप ॥
पुष्पधूपादिना पश्चात्पूजयेत्कृत्तिकासुतम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.42.m: Having bathed thus and worshipped the sun, O lord of the world, / one should afterwards worship the son of Kṛttikā with flowers, incense, and the like:

4.42.s:
deva senāpate skanda kārttikeya bhavodbhava ..
kumāra guha gāṃgeya śaktihasta namo'stu te .. 9 ..
4.42.d:
देव सेनापते स्कन्द कार्त्तिकेय भवोद्भव ॥
कुमार गुह गांगेय शक्तिहस्त नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 9 ॥
4.42.m: “O god, general of the army, Skanda, Kārttikeya, born of Bhava, / Kumāra, Guha, Gāṅgeya, who hold a spear in hand, homage be to you!”

4.42.s:
ebhirnnāmapadaiḥ pūjya naivedyaṃ vinivedayet ..
phalāni dakṣiṇānnāni candanaṃ malayodbhavam.. ..4.42.1 0..
4.42.d:
एभिर्न्नामपदैः पूज्य नैवेद्यं विनिवेदयेत् ॥
फलानि दक्षिणान्नानि चन्दनं मलयोद्भवम्॥ ॥4.42.1 0॥
4.42.m: Having worshipped him with these names, he should present food offerings: / fruits, southern cooked foods, and sandalwood grown on the Malaya mountains.

4.42.s:
pārśvasthau pūjayecchāgakukkuṭau svāmivallabhau..
sakalāpaṃ mayūraṃ ca pratyakṣāṃ himajāṃ tathā ..11..
4.42.d:
पार्श्वस्थौ पूजयेच्छागकुक्कुटौ स्वामिवल्लभौ॥
सकलापं मयूरं च प्रत्यक्षां हिमजां तथा ॥11॥
4.42.m: He should worship the goat and the rooster standing at his sides, dear to the Master, / and the peacock with its plumage, as well as Himajā (the Daughter of the Himalaya) visibly present.

4.42.s:
kṛttikākaṭakaṃ pārśve saṃpūjya skandavallabham..
tenaiva nāmabhirhomaḥ kāryaḥ sājyaistilaistathā .. 12 ..
4.42.d:
कृत्तिकाकटकं पार्श्वे संपूज्य स्कन्दवल्लभम्॥
तेनैव नामभिर्होमः कार्यः साज्यैस्तिलैस्तथा ॥ 12 ॥
4.42.m: Having worshipped beside him the band of the Kṛttikās, dear to Skanda, / a fire oblation should be made with ghee and sesame seeds using those very names.

4.42.s:
evaṃ nirvartya vidhivatphalamevaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ..
bhakṣayitvā svapedbhūmau svāstṛte darbhasaṃstare .. .. 13 ..
4.42.d:
एवं निर्वर्त्य विधिवत्फलमेवं युधिष्ठिर ॥
भक्षयित्वा स्वपेद्भूमौ स्वास्तृते दर्भसंस्तरे ॥ ॥ 13 ॥
4.42.m: Having thus completed the rites according to rule, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / and having eaten only fruit, he should sleep on the ground upon an arranged layer of darbha grass.

4.42.s:
nālikeraṃ mātuluṃgaṃ nāriṃgaṃ panasaṃ tathā ..
jaṃbīraṃ dāḍimaṃ drākṣāṃ hṛdyānyāmraphalāni ca .. 14 ..
4.42.d:
नालिकेरं मातुलुंगं नारिंगं पनसं तथा ॥
जंबीरं दाडिमं द्राक्षां हृद्यान्याम्रफलानि च ॥ 14 ॥
4.42.m: Coconut, citron, orange, jackfruit, / lime, pomegranate, grape, and delightful mango fruits,

4.42.s:
śrīphalāmalakaṃ tadvattrapusaṃ kadalīphalam ..
krameṇa bhakṣayedrājansaṃyato niyatavratī ..
alābhe kalakālaughaphalamadyādataṃdritaḥ .. 15 ..
4.42.d:
श्रीफलामलकं तद्वत्त्रपुसं कदलीफलम् ॥
क्रमेण भक्षयेद्राजन्संयतो नियतव्रती ॥
अलाभे कलकालौघफलमद्यादतंद्रितः ॥ 15 ॥
4.42.m: as well as the bilva fruit, myrobalan, cucumber, and plantain fruit— / the king, self-controlled and keeping his vow, should eat them in order. / If unavailable, he should eat without indolence whatever fruit belongs to that season.

4.42.s:
pratyakṣo hemaghaṭitaśchāgo vā kukkuṭo'thavā..
prātardadyāddvijāyaitatsenānīḥ prīyatāmiti .. 16 ..
4.42.d:
प्रत्यक्षो हेमघटितश्छागो वा कुक्कुटोऽथवा॥
प्रातर्दद्याद्द्विजायैतत्सेनानीः प्रीयतामिति ॥ 16 ॥
4.42.m: In the morning, he should give to a brahmin an actual [animal] or one fashioned of gold, / either a goat or a rooster, saying, “May the general of the army be pleased!”

4.42.s:
senāyāṃ sa ca saṃbhūtaḥ krauñcāriḥ ṣaṇmukho guhaḥ ..
gāṃgeyaḥ kārttikeyaśca svāmī bālagrahāgraṇīḥ .. 17 ..
4.42.d:
सेनायां स च संभूतः क्रौञ्चारिः षण्मुखो गुहः ॥
गांगेयः कार्त्तिकेयश्च स्वामी बालग्रहाग्रणीः ॥ 17 ॥
4.42.m: “Born in the army,” “Enemy of Krauñca,” “Six-faced,” “Guha,” / “Gāṅgeya,” “Kārttikeya,” “Master,” “Leader of spirits seizing children,”

4.42.s:
chāgapriyaśśaktidharo dvāro dvādaśamaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
prīyatāmiti sarveṣu kramānmāseṣu kīrtayet .. 18 ..
4.42.d:
छागप्रियश्शक्तिधरो द्वारो द्वादशमः स्मृतः ॥
प्रीयतामिति सर्वेषु क्रमान्मासेषु कीर्तयेत् ॥ 18 ॥
4.42.m: “Fond of goats,” “Spear-bearer,” “Dvāra”—he is remembered as the twelfth. / In all the months in sequence, he should proclaim: “May [he] be pleased!”

4.42.s:
brāhmaṇānbhojayitvādau paścādbhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ..
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyānte kārttike māsi śobhane ..19..
4.42.d:
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयित्वादौ पश्चाद्भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः ॥
एवं संवत्सरस्यान्ते कार्त्तिके मासि शोभने ॥19॥
4.42.m: Having first fed the brahmins, he should afterwards eat in silence. / Thus at the end of the year, in the auspicious month of Kārttika,

4.42.s:
kārttikeyaṃ samabhyarcya vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaiḥ saha ..
gāṃgeyaḥ kārtikeyaśca sakṛdevaivamācaret ..4.42.20..
4.42.d:
कार्त्तिकेयं समभ्यर्च्य वासोभिर्भूषणैः सह ॥
गांगेयः कार्तिकेयश्च सकृदेवैवमाचरेत् ॥4.42.20॥
4.42.m: having worshipped Kārttikeya along with garments and ornaments, / he should perform this once as Gāṅgeya and Kārttikeya.

4.42.s:
saṃvatsaravidhiṃ kṛtvā japaṃ homapuraskṛtam ..
dadyādviprāya rājendra vācakāya viśeṣataḥ ..21..
4.42.d:
संवत्सरविधिं कृत्वा जपं होमपुरस्कृतम् ॥
दद्याद्विप्राय राजेन्द्र वाचकाय विशेषतः ॥21॥
4.42.m: Having performed the ritual of the year, preceded by recitation and fire offerings, / he should make a gift to a brahmin, O king of kings, especially to a reciter of scriptures.

4.42.s:
ete viprāḥ smṛtā divyā bhaumāstvanye dvijātayaḥ ..
pālite'sminvrate pārtha tīrṇaḥ syādbhavasāgarāt ..22..
4.42.d:
एते विप्राः स्मृता दिव्या भौमास्त्वन्ये द्विजातयः ॥
पालितेऽस्मिन्व्रते पार्थ तीर्णः स्याद्भवसागरात् ॥22॥
4.42.m: These brahmins are considered divine, while other twice-born are earthly. / When this observance is maintained, O Pārtha, one crosses over the ocean of worldly existence.

4.42.s:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā naro yoṣidathāpi vā..
sa prāpyeha śubhaṃ kāmaṃ gacchatīndrasalokatām.. ..23..
4.42.d:
एवं यः कुरुते भक्त्या नरो योषिदथापि वा॥
स प्राप्येह शुभं कामं गच्छतीन्द्रसलोकताम्॥ ॥23॥
4.42.m: Whoever, whether a man or a woman, performs this with devotion, / having attained their auspicious desire here, goes to the realm of Indra.

4.42.s:
sadaiva pūjanīyastu kārtikeyo mahīpate..
kārttikeyādṛte nānyo rājñāṃ pūjyaḥ pravakṣyate ..24..
4.42.d:
सदैव पूजनीयस्तु कार्तिकेयो महीपते॥
कार्त्तिकेयादृते नान्यो राज्ञां पूज्यः प्रवक्ष्यते ॥24॥
4.42.m: Kārttikeya is always to be worshipped, O lord of the earth; / for kings, none other than Kārttikeya is declared worthy of worship.

4.42.s:
saṃgrāmaṃ gacchamāno yaḥ pūjayetkṛttikāsutam..
sa sarvaṃ jayate vīro yathendro dānavānraṇe ..25..
4.42.d:
संग्रामं गच्छमानो यः पूजयेत्कृत्तिकासुतम्॥
स सर्वं जयते वीरो यथेन्द्रो दानवान्रणे ॥25॥
4.42.m: The heroic man who, marching into battle, worships the son of Kṛttikā, / conquers everything, just as Indra conquered the Dānavas in battle.

4.42.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjayecchaṃkarātmajam..
pūjyamānastu sadbhaktyā sarvānkāmānprayacchati ..26..
4.42.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन पूजयेच्छंकरात्मजम्॥
पूज्यमानस्तु सद्भक्त्या सर्वान्कामान्प्रयच्छति ॥26॥
4.42.m:
Therefore, with every effort one should worship the son of Śaṅkara.
Worshipped with true devotion, he grants all desires.

4.42.s:
yastu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ naro naktaṃ kuryādbhāratasattama ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto gāṃgeyasya sadā vrajet ..27..
4.42.d:
यस्तु षष्ठ्यां नरो नक्तं कुर्याद्भारतसत्तम ॥
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो गांगेयस्य सदा व्रजेत् ॥27॥
4.42.m:
A man who observes the nocturnal meal on the ṣaṣṭhī, O best of the Bhāratas,
freed from all sins, ever goes to the son of Gaṅgā.

4.42.s:
śrutvaivaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ māsaṃ gatvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ.
pūjayed devadeveśaṃ sa gatvā śivamaṃdiram .. 28 ..
4.42.d:
श्रुत्वैवं दक्षिणां मासं गत्वा श्रद्धासमन्वितः।
पूजयेद् देवदेवेशं स गत्वा शिवमंदिरम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.42.m:
Having heard this, going south for a month endowed with faith,
he should go to a temple of Śiva and worship the lord of the gods of gods,

4.42.s:
skandaṃ guhaṃ śaravaṇodbhavamādidevaṃ śambhoḥ sutaṃ sadayitaṃ girirājaputryāḥ ..
svarge nirargalasukhānyanubhūyate na senāpatirbhavati rājyadhuraṃdhuro'sau .. 29 .. ..
vijayasaptamīvratavarṇanam
4.42.d:
स्कन्दं गुहं शरवणोद्भवमादिदेवं शम्भोः सुतं सदयितं गिरिराजपुत्र्याः ॥
स्वर्गे निरर्गलसुखान्यनुभूयते न सेनापतिर्भवति राज्यधुरंधुरोऽसौ ॥ 29 ॥ ॥
विजयसप्तमीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.42.m:
Skanda, Guha, born in the reed-thicket, the primeval god, the son of Śambhu, the beloved of the mountain king's daughter.
Having enjoyed unhindered pleasures in heaven, he becomes a commander of armies, bearing the yoke of kingship.
Description of the Vijayasaptamī Vrata

4.43.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
saptamī ca yadā deva kena kālena pūjyate ..
kiṃphalā niyamaḥ kaścidvada devakinandana .. 1 ..
4.43.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
सप्तमी च यदा देव केन कालेन पूज्यते ॥
किंफला नियमः कश्चिद्वद देवकिनन्दन ॥ 1 ॥
4.43.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
And when, O God, is the saptamī worshipped, and at what time?
What is its fruit, and what is its rule? Tell me, O son of Devakī.

4.43.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śuklapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ yadādityadinaṃ bhavet ..
saptamī vijayā nāma tatra dattaṃ mahā phalam .. 2 ..
4.43.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शुक्लपक्षे तु सप्तम्यां यदादित्यदिनं भवेत् ॥
सप्तमी विजया नाम तत्र दत्तं महा फलम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.43.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
When in the bright fortnight a saptamī falls on the day of the sun,
that saptamī is named Vijayā; what is given thereon bears great fruit.

4.43.s:
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homa upavāsastathaiva ca ..
sarvaṃ vijayasaptamyāṃ mahāpātakanāśanam .. 3 ..
4.43.d:
स्नानं दानं जपो होम उपवासस्तथैव च ॥
सर्वं विजयसप्तम्यां महापातकनाशनम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.43.m:
Bathing, giving gifts, recitation, fire offering, and likewise fasting—
everything done on Vijayasaptamī destroys great sins.

4.43.s:
pradakṣiṇāṃ yaḥ kurute phalaiḥ puṣpai rdivākaram ..
sa sarvaguṇasaṃpannaṃ putraṃ prānotyanuttamam .. 4 ..
4.43.d:
प्रदक्षिणां यः कुरुते फलैः पुष्पै र्दिवाकरम् ॥
स सर्वगुणसंपन्नं पुत्रं प्रानोत्यनुत्तमम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.43.m:
He who circumambulates the Sun with fruits and flowers
obtains an unsurpassed son endowed with all good qualities.

4.43.s:
prathamā nālikeraistu dvitīyā raktanāgaraiḥ ..
tṛtīyā mātuluṃgaiśca caturthī kadalīphalaiḥ .. .. 5 ..
4.43.d:
प्रथमा नालिकेरैस्तु द्वितीया रक्तनागरैः ॥
तृतीया मातुलुंगैश्च चतुर्थी कदलीफलैः ॥ ॥ 5 ॥
4.43.m:
The first with coconuts, the second with red dry gingers,
the third with citrons, and the fourth with plantains,

4.43.s:
pañcamī varakūṣmāṇḍaiḥ ṣaṣṭhī pakvaistu teṃdukaiḥ ..
vṛntākaiḥ saptamī deyā aṣṭottaraśatena ca .. 6 ..
4.43.d:
पञ्चमी वरकूष्माण्डैः षष्ठी पक्वैस्तु तेंदुकैः ॥
वृन्ताकैः सप्तमी देया अष्टोत्तरशतेन च ॥ 6 ॥
4.43.m:
the fifth with excellent winter-melons, the sixth with ripe tendu fruits,
and the seventh should be given with eggplants, [each] one hundred and eight in number,

4.43.s:
mauktikaiḥ padmarāgaiśca nīlaiḥ karketanaistathā ..
gomedairvajravaiḍūryaiḥ śatenāṣṭādhikena tu .. 7 ..
4.43.d:
मौक्तिकैः पद्मरागैश्च नीलैः कर्केतनैस्तथा ॥
गोमेदैर्वज्रवैडूर्यैः शतेनाष्टाधिकेन तु ॥ 7 ॥
4.43.m:
or with pearls, rubies, sapphires, chrysoberyls,
hessonites, diamonds, and cat's-eyes, one hundred and eight in number,

4.43.s:
akṣoṭairbadarairbilvaiḥ karamardaiḥ sabarbaraiḥ ..
āmrāmrātakajaṃbīrairjaṃbukarkoṭikāphalaiḥ ..8..
4.43.d:
अक्षोटैर्बदरैर्बिल्वैः करमर्दैः सबर्बरैः ॥
आम्राम्रातकजंबीरैर्जंबुकर्कोटिकाफलैः ॥8॥
4.43.m:
or with walnuts, jujubes, bilvas, karamarda fruits together with barbara fruits,
mangoes, hog-plums, limes, rose-apples, and karkoṭikā fruits,

4.43.s:
puṣpairdhūpaiḥ phalaiḥ patrairmodakairguṇakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
ebhirvijayasaptamyāṃ bhānoḥ kuryātpradakṣiṇām .. 9 ..
4.43.d:
पुष्पैर्धूपैः फलैः पत्रैर्मोदकैर्गुणकैः शुभैः ॥
एभिर्विजयसप्तम्यां भानोः कुर्यात्प्रदक्षिणाम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.43.m:
with flowers, incenses, fruits, leaves, modakas, and auspicious sweetmeats.
With these one should perform the circumambulation of the Sun on Vijayasaptamī,

4.43.s:
anyaiḥ phalaiśca kāmyaiśca aikṣavairgraṃthivarjitaiḥ ..
raveḥ pradakṣiṇā deyā phalena phalamādiśet .. 4.43.10 ..
4.43.d:
अन्यैः फलैश्च काम्यैश्च ऐक्षवैर्ग्रंथिवर्जितैः ॥
रवेः प्रदक्षिणा देया फलेन फलमादिशेत् ॥ 4.43.10 ॥
4.43.m:
and with other desirable fruits, and with pieces of sugarcane free of knots.
A circumambulation of the Sun should be given; according to the fruit one may indicate the fruit [obtained].

4.43.s:
na viśenna ca saṃjalpenna ca kaścidvadedapi ..
ekacittatayā bhānuścintanāya prayacchati .. 11..
4.43.d:
न विशेन्न च संजल्पेन्न च कश्चिद्वदेदपि ॥
एकचित्ततया भानुश्चिन्तनाय प्रयच्छति ॥ 11॥
4.43.m:
One must not enter, nor converse, nor should anyone speak.
To the single-minded [worshipper] the Sun yields himself for contemplation.

4.43.s:
vasordhārāpradātavyā bhānorgavyena sarpiṣā ..
candrātapatraṃ badhnīyājjayaṃ kiṃkiṇikāyutam ..12..
4.43.d:
वसोर्धाराप्रदातव्या भानोर्गव्येन सर्पिषा ॥
चन्द्रातपत्रं बध्नीयाज्जयं किंकिणिकायुतम् ॥12॥
4.43.m:
A continuous stream of wealth should be offered to the Sun with clarified butter from a cow.
One should fasten a white canopy adorned with tiny bells, [bringing] victory.

4.43.s:
kuṃkumena samālabhya puṣpadhūpaiśca pūjayet ..
śubhaṃ nivedya naivedyaṃ tataḥ paścātkṣamāpayet ..13..
4.43.d:
कुंकुमेन समालभ्य पुष्पधूपैश्च पूजयेत् ॥
शुभं निवेद्य नैवेद्यं ततः पश्चात्क्षमापयेत् ॥13॥
4.43.m:
Anointing him with saffron, one should worship with flowers and incenses;
having presented an auspicious food-offering, one should afterwards ask for forgiveness:

4.43.s:
bhāno bhrāskaramārtaṇḍa caṇḍaraśme divākara ..
ārogyamāyurvijayaṃ putraṃ dehi namo'stu te .. 14 ..
4.43.d:
भानो भ्रास्करमार्तण्ड चण्डरश्मे दिवाकर ॥
आरोग्यमायुर्विजयं पुत्रं देहि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 14 ॥
4.43.m:
“O Splendour, O Illuminator, O Mārtaṇḍa, O Fierce-rayed One, O Daymaker!
Grant health, longevity, victory, and a son! Homage be to you!”

4.43.s:
upavāsena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca ..
kṛtā niyamayuktena yā tviyaṃ jayasaptamī .. 15 ..
4.43.d:
उपवासेन नक्तेन तथैवायाचितेन च ॥
कृता नियमयुक्तेन या त्वियं जयसप्तमी ॥ 15 ॥
4.43.m:
By fasting, by a nocturnal meal, or likewise by taking only unasked-for food,
when this Jayasaptamī is observed by one keeping the rules,

4.43.s:
rogī vimucyate rogāddaridraḥ śriyamāpnuyāt ..
aputro labhate putraṃ vidyā vidyārthino bhavet .. 16 ..
4.43.d:
रोगी विमुच्यते रोगाद्दरिद्रः श्रियमाप्नुयात् ॥
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रं विद्या विद्यार्थिनो भवेत् ॥ 16 ॥
4.43.m:
the diseased is freed from illness, the poor obtains fortune,
the childless obtains a son, and learning comes to the seeker of learning.

4.43.s:
śuklapakṣe yadā pārtha sādityasaptamī bhavet ..
tadā naktena mudgāśī kṣapayetsapta saptamī .. 17 ..
4.43.d:
शुक्लपक्षे यदा पार्थ सादित्यसप्तमी भवेत् ॥
तदा नक्तेन मुद्गाशी क्षपयेत्सप्त सप्तमी ॥ 17 ॥
4.43.m:
When, O son of Pṛthā, in the bright fortnight a saptamī falls on a Sunday,
then, eating mung beans at night, one should spend seven saptamīs.

4.43.s:
bhūmau palāśapatreṣu snātvā hutvā yathāvidhi ..
samāpte tu vrate dadyātsauvarṇaṃ mudgamiśritam .. 18 ..
4.43.d:
भूमौ पलाशपत्रेषु स्नात्वा हुत्वा यथाविधि ॥
समाप्ते तु व्रते दद्यात्सौवर्णं मुद्गमिश्रितम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.43.m:
On the ground, upon palāśa leaves, having bathed and offered oblations according to rule,
when the votive observance is completed, he should give gold mixed with mung beans,

4.43.s:
mudgaṃ śreṣṭhāya viprāya vācakāya viśeṣataḥ..
saptamyāṃ saptisaṃyukta ādityena narottama .. 19 ..
4.43.d:
मुद्गं श्रेष्ठाय विप्राय वाचकाय विशेषतः॥
सप्तम्यां सप्तिसंयुक्त आदित्येन नरोत्तम ॥ 19 ॥
4.43.m:
[and give] mung beans to an eminent brāhmaṇa, especially to a reciter,
on the saptamī joined with horses [dedicated to] the Sun, O best of men.

4.43.s:
upoṣya vidhinānena mantraprāśanapūjaneḥ ..
ṣaḍakṣareṇa mantreṇa sarvaṃ kāryaṃ vijānatā .. 4.43.20 ..
4.43.d:
उपोष्य विधिनानेन मन्त्रप्राशनपूजनेः ॥
षडक्षरेण मन्त्रेण सर्वं कार्यं विजानता ॥ 4.43.20 ॥
4.43.m:
Having fasted according to this rule with sipping accompanied by mantras and worship,
everything should be performed with the six-syllable mantra by one who knows.

4.43.s:
arcanaṃ vahnikāryaṃ ca śatamaṣṭottaraṃ naraḥ ..
samāpte tu vrate paścātsuvarṇena ghaṭāpitam .. 21 ..
4.43.d:
अर्चनं वह्निकार्यं च शतमष्टोत्तरं नरः ॥
समाप्ते तु व्रते पश्चात्सुवर्णेन घटापितम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.43.m:
A man performs worship and fire rituals one hundred and eight times.
Afterwards, when the votive observance is completed, [an image] fashioned of gold,

4.43.s:
sauvarṇaṃ bhāskaraṃ pārtha rukmapātragataṃ śubham ..
raktāṃbaraṃ ca kāṣāyaṃ gandhaṃ dadyātsadakṣiṇam .. 22 ..
4.43.d:
सौवर्णं भास्करं पार्थ रुक्मपात्रगतं शुभम् ॥
रक्तांबरं च काषायं गन्धं दद्यात्सदक्षिणम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.43.m:
an auspicious golden Sun, O son of Pṛthā, placed in a golden vessel,
and red cloth, an ochre robe, and perfume he should give along with a priestly gift,

4.43.s:
mantreṇānena viprāya karmasiddhyai dvijātaye ..
oṃ bhāskarāya sudevāya namastubhya yaśaskara .. 23 ..
4.43.d:
मन्त्रेणानेन विप्राय कर्मसिद्ध्यै द्विजातये ॥
ओं भास्कराय सुदेवाय नमस्तुभ्य यशस्कर ॥ 23 ॥
4.43.m:
to a brāhmaṇa, a twice-born, for the success of the rite, with this mantra:
“Oṃ, to the Sun, to the good God, homage to you, O maker of renown!

4.43.s:
mamādya samīhitārthaprado bhava namonamaḥ ..
dānāni ca pradeyāni gṛhāṇi śayanāni ca .. 24 ..
4.43.d:
ममाद्य समीहितार्थप्रदो भव नमोनमः ॥
दानानि च प्रदेयानि गृहाणि शयनानि च ॥ 24 ॥
4.43.m:
Today be the granter of the matters I desire; homage, homage [to you]!”
Gifts of houses and beds should also be presented,

4.43.s:
śrāddhāni pitṛdevānāṃ śāśvatīṃ tṛptimicchatā ..
yātrā praśastā yātṝṇāṃ rājñāṃ ca jayamicchatām ..25..
4.43.d:
श्राद्धानि पितृदेवानां शाश्वतीं तृप्तिमिच्छता ॥
यात्रा प्रशस्ता यातॄणां राज्ञां च जयमिच्छताम् ॥25॥
4.43.m:
as well as ancestral offerings to the pitṛs and gods by one desiring their eternal satisfaction.
Setting out on a journey is praised for travellers, and for kings desiring victory.

4.43.s:
vijayo jāyate'vaśyaṃ yatīnāṃ ca nṛṇāṃ tadā ..
atorthaṃ viśrutā loke sadā vijayasaptamī .. 26 ..
4.43.d:
विजयो जायतेऽवश्यं यतीनां च नृणां तदा ॥
अतोर्थं विश्रुता लोके सदा विजयसप्तमी ॥ 26 ॥
4.43.m:
Victory certainly comes to ascetics and to men then.
For this reason it is celebrated in the world ever as Vijayasaptamī.

4.43.s:
evameṣā tithiḥ pārtha iha kāmapradā nṛṇām ..
paratra sukhadā saumyā sūryalokapradāyinī .. 27 ..
4.43.d:
एवमेषा तिथिः पार्थ इह कामप्रदा नृणाम् ॥
परत्र सुखदा सौम्या सूर्यलोकप्रदायिनी ॥ 27 ॥
4.43.m:
In this way, O son of Pṛthā, this lunar day grants desires to men in this world,
and in the next world it gives happiness; it is gentle and grants the world of the Sun.

4.43.s:
dātā bhogī ca caturo dīrghāyurnīrujaḥ sukhī ..
ihāgatya bhavedrājā hastyaśvadhanaratnavān .. 28 ..
4.43.d:
दाता भोगी च चतुरो दीर्घायुर्नीरुजः सुखी ॥
इहागत्य भवेद्राजा हस्त्यश्वधनरत्नवान् ॥ 28 ॥
4.43.m:
A giver, an enjoyer, clever, long-lived, free from sickness, happy,
returning to this world he becomes a king possessing elephants, horses, wealth, and jewels.

4.43.s:
nārī vā kurute yā tu sāpi tatpuṇyabhāginī ..
bhavatyatra na saṃdehaḥ kāryaḥ pārtha tvayā kvacit.. .. 29 ..
4.43.d:
नारी वा कुरुते या तु सापि तत्पुण्यभागिनी ॥
भवत्यत्र न संदेहः कार्यः पार्थ त्वया क्वचित्॥ ॥ 29 ॥
4.43.m:
Or whatever woman performs it, she too shares in that merit;
there is no doubt to be had here by you anywhere, O son of Pṛthā.

4.43.s:
svargyā samīhitasukhārthaphalapradā ca yā mṛgyate munivaraiḥ pravarā tithīnām ..
sā bhānupādakamalārcanaciṃtakānāṃ puṃsāṃ sadaiva vijayā vijayaṃ dadāti ..4.43.30..
4.43.d:
स्वर्ग्या समीहितसुखार्थफलप्रदा च या मृग्यते मुनिवरैः प्रवरा तिथीनाम् ॥
सा भानुपादकमलार्चनचिंतकानां पुंसां सदैव विजया विजयं ददाति ॥4.43.30॥
4.43.m:
Leading to heaven, granting the fruit of desired happiness and prosperity, sought by the best of sages, the foremost among lunar days,
that Vijayā ever grants victory to men who meditate on worshipping the lotus feet of the Sun.

4.43.s:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde vijayasaptamīvratakathanaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..43.. ..
ādityamaṇḍalavidhivarṇanam
4.43.d:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराण उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे विजयसप्तमीव्रतकथनं नाम त्रिचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः ॥43॥ ॥
आदित्यमण्डलविधिवर्णनम्
4.43.m:
Thus ends the forty-third chapter, titled “Account of the Vijayasaptamī Vrata,” in the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira in the Uttaraparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Rite of the Disc of the Sun

4.44.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athānyadapi te vacmi dānaṃ śreyaskaraṃ param ..
ādityamaṃḍalaṃ nāma sarvāśubhavināśanam .. 1 ..
4.44.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अथान्यदपि ते वच्मि दानं श्रेयस्करं परम् ॥
आदित्यमंडलं नाम सर्वाशुभविनाशनम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.44.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Now I shall tell you another supreme gift that produces welfare,
named the Disc of the Sun, which destroys all inauspiciousness.

4.44.s:
yavacūrṇena śubhreṇa kuryādgodhūmajena vā ..
supakvaṃ bhānubiṃbābhaṃ guḍagavyājyapūritam .. 2 ..
4.44.d:
यवचूर्णेन शुभ्रेण कुर्याद्गोधूमजेन वा ॥
सुपक्वं भानुबिंबाभं गुडगव्याज्यपूरितम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.44.m:
With pure barley flour or with wheat flour,
one should make a well-baked [cake] resembling the solar disc, filled with jaggery and cow's ghee.

4.44.s:
saṃpūjya bhāskaraṃ bhaktyā tadagre maṃḍalaṃ śubham ..
raktacandanajaṃ kuryātkuṃkumaṃ vā viśeṣataḥ .. 3 ..
4.44.d:
संपूज्य भास्करं भक्त्या तदग्रे मंडलं शुभम् ॥
रक्तचन्दनजं कुर्यात्कुंकुमं वा विशेषतः ॥ 3 ॥
4.44.m:
Having worshipped the Sun with devotion, in front of him an auspicious diagram
made of red sandalwood, or especially of saffron, one should make.

4.44.s:
maṇḍalaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya raktavastraiḥ supūjitam ..
brāhmaṇāya pradātavyaṃ maṃtreṇānena pāṃḍava .. 4 ..
4.44.d:
मण्डलं तत्र संस्थाप्य रक्तवस्त्रैः सुपूजितम् ॥
ब्राह्मणाय प्रदातव्यं मंत्रेणानेन पांडव ॥ 4 ॥
4.44.m:
Placing the disc there, well worshipped with red cloths,
it should be given to a brāhmaṇa with this mantra, O Pāṇḍava:

4.44.s:
ādityatejasotpannaṃ rājataṃ vidhinirmitam ..
śreyase mama vipra tvaṃ pratigṛhṇedamuttamam .. 5 .. (iti dānamaṃtraḥ)
4.44.d:
आदित्यतेजसोत्पन्नं राजतं विधिनिर्मितम् ॥
श्रेयसे मम विप्र त्वं प्रतिगृह्णेदमुत्तमम् ॥ 5 ॥ (इति दानमंत्रः)
4.44.m:
“Born from the splendour of the Sun, fashioned according to rule [with] silver,
O brāhmaṇa, accept this excellent [gift] for my welfare.” (Thus is the gift mantra.)

4.44.s:
kāmadaṃ dhanadaṃ dharmyaṃ putradaṃ sukhadaṃ tava ..
ādityaprītaye dattaṃ pratigṛhṇāmi maṃḍalam .. 6 .. ( iti pratigrahamaṃtra)
4.44.d:
कामदं धनदं धर्म्यं पुत्रदं सुखदं तव ॥
आदित्यप्रीतये दत्तं प्रतिगृह्णामि मंडलम् ॥ 6 ॥ ( इति प्रतिग्रहमंत्र)
4.44.m: "Granting desires, granting wealth, righteous, granting sons, and granting happiness to you, / given for the pleasure of the Sun: I accept the disk." (Thus the formula of acceptance)

4.44.s:
evaṃ dattvā naro rājansūryavaddivi rājate ..
sarvakāmasamṛddhārtho maṃḍalādhipatirbhavet .. 7 ..
4.44.d:
एवं दत्त्वा नरो राजन्सूर्यवद्दिवि राजते ॥
सर्वकामसमृद्धार्थो मंडलाधिपतिर्भवेत् ॥ 7 ॥
4.44.m: Having given thus, O king, a man shines in heaven like the sun; / with all his desires and purposes fulfilled, he becomes a lord of a territory.

4.44.s:
dātavyaṃ jayasaptamyāṃ tadārabhya dinedine ..
bhāskarasya mahārāja śaktyā bhāvena bhāvitaḥ .. 8 ..
4.44.d:
दातव्यं जयसप्तम्यां तदारभ्य दिनेदिने ॥
भास्करस्य महाराज शक्त्या भावेन भावितः ॥ 8 ॥
4.44.m: Filled with devotion, O great king, [this gift] should be given according to one's capacity / to the Sun on Jayasaptamī, and day by day from then on.

4.44.s:
godhūmacūrṇajanitaṃ yavacūrṇajaṃ vā ādityamaṃḍalamakhaṇḍaguḍādyapūrṇam ..
kṛtvā dvijāya vidhivatpratipādayedyo bhūmau bhavatyamitamaṃḍalamaṃḍito'sau .. 9 ..
trayodaśavarjyasaptamīvratavarṇanam
4.44.d:
गोधूमचूर्णजनितं यवचूर्णजं वा आदित्यमंडलमखण्डगुडाद्यपूर्णम् ॥
कृत्वा द्विजाय विधिवत्प्रतिपादयेद्यो भूमौ भवत्यमितमंडलमंडितोऽसौ ॥ 9 ॥
त्रयोदशवर्ज्यसप्तमीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.44.m:
Whoever, having fashioned a solar disk made of wheat flour or of barley flour, / filled with unbroken jaggery and the like, duly presents it to a twice-born, becomes adorned on earth with immeasurable lands.
Description of the Votive Observance of Saptamī with Thirteen Prohibitions

4.45.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
yāmupoṣya naraḥ kāmānprāpnoti manasepsitān ..
tāmekāṃ vada me deva saptamīṃ dhanasaukhyadām .. 1 ..
4.45.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
यामुपोष्य नरः कामान्प्राप्नोति मनसेप्सितान् ॥
तामेकां वद मे देव सप्तमीं धनसौख्यदाम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.45.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Tell me, O Lord, of that single saptamī which grants wealth and happiness, / fasting on which a man obtains the desires cherished in his mind.

4.45.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
bhānordine site pakṣe atīte cottarāyaṇe ..
punnāmāhvaya nakṣatre gṛhṇīyātsaptamīvratam .. 2 ..
4.45.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
भानोर्दिने सिते पक्षे अतीते चोत्तरायणे ॥
पुन्नामाह्वय नक्षत्रे गृह्णीयात्सप्तमीव्रतम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.45.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
On a Sunday, in the bright fortnight, after the winter solstice has passed, / under an asterism having a masculine name, one should undertake the votive observance of saptamī.

4.45.s:
savrīhikānyavatilānsaha māṣamudgairgodhūmamāṃsamadhumaithunakāṃsyapātram ..
abhyaṃjanāṃjana śilātalacūrṇitāni ṣaṣṭhyāṃ paraṃ pariharedahani prasiddhyai .. 3 ..
4.45.d:
सव्रीहिकान्यवतिलान्सह माषमुद्गैर्गोधूममांसमधुमैथुनकांस्यपात्रम् ॥
अभ्यंजनांजन शिलातलचूर्णितानि षष्ठ्यां परं परिहरेदहनि प्रसिद्ध्यै ॥ 3 ॥
4.45.m: Paddy rice, barley, and sesame, along with black gram, mung beans, / wheat, meat, honey, sexual intercourse, bronze vessels, / inunction, eye-ointment, and items ground on a flat stone: one should strictly avoid these on the ṣaṣṭhī day for success.

4.45.s:
devānmunīnpitṛgaṇānsajalāñjalībhiḥ saṃtarpya pūjya gaganāṃgaṇahastabhuktān ..
hutvānale tilayavānbahuśo ghṛtāktānbhūmau svapeddhṛdi nidhāya hi taṃ savitram .. 4 ..
4.45.d:
देवान्मुनीन्पितृगणान्सजलाञ्जलीभिः संतर्प्य पूज्य गगनांगणहस्तभुक्तान् ॥
हुत्वानले तिलयवान्बहुशो घृताक्तान्भूमौ स्वपेद्धृदि निधाय हि तं सवित्रम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.45.m: Having gratified the gods, sages, and ancestral hosts with handfuls of water, and having honoured them once eaten from the hand of the sky-courtyard [sun], / having repeatedly offered into the fire sesame and barley smeared with ghee, one should sleep on the ground, holding that Savitṛ in one's heart.

4.45.s:
yāni trayodaśa janairiha varjitāni dravyāṇi tāni parihṛtya paridviṣaṣṭyā ..
saṃprāśya varṣamekaṃ prāpnoti bhārata sukhaṃ manasepsitaṃ ca .. 5 ..
kukkuṭīmarkaṭīvratavarṇanam
4.45.d:
यानि त्रयोदश जनैरिह वर्जितानि द्रव्याणि तानि परिहृत्य परिद्विषष्ट्या ॥
संप्राश्य वर्षमेकं प्राप्नोति भारत सुखं मनसेप्सितं च ॥ 5 ॥
कुक्कुटीमर्कटीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.45.m:
Having avoided those thirteen substances that are here forbidden to people, / and having consumed [only permitted foods] after the ṣaṣṭhī for one year, O descendant of Bharata, one attains happiness and whatever is cherished in the mind.
Description of the Hen and Monkey Votive Observance

4.46.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
lomaśo nāma viprarṣirmathurāyāṃ gataḥ purā ..
sorcito vasudevena devakyā ca yudhiṣṭhira .. 1 ..
4.46.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
लोमशो नाम विप्रर्षिर्मथुरायां गतः पुरा ॥
सोर्चितो वसुदेवेन देवक्या च युधिष्ठिर ॥ 1 ॥
4.46.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
In ancient times, the brāhmaṇa-seer named Lomaśa went to Mathurā; / he was worshipped there, O Yudhiṣṭhira, by Vasudeva and Devakī.

4.46.s:
upaviṣṭaḥ kathāḥ puṇyāḥ kathayitvā manoharāḥ ..
tataḥ kathayituṃ bhūyaḥ kathāmetāṃ praca krame ..2..
4.46.d:
उपविष्टः कथाः पुण्याः कथयित्वा मनोहराः ॥
ततः कथयितुं भूयः कथामेतां प्रच क्रमे ॥2॥
4.46.m: Being seated, after recounting meritorious and charming tales, / he then began to narrate this story once again:

4.46.s:
kaṃse hate mṛtāḥ putrāḥ putrā jātāḥ puna. punaḥ ..
mṛtavatsā devaki tvaṃ putraduḥkhena duḥkhitā..3..
4.46.d:
कंसे हते मृताः पुत्राः पुत्रा जाताः पुन। पुनः ॥
मृतवत्सा देवकि त्वं पुत्रदुःखेन दुःखिता॥3॥
4.46.m: "When Kaṃsa was slain, your sons were dead, though sons were born again and again; / O Devakī, you whose offspring died, you were grieved by the sorrow for your sons.

4.46.s:
yathā candramukhī dīptirbabhūva mṛtaputrikā ..
paścāccīrṇavratā saiva babhūvākṣatavatsakā ..
tvameva devaki tathā bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ..4..
4.46.d:
यथा चन्द्रमुखी दीप्तिर्बभूव मृतपुत्रिका ॥
पश्चाच्चीर्णव्रता सैव बभूवाक्षतवत्सका ॥
त्वमेव देवकि तथा भविष्यसि न संशयः ॥4॥
4.46.m: Just as the moon-faced Dīpti became one whose sons were dead, / and later, having performed a votive observance, became one whose offspring were unharmed, / even so you, O Devakī, will become without a doubt."

4.46.s:
.. devakyuvāca .. ..
kā sā candramukhī brahmanbabhūva bahu putrikā .. 5 ..
4.46.d:
॥ देवक्युवाच ॥ ॥
का सा चन्द्रमुखी ब्रह्मन्बभूव बहु पुत्रिका ॥ 5 ॥
4.46.m:
Devakī said:
Who was that moon-faced lady, O brāhmaṇa, who came to have many sons?

4.46.s:
caritaṃ kiṃ vratavaraṃ bahusaṃtatikārakam ..
satāṃ sadarthakaraṇaṃ saubhāgyārogyavarddhanam .. 6 ..
4.46.d:
चरितं किं व्रतवरं बहुसंततिकारकम् ॥
सतां सदर्थकरणं सौभाग्यारोग्यवर्द्धनम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.46.m: What was her deed, what was the supreme votive observance that produces abundant progeny, / which achieves the true goal of the virtuous and increases good fortune and health?

4.46.s:
.. lomaśa uvāca .. ..
ayodhyāyāṃ purā rājā nuhuṣo nāma viśrutaḥ ..
tasya rājño mahādevī nāmnā candramukhī purā .. 7 ..
4.46.d:
॥ लोमश उवाच ॥ ॥
अयोध्यायां पुरा राजा नुहुषो नाम विश्रुतः ॥
तस्य राज्ञो महादेवी नाम्ना चन्द्रमुखी पुरा ॥ 7 ॥
4.46.m:
Lomaśa said:
Formerly in Ayodhyā, there was a celebrated king named Nahuṣa; / that king's chief queen was in former times named Candramukhī.

4.46.s:
purohitasya tasyaiva patnyāsīnmānamānikā ..
tayorāsīddṛḍhā prītiḥ spṛhaṇīyā parasparam .. 8 ..
4.46.d:
पुरोहितस्य तस्यैव पत्न्यासीन्मानमानिका ॥
तयोरासीद्दृढा प्रीतिः स्पृहणीया परस्परम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.46.m: The wife of his family priest was Mānamānikā; / between the two of them there was a firm, enviable mutual affection.

4.46.s:
athāpi tepi mitriṇyau snānārthaṃ sarayūjale ..
prāpte prāptāśca tatraiva bahvyaśca nagarāṅganāḥ .. 9 ..
4.46.d:
अथापि तेपि मित्रिण्यौ स्नानार्थं सरयूजले ॥
प्राप्ते प्राप्ताश्च तत्रैव बह्व्यश्च नगराङ्गनाः ॥ 9 ॥
4.46.m: Then those two female friends arrived at the waters of the Sarayū to bathe, / and many townswomen also arrived there.

4.46.s:
snātvā tu maṃḍala cakruḥ svapatervyaktarūpiṇaḥ ..
lekhayitvā śivaṃ śāṃtamumayā saha śaṃkaram .. 4.46.10 ..
4.46.d:
स्नात्वा तु मंडल चक्रुः स्वपतेर्व्यक्तरूपिणः ॥
लेखयित्वा शिवं शांतमुमया सह शंकरम् ॥ 4.46.10 ॥
4.46.m: Having bathed, having drawn Śiva, the peaceful Śaṅkara, together with Umā, / they made a diagram of their own manifest lord.

4.46.s:
gandhapuṣpākṣatairbhaktyā pūjayitvā yathāvidhi ..
praṇamya gaṃtukāmāstāḥ pṛṣṭāstābhyāṃ narastriyaḥ .. 11 ..
4.46.d:
गन्धपुष्पाक्षतैर्भक्त्या पूजयित्वा यथाविधि ॥
प्रणम्य गंतुकामास्ताः पृष्टास्ताभ्यां नरस्त्रियः ॥ 11 ॥
4.46.m: Having worshipped him with fragrances, flowers, and unbroken grains in accordance with the rule and with devotion, / and wishing to depart after bowing down, those women of the city were questioned by the two friends.

4.46.s:
tā ūcuḥ śaṅkaro'smābhiḥ pārvatyā saha pūjitaḥ ..
svarṇasūtramayastaṃtuḥ śivāyātmā nive ditaḥ .. 12 ..
4.46.d:
ता ऊचुः शङ्करोऽस्माभिः पार्वत्या सह पूजितः ॥
स्वर्णसूत्रमयस्तंतुः शिवायात्मा निवे दितः ॥ 12 ॥
4.46.m: They said: "Śaṅkara has been worshipped by us along with Pārvatī; / a thread consisting of gold cords has been dedicated to Śivā along with ourselves.

4.46.s:
dhārāmayamidaṃ tāvadyāvatprāṇāvadhāraṇam ..
tāsāṃ tu vacanaṃ śrutvā mitriṇyau te'pi bhārata .. 13 ..
4.46.d:
धारामयमिदं तावद्यावत्प्राणावधारणम् ॥
तासां तु वचनं श्रुत्वा मित्रिण्यौ तेऽपि भारत ॥ 13 ॥
4.46.m: This string is to be worn as long as life is sustained." / Hearing their words, those two female friends as well, O descendant of Bharata,

4.46.s:
tasyaiva samayaṃ tatra baddhvā dorbhyāṃ tu dorakaiḥ ..
tatastāḥ svagṛhāñjagmuḥ svasakhībhiḥ samāvṛtāḥ .. 14 ..
4.46.d:
तस्यैव समयं तत्र बद्ध्वा दोर्भ्यां तु दोरकैः ॥
ततस्ताः स्वगृहाञ्जग्मुः स्वसखीभिः समावृताः ॥ 14 ॥
4.46.m: undertook his vow there, tying the threads upon their arms; / then they went to their homes, surrounded by their female companions.

4.46.s:
kālena mahatā yātaṃ tasyā vai tadvrata nṛpa ..
caṃdravatyāḥ pramattāyā vismṛtaḥ sa tu dorakaḥ .. 15 ..
4.46.d:
कालेन महता यातं तस्या वै तद्व्रत नृप ॥
चंद्रवत्याः प्रमत्ताया विस्मृतः स तु दोरकः ॥ 15 ॥
4.46.m: In the course of great time, O king, her votive observance fell away; / for Candravatī, being negligent, that thread was forgotten.

4.46.s:
mṛtā kaiścidahorātraiḥ sā babhūva plavaṅgamī ..
mānī ca kukkuṭī jātā prāyaḥ saṃnikaṭañcare .. .. 16 ..
4.46.d:
मृता कैश्चिदहोरात्रैः सा बभूव प्लवङ्गमी ॥
मानी च कुक्कुटी जाता प्रायः संनिकटञ्चरे ॥ ॥ 16 ॥
4.46.m: Dying after some days and nights, she became a monkey, / and Mānī became a hen, roaming mostly nearby.

4.46.s:
tathaiva jāte mitriṇyau pūrvajātismare tathā ..
saṃbhūya bhūpasamayaṃ prāgbhūtaṃ cakratuḥ punaḥ .. 17 ..
4.46.d:
तथैव जाते मित्रिण्यौ पूर्वजातिस्मरे तथा ॥
संभूय भूपसमयं प्राग्भूतं चक्रतुः पुनः ॥ 17 ॥
4.46.m: Born thus as two female friends, remembering their former births, / meeting together, they again performed that vow of the king which they had undertaken before.

4.46.s:
taddine tatra saṃprāpte punaḥ kāle na te mṛte ..
tatraiva mātrake deśe jāte gokulasaṃyute .. 18 ..
4.46.d:
तद्दिने तत्र संप्राप्ते पुनः काले न ते मृते ॥
तत्रैव मात्रके देशे जाते गोकुलसंयुते ॥ 18 ॥
4.46.m: When that day arrived there, in time they died; / and they were born in that very same Mātṛka region, rich in herds of cows.

4.46.s:
rājño jāyā babhūvātha pṛdhvīnāthasya vā punaḥ ..
īśvarī nāma vikhyātā rājñī rājeṃdravallabhā .. 19 ..
4.46.d:
राज्ञो जाया बभूवाथ पृध्वीनाथस्य वा पुनः ॥
ईश्वरी नाम विख्याता राज्ञी राजेंद्रवल्लभा ॥ 19 ॥
4.46.m: One then became the wife of the king, the lord of the earth; / she was celebrated by the name Īśvarī, a queen beloved of the king of kings.

4.46.s:
agnimīlā dvijasyābhūdbhāryā bhūṣaṇanāmikā ..
purohitasya kālena kukkuṭī bahuputriṇī .. 4.46.20 ..
4.46.d:
अग्निमीला द्विजस्याभूद्भार्या भूषणनामिका ॥
पुरोहितस्य कालेन कुक्कुटी बहुपुत्रिणी ॥ 4.46.20 ॥
4.46.m: The hen in time became the wife, named Bhūṣaṇā, / of the family priest, the twice-born Agnimīla, and was blessed with many sons.

4.46.s:
jātismarā padmahastā aṣṭaputrā mṛtaprajā ..
punarnirantarā prītirbabhūvātha tayornṛpa .. 21 ..
4.46.d:
जातिस्मरा पद्महस्ता अष्टपुत्रा मृतप्रजा ॥
पुनर्निरन्तरा प्रीतिर्बभूवाथ तयोर्नृप ॥ 21 ॥
4.46.m: Remembering her former birth, with lotus-hands, [Īśvarī] bore eight sons whose offspring died; / and continuous affection arose between the two again, O king.

4.46.s:
tatreśvarī putramekaṃ prasūtā caiva rogiṇam ..
navavarṣastu pañcatvamagātsa ca yudhiṣṭhira .. 22 ..
4.46.d:
तत्रेश्वरी पुत्रमेकं प्रसूता चैव रोगिणम् ॥
नववर्षस्तु पञ्चत्वमगात्स च युधिष्ठिर ॥ 22 ॥
4.46.m: There Īśvarī gave birth to a single son, and he was sickly; / and at nine years of age, O Yudhiṣṭhira, he died.

4.46.s:
tatastāṃ bhūṣaṇāṃ draṣṭumathaiṣā putraduḥkhitā ..
sakhībhāvādatisnehātsarvaputrasamanvitā ..
amuktābharaṇā nityaṃ svabhāvenaiva bhūṣitā .. 23 ..
4.46.d:
ततस्तां भूषणां द्रष्टुमथैषा पुत्रदुःखिता ॥
सखीभावादतिस्नेहात्सर्वपुत्रसमन्विता ॥
अमुक्ताभरणा नित्यं स्वभावेनैव भूषिता ॥ 23 ॥
4.46.m: Then, grieved by the loss of her son, she [went] to see Bhūṣaṇā, / out of friendship and deep affection, who was accompanied by all her sons, / never without ornaments, adorned by her very nature.

4.46.s:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā putriṇīṃ bhavyāṃ prajajvāleśvarī ruṣā ..
tato gṛhaṃ preṣya ca tāṃ sakhīṃ vai tīvramatsarā .. 24 ..
4.46.d:
तां दृष्ट्वा पुत्रिणीं भव्यां प्रजज्वालेश्वरी रुषा ॥
ततो गृहं प्रेष्य च तां सखीं वै तीव्रमत्सरा ॥ 24 ॥
4.46.m: Seeing her endowed with sons and prosperous, Īśvarī blazed with fury; / then, having sent her female friend home, filled with intense jealousy,

4.46.s:
cintayāmāsa sā rātryāṃ tasyāḥ putravadhaṃ prati ..
hatāhatāśca tatputrā punarjīvantyanāmayāḥ .. 25 ..
4.46.d:
चिन्तयामास सा रात्र्यां तस्याः पुत्रवधं प्रति ॥
हताहताश्च तत्पुत्रा पुनर्जीवन्त्यनामयाः ॥ 25 ॥
4.46.m: she plotted in the night to slay her sons; / but her sons, struck down again and again, revived free from illness.

4.46.s:
kadācidāhūya sakhīṃ bhūṣaṇāṃ purataḥ sthitām ..
īśvarī prāha kimidaṃ sakhi puṇyaṃ tvayā kṛtam .. 26 ..
4.46.d:
कदाचिदाहूय सखीं भूषणां पुरतः स्थिताम् ॥
ईश्वरी प्राह किमिदं सखि पुण्यं त्वया कृतम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.46.m: Once, having summoned her friend Bhūṣaṇā standing before her, / Īśvarī said: "What merit is this that has been performed by you, my friend,

4.46.s:
yena te nihatāḥ putrāḥ punarjīvanti no bhayam ..
bahuputrā jīvavatsā amuktābharaṇā katham ..
śobhase'bhyadhikaṃ bhadre vidyutsaudāminīva hi .. 27 ..
4.46.d:
येन ते निहताः पुत्राः पुनर्जीवन्ति नो भयम् ॥
बहुपुत्रा जीववत्सा अमुक्ताभरणा कथम् ॥
शोभसेऽभ्यधिकं भद्रे विद्युत्सौदामिनीव हि ॥ 27 ॥
4.46.m: by which your sons, when slain, revive again and have no fear? / How is it that, having many sons, with your offspring alive and never without ornaments, / you shine exceedingly, O auspicious one, like a flash of lightning?"

4.46.s:
.. bhūṣaṇovāca .. ..
bhadre bhādrapade māsi saptamyāṃ salilāśaye ..
snātvā śivamaṃḍalake lekhayitvā sahāṃbikam .. 28 ..
4.46.d:
॥ भूषणोवाच ॥ ॥
भद्रे भाद्रपदे मासि सप्तम्यां सलिलाशये ॥
स्नात्वा शिवमंडलके लेखयित्वा सहांबिकम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.46.m: Bhūṣaṇā said: / O good woman, in the month of Bhādrapada, on the seventh day, having bathed in a reservoir of water, / and having drawn a circle for Śiva together with Ambikā,

4.46.s:
bhaktyā saṃpūjya samayaṃ kuryādbaddhvā kare guṇam ..
yāvajjīvaṃ mayā tāvacchivasyātmā niveditaḥ .. 29 ..
4.46.d:
भक्त्या संपूज्य समयं कुर्याद्बद्ध्वा करे गुणम् ॥
यावज्जीवं मया तावच्छिवस्यात्मा निवेदितः ॥ 29 ॥
4.46.m: having worshipped with devotion, one should make a solemn pledge, tying a cord upon the hand: / 'For as long as I live, my very self is offered to Śiva.'

4.46.s:
ityevaṃ samayaṃ kṛtvā tataḥprabhṛti dorakam ..
svarṇaraupyamayaṃ vāpi karaśākhāsu dhārayet .. 4.46.30 ..
4.46.d:
इत्येवं समयं कृत्वा ततःप्रभृति दोरकम् ॥
स्वर्णरौप्यमयं वापि करशाखासु धारयेत् ॥ 4.46.30 ॥
4.46.m: Having thus made the vow, from then onwards one should wear a cord, / or one made of gold or silver, upon the fingers of the hand.

4.46.s:
maṃḍakaṃ veṣṭikāṃ dayācchvaśrūpakṣe dvije tu vā ..
svayaṃ ca tā na bhoktavyā vratabhaṃgabhayātsakhi .. 31 ..
4.46.d:
मंडकं वेष्टिकां दयाच्छ्वश्रूपक्षे द्विजे तु वा ॥
स्वयं च ता न भोक्तव्या व्रतभंगभयात्सखि ॥ 31 ॥
4.46.m: One should give a cake and rolled pastry to the mother-in-law's family or to a twice-born; / and one must not eat them oneself, O friend, for fear of breaking the votive observance.

4.46.s:
parito mudrikā raupyā sauvarṇīṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira ..
tāmrapātropari sthāpya brāhmaṇāya nivedayet .. 32 ..
4.46.d:
परितो मुद्रिका रौप्या सौवर्णीं च युधिष्ठिर ॥
ताम्रपात्रोपरि स्थाप्य ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥ 32 ॥
4.46.m: All around, O Yudhiṣṭhira, having placed a silver and a gold ring / upon a copper vessel, one should present it to a brāhmaṇa.

4.46.s:
sohālakāni kāṃsāraṃ dadyādbhuñjīta ca svayam ..
maṇḍalaṃ sadma vittaṃ ca śivaṃ śaktisamanvitam .. 33 ..
4.46.d:
सोहालकानि कांसारं दद्याद्भुञ्जीत च स्वयम् ॥
मण्डलं सद्म वित्तं च शिवं शक्तिसमन्वितम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.46.m: One should give sohālaka pastries and kāṃsāra sweetmeat, and eat of them oneself. / The circle, the dwelling, and wealth, and Śiva accompanied by Śakti—

4.46.s:
sampūjya sakhi duṣprāpyaṃ trailokye'pi na vidyate ..
tadevaṃ samayaḥ pūrvaṃ tvayā saha mayā kṛtaḥ .. 34 ..
4.46.d:
सम्पूज्य सखि दुष्प्राप्यं त्रैलोक्येऽपि न विद्यते ॥
तदेवं समयः पूर्वं त्वया सह मया कृतः ॥ 34 ॥
4.46.m: when these are worshipped, O friend, nothing remains unattainable even in the three worlds. / Thus formerly that vow was made by me together with you.

4.46.s:
sa mayā pālito bhaktyā tato'haṃ susthitā sakhi ..
tvayā sa bhagnaḥ samayo darpāttyaktaḥ śarīrayoḥ .. 35 ..
4.46.d:
स मया पालितो भक्त्या ततोऽहं सुस्थिता सखि ॥
त्वया स भग्नः समयो दर्पात्त्यक्तः शरीरयोः ॥ 35 ॥
4.46.m: That [vow] was kept by me with devotion; therefore, O friend, I am well situated. / By you that vow was broken, cast aside from the bodies out of pride.

4.46.s:
tena santativicchinnā rājyepi sati duḥkhitā ..
eṣa prabhāvaḥ kathito vratasyāsya mayā tava .. 36 ..
4.46.d:
तेन सन्ततिविच्छिन्ना राज्येपि सति दुःखिता ॥
एष प्रभावः कथितो व्रतस्यास्य मया तव ॥ 36 ॥
4.46.m: Thereby your lineage was severed, and you are sorrowful even though you possess a kingdom. / This power of this votive observance has been related by me to you.

4.46.s:
arddhaṃ tava pradāsyāmi tasya dharmasya suvrate ..
sakhībhāvātpratīccha tvaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 37 ..
4.46.d:
अर्द्धं तव प्रदास्यामि तस्य धर्मस्य सुव्रते ॥
सखीभावात्प्रतीच्छ त्वं नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ 37 ॥
4.46.m: I will give you half of the religious merit of that, O woman of virtuous vows. / Out of friendship, accept it; no hesitation is to be made here.

4.46.s:
ityuktvā pratijagrāha vratadānaphalaṃ tataḥ ..
babhūva suprajāḥ sādhvī mokṣaṃ prāpa sureśvarī .. 38 ..
4.46.d:
इत्युक्त्वा प्रतिजग्राह व्रतदानफलं ततः ॥
बभूव सुप्रजाः साध्वी मोक्षं प्राप सुरेश्वरी ॥ 38 ॥
4.46.m: Having spoken thus, she then received the fruit of the gift of the votive observance. / The virtuous woman came to have good offspring, and the queen attained liberation.

4.46.s:
vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa saputrā tvaṃ ca devaki ..
bhaviṣyasi trilokeśaṃ putraṃ ca janayiṣyasi .. 39 ..
4.46.d:
व्रतस्यास्य प्रभावेण सपुत्रा त्वं च देवकि ॥
भविष्यसि त्रिलोकेशं पुत्रं च जनयिष्यसि ॥ 39 ॥
4.46.m: By the power of this votive observance you too, O Devakī, shall possess sons, / and you will give birth to the lord of the three worlds as your son.

4.46.s:
ityevaṃ kathayitvāsyai lomaśo munipuṃgavaḥ ..
jagāma nabhasā pārtha mayā'pyetattavoditam.. 4.46.40 ..
4.46.d:
इत्येवं कथयित्वास्यै लोमशो मुनिपुंगवः ॥
जगाम नभसा पार्थ मयाऽप्येतत्तवोदितम्॥ 4.46.40 ॥
4.46.m: Having spoken thus to her, Lomaśa, best of sages, / departed through the sky, O Pārtha; and this has been related by me to you.

4.46.s:
ye cariṣyaṃti manujā vratametadyudhiṣṭhira ..
kṛkavākuprasaṅgākhyaṃ devakyā caritaṃ śubham .. 41 ..
4.46.d:
ये चरिष्यंति मनुजा व्रतमेतद्युधिष्ठिर ॥
कृकवाकुप्रसङ्गाख्यं देवक्या चरितं शुभम् ॥ 41 ॥
4.46.m: Those mortals who will perform this votive observance, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / named the episode of the hen, the auspicious deed of Devakī,

4.46.s:
teṣāṃ santativicchedo na kadācidbhaviṣyati ..
striyaśca yāścariṣyaṃti vratametatsutapradam ..
martyaloke sukhaṃ sthitvā yāsyaṃti śivamaṃdiram .. 42 ..
4.46.d:
तेषां सन्ततिविच्छेदो न कदाचिद्भविष्यति ॥
स्त्रियश्च याश्चरिष्यंति व्रतमेतत्सुतप्रदम् ॥
मर्त्यलोके सुखं स्थित्वा यास्यंति शिवमंदिरम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.46.m: there will never be an interruption of their lineage. / And those women who will perform this votive observance that grants sons, / dwelling in happiness in the mortal world, will go to the abode of Śiva.

4.46.s:
yaḥ kukkuṭīvratavaraṃ plavagīsametaṃ cakre carācaraguruṃ hṛdaye nidhāya ..
tadvyākaroti kaluṣaughavighātarakṣāṃ sā strī yuvāṃ bhavati śobhanagītavatsā .. 43 ..
ubhayasaptamīvratavarṇanam
4.46.d:
यः कुक्कुटीव्रतवरं प्लवगीसमेतं चक्रे चराचरगुरुं हृदये निधाय ॥
तद्व्याकरोति कलुषौघविघातरक्षां सा स्त्री युवां भवति शोभनगीतवत्सा ॥ 43 ॥
उभयसप्तमीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.46.m:
Whoever, having placed the guru of moving and unmoving beings in the heart, performs the excellent votive observance of the hen together with the female monkey, / or expounds it, which protects by destroying the flood of sins, that woman becomes young, with children who are celebrated in song.
Description of the Votive Observance of Both Seventh Days

4.47.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi saptamīkalpamuttamam ..
māghamāsātsamārabhya śuklapakṣe yudhiṣṭhira ..1..
4.47.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि सप्तमीकल्पमुत्तमम् ॥
माघमासात्समारभ्य शुक्लपक्षे युधिष्ठिर ॥1॥
4.47.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Hereafter I shall declare the excellent procedure for the seventh lunar day, / beginning from the month of Māgha in the bright fortnight, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

4.47.s:
saptamyāṃ kuru saṃkalpamahorātre vrate nṛpa ..
varuṇetyarcayitvā tu brahmakūrcaṃ tu kārayet .. 2 ..
4.47.d:
सप्तम्यां कुरु संकल्पमहोरात्रे व्रते नृप ॥
वरुणेत्यर्चयित्वा तु ब्रह्मकूर्चं तु कारयेत् ॥ 2 ॥
4.47.m: On the seventh day, O king, make the solemn resolution for a day-and-night votive observance. / Having worshipped with the name Varuṇa, one should prepare the brahmakūrca.

4.47.s:
aṣṭamyāṃ bhojayedviprāṃstilapiṣṭaṃ guḍaudanam ..
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 3 ..
4.47.d:
अष्टम्यां भोजयेद्विप्रांस्तिलपिष्टं गुडौदनम् ॥
अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥ 3 ॥
4.47.m: On the eighth lunar day one should feed the vipras ground sesame and rice cooked with jaggery. / A mortal obtains the fruit of the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

4.47.s:
saptamyāṃ phālgune māsi sūryamityabhipūjayet ..
vājapeyasya yajñasya yathoktaṃ labhate phalam .. 4 ..
4.47.d:
सप्तम्यां फाल्गुने मासि सूर्यमित्यभिपूजयेत् ॥
वाजपेयस्य यज्ञस्य यथोक्तं लभते फलम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.47.m: On the seventh lunar day in the month of Phālguna one should worship [the Sun] as Sūrya; / one obtains the fruit of the Vājapeya sacrifice as stated.

4.47.s:
saptamyāṃ caitramāse tu vedāṃśumabhipūjayet ..
ukthādhvarasamaṃ puṇyaṃ naraḥ prāpnoti bhaktimān .. 5 ..
4.47.d:
सप्तम्यां चैत्रमासे तु वेदांशुमभिपूजयेत् ॥
उक्थाध्वरसमं पुण्यं नरः प्राप्नोति भक्तिमान् ॥ 5 ॥
4.47.m: On the seventh lunar day in the month of Caitra one should worship Vedāṃśu; / a devoted man obtains religious merit equal to the Ukthya sacrifice.

4.47.s:
vaiśākhasya tu saptamyāṃ dhātāramabhipūjayet ..
paśubaṃdhvadhvare puṇyaṃ samyakprāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 6 ..
4.47.d:
वैशाखस्य तु सप्तम्यां धातारमभिपूजयेत् ॥
पशुबंध्वध्वरे पुण्यं सम्यक्प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥ 6 ॥
4.47.m: On the seventh lunar day of Vaiśākha one should worship Dhātṛ; / a mortal properly obtains the religious merit of the animal sacrifice.

4.47.s:
saptamyāṃ jyeṣṭhamāsasya indra ityabhipūjayet ..
vājapeyasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti durllabham..7..
4.47.d:
सप्तम्यां ज्येष्ठमासस्य इन्द्र इत्यभिपूजयेत् ॥
वाजपेयस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति दुर्ल्लभम्॥7॥
4.47.m: On the seventh lunar day of the month of Jyeṣṭha one should worship [him] as Indra; / one obtains the rare fruit of the Vājapeya sacrifice.

4.47.s:
āṣāḍhamāse saptamyāṃ pūjayitvā divākaram ..
bahuvarṇasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam .. 8 ..
4.47.d:
आषाढमासे सप्तम्यां पूजयित्वा दिवाकरम् ॥
बहुवर्णस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति पुष्कलम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.47.m: Having worshipped the sun-maker on the seventh lunar day in the month of Āṣāḍha, / one obtains the abundant fruit of the Bahusuvarṇa sacrifice.

4.47.s:
saptamyāṃ śrāvaṇe māsi mātāpi nāma pūjayet..
sautrāmaṇiphalaṃ samyakprāpnoti puruṣaḥ śubham .. 9 ..
4.47.d:
सप्तम्यां श्रावणे मासि मातापि नाम पूजयेत्॥
सौत्रामणिफलं सम्यक्प्राप्नोति पुरुषः शुभम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.47.m: On the seventh lunar day in the month of Śrāvaṇa one should worship the name Mātṛpi; / a man properly obtains the auspicious fruit of the Sautrāmaṇī sacrifice.

4.47.s:
raviṃ prauṣṭhapade māse saptamyāmarcayecchuciḥ ..
tulāpuruṣadānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. ... 4.47.10 ..
4.47.d:
रविं प्रौष्ठपदे मासे सप्तम्यामर्चयेच्छुचिः ॥
तुलापुरुषदानस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥ ॥। 4.47.10 ॥
4.47.m: Being pure, one should worship the sun on the seventh lunar day in the month of Prauṣṭhapada; / a mortal obtains the fruit of the gift of a man weighed against gold.

4.47.s:
āśvayukchuklasaptamyāṃ savitāraṃ prapūjya ca ..
gosahasrapradānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 11 ..
4.47.d:
आश्वयुक्छुक्लसप्तम्यां सवितारं प्रपूज्य च ॥
गोसहस्रप्रदानस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥ 11 ॥
4.47.m: Having worshipped Savitṛ on the bright seventh lunar day of Āśvayuja, / a mortal obtains the fruit of giving a thousand cows.

4.47.s:
kārtike śuklasaptamyāṃ dineśaṃ saptavāha nam..
yo'bhyarcayati puṇyātmā pauṃḍarīkaṃ sa vindati .. 12 ..
4.47.d:
कार्तिके शुक्लसप्तम्यां दिनेशं सप्तवाह नम्॥
योऽभ्यर्चयति पुण्यात्मा पौंडरीकं स विन्दति ॥ 12 ॥
4.47.m: On the bright seventh lunar day in Kārtika, that virtuous soul who worships the lord of the day, / the one borne by seven horses, attains [the fruit of] the Pauṇḍarīka sacrifice.

4.47.s:
bhānuṃ mārgasite pakṣe pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ..
rājasūyasya yajñasya phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ bhajet .. 13 ..
4.47.d:
भानुं मार्गसिते पक्षे पूजयित्वा विधानतः ॥
राजसूयस्य यज्ञस्य फलं दशगुणं भजेत् ॥ 13 ॥
4.47.m: Having worshipped the sun according to rule in the bright fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, / one enjoys tenfold the fruit of the Rājasūya sacrifice.

4.47.s:
bhāskaraṃ pauṣamāse tu pūjayitvā yathāvidhi ..
narameghasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam .. 14 ..
4.47.d:
भास्करं पौषमासे तु पूजयित्वा यथाविधि ॥
नरमेघस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति पुष्कलम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.47.m: Having worshipped the light-maker according to rule in the month of Pauṣa, / one obtains the abundant fruit of the Puruṣamedha sacrifice.

4.47.s:
tadeva kṛṣṇasaptamyāṃ nāma saṃpūjayedbudhaḥ ..
sopavāsaḥ prayatnena varṣamekaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ..
paścātsamāpte niyame sūryayāgaṃ samācaret .. 15 ..
4.47.d:
तदेव कृष्णसप्तम्यां नाम संपूजयेद्बुधः ॥
सोपवासः प्रयत्नेन वर्षमेकं युधिष्ठिर ॥
पश्चात्समाप्ते नियमे सूर्ययागं समाचरेत् ॥ 15 ॥
4.47.m: On that same seventh lunar day of the dark fortnight, the wise person should worship that name / with fasting and effort for one year, O Yudhiṣṭhira. / Afterwards, when the restriction is completed, one should perform a sacrifice to the Sun.

4.47.s:
śucirbhūmau same deśe lepayedraktaca ndanaiḥ ..
ekahastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā caturhastamathāpi vā .. 16 ..
4.47.d:
शुचिर्भूमौ समे देशे लेपयेद्रक्तच न्दनैः ॥
एकहस्तं द्विहस्तं वा चतुर्हस्तमथापि वा ॥ 16 ॥
4.47.m: Pure, on level ground, one should smear with red sandalwood [paste] / an area of one cubit, two cubits, or even four cubits.

4.47.s:
siṃdūragairikābhyāṃ ca sūryamaṇḍalamālikhet ..
raktapuṣpaiḥ sapadmaiśca dhūpaiḥ kundurakādibhiḥ ..
sampūjya dadyānnaivedyaṃ vicitraṃ ghṛtapācitam .. 17 ..
4.47.d:
सिंदूरगैरिकाभ्यां च सूर्यमण्डलमालिखेत् ॥
रक्तपुष्पैः सपद्मैश्च धूपैः कुन्दुरकादिभिः ॥
सम्पूज्य दद्यान्नैवेद्यं विचित्रं घृतपाचितम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.47.m: And with vermilion and red chalk one should draw the solar orb. / Having worshipped with red flowers including lotuses, and with frankincense and other incenses, / one should offer various food offerings cooked in clarified butter.

4.47.s:
purataḥ sthāpayetkumbhānsahiṇyānnasaṃyutān ..
agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kuryātsamabhyukṣya hutāśanam .. 18 ..
4.47.d:
पुरतः स्थापयेत्कुम्भान्सहिण्यान्नसंयुतान् ॥
अग्निकार्यं ततः कुर्यात्समभ्युक्ष्य हुताशनम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.47.m: In front, one should place pots together with gold and food. / Then, having sprinkled the fire, one should perform the fire rite.

4.47.s:
ākṛṣṇeneti maṃtreṇa samidbhiścārkasaṃbhavaiḥ ..
tilairājyaguḍopeterdadyāddaśaśatāhutīḥ .. 19 ..
4.47.d:
आकृष्णेनेति मंत्रेण समिद्भिश्चार्कसंभवैः ॥
तिलैराज्यगुडोपेतेर्दद्याद्दशशताहुतीः ॥ 19 ॥
4.47.m: With the mantra beginning with 'ākṛṣṇena' and with kindling sticks born of the arka plant, / one should make a thousand oblations of sesame mixed with clarified butter and jaggery.

4.47.s:
tatastu dakṣiṇā deyā brāhmaṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ..
bhojayitvā raktavastraiḥ śuklānyapi pidhāpayet.. 4.47.20 ..
4.47.d:
ततस्तु दक्षिणा देया ब्राह्मणानां युधिष्ठिर ॥
भोजयित्वा रक्तवस्त्रैः शुक्लान्यपि पिधापयेत्॥ 4.47.20 ॥
4.47.m: Then the priestly fee should be given to the brāhmaṇas, O Yudhiṣṭhira. / Having fed them, one should cover them with red garments and white ones too.

4.47.s:
dvādaśātra praśaṃsaṃti gāvo vastrānvitāḥ śubhāḥ..
chatropānahayugmaṃ ca ekaikāya pradāpayet ..
evaṃ visṛjya tānviprānsvayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ .. 21 ..
4.47.d:
द्वादशात्र प्रशंसंति गावो वस्त्रान्विताः शुभाः॥
छत्रोपानहयुग्मं च एकैकाय प्रदापयेत् ॥
एवं विसृज्य तान्विप्रान्स्वयं भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः ॥ 21 ॥
4.47.m: Here twelve auspicious cows adorned with garments are praised; / and one should give a royal parasol and a pair of sandals to each one. / Having thus dismissed those vipras, one should oneself eat, restraining speech.

4.47.s:
ya evaṃ kurute pārtha saptamīvratamuttamam ..
nīrujo rūpavānvāggmī dīrghāyuścaiva jāyate .. 22 ..
4.47.d:
य एवं कुरुते पार्थ सप्तमीव्रतमुत्तमम् ॥
नीरुजो रूपवान्वाग्ग्मी दीर्घायुश्चैव जायते ॥ 22 ॥
4.47.m: Whoever thus performs this excellent votive observance of the seventh lunar day, O Pārtha, / becomes free from illness, handsome, eloquent, and long-lived.

4.47.s:
saptamyāṃ sopavāsastu bhānoḥ paśyaṃti ye mukham ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ sūryalokamavāpnuyuḥ .. 23 ..
4.47.d:
सप्तम्यां सोपवासस्तु भानोः पश्यंति ये मुखम् ॥
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्ताः सूर्यलोकमवाप्नुयुः ॥ 23 ॥
