4.47.m: Those who, fasting on the seventh lunar day, look upon the face of the sun, / freed from all sins, attain the world of the Sun.

4.47.s:
vratametanmahārāja sarvāśubhavināśanam ..
sarvaduṣṭapraśamanaṃ śarīrārogyakārakam ..
sūryalokapradaṃ cāṃte prāhaivaṃ nārado muniḥ .. 24 ..
4.47.d:
व्रतमेतन्महाराज सर्वाशुभविनाशनम् ॥
सर्वदुष्टप्रशमनं शरीरारोग्यकारकम् ॥
सूर्यलोकप्रदं चांते प्राहैवं नारदो मुनिः ॥ 24 ॥
4.47.m: “This votive observance, O great king, destroys all inauspiciousness, / quells all wicked things, produces bodily health, / and in the end bestows the realm of the sun.” Thus spoke the sage Nārada.

4.47.s:
ye saptamīmupavasaṃti sitāsitāṃ ca nāmākṣarairahimadīdhitimarcayaṃti ..
te sarvarogarahitāḥ sukhinaḥ sadaiva bhūtvā raveranucarāḥ suciraṃ bhavaṃti .. 25 ..
kalyāṇasaptamīvratavarṇanam
4.47.d:
ये सप्तमीमुपवसंति सितासितां च नामाक्षरैरहिमदीधितिमर्चयंति ॥
ते सर्वरोगरहिताः सुखिनः सदैव भूत्वा रवेरनुचराः सुचिरं भवंति ॥ 25 ॥
कल्याणसप्तमीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.47.m:
Those who fast on the seventh lunar day, both bright and dark, and worship the hot-rayed [sun] with the syllables of his names, / freed from all disease and ever happy, become attendants of the sun for a very long time.
Description of the Votive Observance of Kalyāṇasaptamī

4.48.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ..
bhagavandurgasaṃsārasāgarottārakārakam ..
kiñcidvrataṃ samācakṣva svargārogyasukhapradam .. 1 ..
4.48.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥
भगवन्दुर्गसंसारसागरोत्तारकारकम् ॥
किञ्चिद्व्रतं समाचक्ष्व स्वर्गारोग्यसुखप्रदम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.48.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O Blessed One, declare some votive observance that carries one across the impassable ocean of worldly existence, / and bestows heaven, health, and happiness.

4.48.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
yadā tu śuklasaptamyāmādi tyasya dinaṃ bhavet ..
tadā sā tu mahāpuṇyā vijayā tu nigadyate ..2..
4.48.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
यदा तु शुक्लसप्तम्यामादि त्यस्य दिनं भवेत् ॥
तदा सा तु महापुण्या विजया तु निगद्यते ॥2॥
4.48.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / When the bright seventh lunar day coincides with the day of the sun, / it is called Vijayā, exceedingly meritorious.

4.48.s:
prātargavyena payasā snānamasyāṃ samācaret ..
śuklāṃbaradharaḥ padmamakṣataiḥ parika lpayet ..3..
4.48.d:
प्रातर्गव्येन पयसा स्नानमस्यां समाचरेत् ॥
शुक्लांबरधरः पद्ममक्षतैः परिक ल्पयेत् ॥3॥
4.48.m: On this [day], one should bathe in the morning with cow's milk. / Wearing white garments, one should arrange a lotus with unbroken grains of rice,

4.48.s:
prāṅmukhoṣṭadalaṃ madhye tadvicitrāṃ ca karṇikām ..
sarveṣvapi daleṣveva vinyasetpūrvataḥ kramāt ..4..
4.48.d:
प्राङ्मुखोष्टदलं मध्ये तद्विचित्रां च कर्णिकाम् ॥
सर्वेष्वपि दलेष्वेव विन्यसेत्पूर्वतः क्रमात् ॥4॥
4.48.m: facing east, [drawing] an eight-petalled [lotus] with a variegated pericarp in the centre. / On each of the petals, in order starting from the east, one should assign:

4.48.s:
pūrveṇa tapanāyeti mārtaṇḍāyeti vai namaḥ ..
yāmye divākarāyeti vidhātre nairṛtena ca ..5..
4.48.d:
पूर्वेण तपनायेति मार्तण्डायेति वै नमः ॥
याम्ये दिवाकरायेति विधात्रे नैरृतेन च ॥5॥
4.48.m: in the east, “Obeisance to Tapana,” and “Obeisance to Mārtaṇḍa”; / in the south, “To Divākara”; and in the southwest, “To Vidhātṛ”;

4.48.s:
paścime varuṇāyeti bhāskarāyeti vānile ..
saumye ca varuṇāyeti ravayetya'ṣṭame dale ..6..
4.48.d:
पश्चिमे वरुणायेति भास्करायेति वानिले ॥
सौम्ये च वरुणायेति रवयेत्यऽष्टमे दले ॥6॥
4.48.m: in the west, “To Varuṇa”; and in the northwest, “To Bhāskara”; / in the north, “To Varuṇa”; and on the eighth petal, “To Ravi”.

4.48.s:
ādāvaṃte ca tanmadhye namo'stu paramātmane ..
maṃtrairevaṃ samabhyarcya namaskārāṃtadīpitaiḥ ..7..
4.48.d:
आदावंते च तन्मध्ये नमोऽस्तु परमात्मने ॥
मंत्रैरेवं समभ्यर्च्य नमस्कारांतदीपितैः ॥7॥
4.48.m: At the beginning, at the end, and in its centre: “Obeisance be to the Supreme Self.” / Having thus worshipped with mantras illuminated by endings of salutation,
with white clothes, fruits, edibles, incense, garlands, and ointments, / one should worship with devotion on a raised mound with raw sugar and salt.

4.48.s:
tato vyāhṛtihomena vibhajya dvijapuṅgavān ..
śaktitastarpayedbhaktyā guḍakṣīraghṛtādibhiḥ ..9..
4.48.d:
ततो व्याहृतिहोमेन विभज्य द्विजपुङ्गवान् ॥
शक्तितस्तर्पयेद्भक्त्या गुडक्षीरघृतादिभिः ॥9॥
4.48.m: Then, having performed the oblation with the vyāhṛtis and distributed [gifts] to eminent brāhmaṇas, / one should satisfy them with devotion according to one's capacity with raw sugar, milk, ghee, and the like.

4.48.s:
tilapātraṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca gurave ca nivedayet ..
evaṃ niyamakṛtsnātvā prātarutthāya mānavaḥ ..4.48.10..
4.48.d:
तिलपात्रं हिरण्यं च गुरवे च निवेदयेत् ॥
एवं नियमकृत्स्नात्वा प्रातरुत्थाय मानवः ॥4.48.10॥
4.48.m: One should present a vessel of sesame and gold to the teacher. / Having thus undertaken the observance, having arisen in the morning and bathed, a person,

4.48.s:
kṛtasnānajapo vipraiḥ sahaiva ghṛtapāyasam ..
bhuktvā ca vedavidvadbhirbaiḍālavratava rjitaiḥ .. 11 ..
4.48.d:
कृतस्नानजपो विप्रैः सहैव घृतपायसम् ॥
भुक्त्वा च वेदविद्वद्भिर्बैडालव्रतव र्जितैः ॥ 11 ॥
4.48.m: having performed bath and silent recitation, having eaten milk-rice with ghee / together with brāhmaṇas who know the Veda and are free from the hypocritical observance of the cat,

4.48.s:
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte kṛtvaitadakhilaṃ nṛpa ..
udyāpayedyathāśakti bhāskaraṃ saṃsmaranhṛdi .. 12 ..
4.48.d:
एवं संवत्सरस्यांते कृत्वैतदखिलं नृप ॥
उद्यापयेद्यथाशक्ति भास्करं संस्मरन्हृदि ॥ 12 ॥
4.48.m: having done all this, O king, at the end of a year, / one should conclude the observance according to one's capacity, remembering the sun in one's heart.

4.48.s:
ghṛtapātraṃ sakarakaṃ sodakumbhaṃ niveda yet ..
vastrālaṃkārasaṃyuktāṃ suvarṇāsyāṃ payasvinīm .. 13 ..
4.48.d:
घृतपात्रं सकरकं सोदकुम्भं निवेद येत् ॥
वस्त्रालंकारसंयुक्तां सुवर्णास्यां पयस्विनीम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.48.m: One should offer a vessel of ghee together with a water jar and a water-pot, / and a milch cow with golden horns, accompanied by clothing and ornaments.

4.48.s:
ekāmapi pradadyādgāṃ vittahīno vimatsaraḥ ..
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta tato mohātpata tyadhaḥ .. 14 ..
4.48.d:
एकामपि प्रदद्याद्गां वित्तहीनो विमत्सरः ॥
वित्तशाठ्यं न कुर्वीत ततो मोहात्पत त्यधः ॥ 14 ॥
4.48.m: Even a poor person, free from malice, should give even a single cow; / one should not practice deceit regarding wealth, for out of such delusion one falls down.

4.48.s:
anena vidhinā yastu kuryātkalyāṇasaptamīm ..
śṛṇuyādvā paṭhedvāpi so'pi pāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 15 ..
4.48.d:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु कुर्यात्कल्याणसप्तमीम् ॥
शृणुयाद्वा पठेद्वापि सोऽपि पापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥ 15 ॥
4.48.m: Whoever performs the Kalyāṇasaptamī according to this rite, / or hears or recites it, is also freed from sins.

4.48.s:
yaścāṣṭapatrakamalodarakarṇikāyāṃ saṃpūjayetkusumadhūpavilepanāyaiḥ ..
ṣaṣṭhyāḥ parehani navārtiharaṃ dineśaṃ kalyāṇabhājanamasau bhavate hi jaṃtuḥ .. 16 ..
śarkarāsaptamīvratavarṇanam
4.48.d:
यश्चाष्टपत्रकमलोदरकर्णिकायां संपूजयेत्कुसुमधूपविलेपनायैः ॥
षष्ठ्याः परेहनि नवार्तिहरं दिनेशं कल्याणभाजनमसौ भवते हि जंतुः ॥ 16 ॥
शर्करासप्तमीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.48.m:
And whoever worships the lord of the day, who dispels ever-new distress, on the day after the sixth lunar day / in the central pericarp of an eight-petalled lotus with flowers, incense, ointments, and the like, that creature indeed becomes a vessel of auspiciousness.
Description of the Votive Observance of Śarkarāsaptamī

4.49.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śarkarāsaptamīṃ vakṣye sarvakalmaṣanāśinīm ..
āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ yayānaṃtaṃ prajāyate .. 1 ..
4.49.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शर्करासप्तमीं वक्ष्ये सर्वकल्मषनाशिनीम् ॥
आयुरारोग्यमैश्वर्यं ययानंतं प्रजायते ॥ 1 ॥
4.49.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / I shall declare Śarkarāsaptamī, which destroys all impurities, / through which endless longevity, health, and dominion arise.

4.49.s:
mādhavasya site pakṣe saptamyāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ ..
prātaḥ snātvā tilaiḥ śuddhaiḥ śuklamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 2 ..
4.49.d:
माधवस्य सिते पक्षे सप्तम्यां श्रद्धयान्वितः ॥
प्रातः स्नात्वा तिलैः शुद्धैः शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥ 2 ॥
4.49.m: On the seventh lunar day in the bright fortnight of Mādhava, endowed with faith, / having bathed in the morning with pure sesame seeds, [adorned] with white garlands and ointments,

4.49.s:
sthaṃḍile padmamālikhya kuṃkumena sakarṇikam ..
tasminnamaḥ savitreti gandhapuṣpaṃ nivedayet..3..
4.49.d:
स्थंडिले पद्ममालिख्य कुंकुमेन सकर्णिकम् ॥
तस्मिन्नमः सवित्रेति गन्धपुष्पं निवेदयेत्॥3॥
4.49.m: having drawn on a raised mound a lotus with a pericarp using saffron, / one should offer fragrant paste and flowers to it, saying: “Obeisance to Savitṛ.”

4.49.s:
sthāpayedudakuṃbhaṃ ca śarkarāpātrasaṃyutam ..
raktavastraiḥ svalaṃkṛtya śuklamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 4 ..
4.49.d:
स्थापयेदुदकुंभं च शर्करापात्रसंयुतम् ॥
रक्तवस्त्रैः स्वलंकृत्य शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥ 4 ॥
4.49.m: And one should set up a water pot accompanied by a bowl of sugar, / well adorned with red clothes, and with white garlands and ointments.

4.49.s:
suvarṇāśvasamāyuktaṃ maṃtreṇānena pūjayet ..
viśvedevamayo yasmādvedavādīti paṭhyate .. 5 ..
4.49.d:
सुवर्णाश्वसमायुक्तं मंत्रेणानेन पूजयेत् ॥
विश्वेदेवमयो यस्माद्वेदवादीति पठ्यते ॥ 5 ॥
4.49.m: Furnished with a golden horse, one should worship with this mantra: / “Since he consists of all the gods, he is proclaimed as the speaker of the Veda;

4.49.s:
tvamevāmṛtasarvasvamataḥ pāhi sanātana ..
saurasūktaṃ japaṃstiṣṭhetpurāṇaśravaṇena vā .. 6 ..
4.49.d:
त्वमेवामृतसर्वस्वमतः पाहि सनातन ॥
सौरसूक्तं जपंस्तिष्ठेत्पुराणश्रवणेन वा ॥ 6 ॥
4.49.m: you alone are the entire essence of immortality; therefore protect [us], O Eternal One.” / One should remain silently reciting the solar hymn, or listening to the Purāṇa.

4.49.s:
ahorātre gate paścādaṣṭamyāṃ kṛtanityakaḥ ..
sarvaṃ ca vedaviduṣe brāhmaṇāyopapādayet ..7..
4.49.d:
अहोरात्रे गते पश्चादष्टम्यां कृतनित्यकः ॥
सर्वं च वेदविदुषे ब्राह्मणायोपपादयेत् ॥7॥
4.49.m: After a day and a night have passed, on the eighth lunar day, having performed one's daily duties, / one should present everything to a brāhmaṇa who knows the Veda.

4.49.s:
bhojayecchaktito viprāñcharkarāghṛtapāyasaiḥ ..
bhuñjīta tailalavaṇaṃ svayamapyatha vāgyataḥ .. .. 8 ..
4.49.d:
भोजयेच्छक्तितो विप्राञ्छर्कराघृतपायसैः ॥
भुञ्जीत तैललवणं स्वयमप्यथ वाग्यतः ॥ ॥ 8 ॥
4.49.m: One should feed brāhmaṇas according to one's capacity with sugar, ghee, and milk-rice, / and one should oneself eat oil and salt, controlling one's speech.

4.49.s:
anena vidhinā sarvaṃ māsimāsi samācaret ..
vatsarāṃte punardadyādbrāhmaṇāya samāhitaḥ .. 9 ..
4.49.d:
अनेन विधिना सर्वं मासिमासि समाचरेत् ॥
वत्सरांते पुनर्दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाय समाहितः ॥ 9 ॥
4.49.m: One should perform everything according to this rite month after month. / At the end of the year, composed in mind, one should give again to a brāhmaṇa

4.49.s:
śayanaṃ vastrasaṃvītaṃ śarkarākalaśānvitam .. .
sarvopaskarasaṃyuktaṃ tathaikāṃ gāṃ payasvinīm .. 4.49.10 ..
4.49.d:
शयनं वस्त्रसंवीतं शर्कराकलशान्वितम् ॥ ।
सर्वोपस्करसंयुक्तं तथैकां गां पयस्विनीम् ॥ 4.49.10 ॥
4.49.m: a bed covered with cloth, accompanied by a pitcher of sugar / and equipped with all utensils, and likewise a single milch cow.

4.49.s:
gṛhaṃ ca śaktito dadyātsamastopaskarānvitam ..
sahasreṇāpi niṣkāṇāṃ kṛtvā dadyācchatena vā ... 11 ..
4.49.d:
गृहं च शक्तितो दद्यात्समस्तोपस्करान्वितम् ॥
सहस्रेणापि निष्काणां कृत्वा दद्याच्छतेन वा ॥। 11 ॥
4.49.m: And according to one's capacity one should give a house equipped with all utensils; / one may give having made it with a thousand niṣkas, or with a hundred,
or with ten, two, or three niṣkas, or even with half of that, out of devotion. / A golden horse should be given, with recitation of mantras as before.

4.49.s:
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta kurvandoṣānsa maśnute ..
amṛtaṃ pibato vaktrātsūryasyāmṛtabindavaḥ..13..
4.49.d:
वित्तशाठ्यं न कुर्वीत कुर्वन्दोषान्स मश्नुते ॥
अमृतं पिबतो वक्त्रात्सूर्यस्यामृतबिन्दवः॥13॥
4.49.m: One should not practice deceit regarding wealth; by doing so, one incurs faults. / As the sun was drinking the nectar, drops of nectar from his mouth

4.49.s:
nipetureta utthāya śālimudgekṣavaḥ smṛtāḥ ..
śarkarā ca paraṃ tasmādikṣurasodbhavā matā..14.. .
4.49.d:
निपेतुरेत उत्थाय शालिमुद्गेक्षवः स्मृताः ॥
शर्करा च परं तस्मादिक्षुरसोद्भवा मता॥14॥ ।
4.49.m: fell down, and having sprung up, they are known as śāli rice, mudga beans, and sugarcane; / and sugar is considered superior because it is produced from sugarcane juice.

4.49.s:
iṣṭā raverataḥ puṇyā śarkarā havyakavyayoḥ ..
śarkarāsaptamī caiṣā vājimedhaphalapradā .. 15 ..
4.49.d:
इष्टा रवेरतः पुण्या शर्करा हव्यकव्ययोः ॥
शर्करासप्तमी चैषा वाजिमेधफलप्रदा ॥ 15 ॥
4.49.m: Therefore, sugar is dear to the sun, pure in offerings to gods and ancestors. / And this Śarkarāsaptamī bestows the fruit of a horse sacrifice;

4.49.s:
sarve hyupaśamaṃ yāṃti punaḥ saṃtativarddhinī ..
yaḥ kuryātparayā bhaktyā sa paraṃ brahma gacchati .. 16 ..
4.49.d:
सर्वे ह्युपशमं यांति पुनः संततिवर्द्धिनी ॥
यः कुर्यात्परया भक्त्या स परं ब्रह्म गच्छति ॥ 16 ॥
4.49.m: all [disturbances] indeed subside, and it increases one's progeny. / Whoever performs it with supreme devotion goes to the supreme Brahman.

4.49.s: kalpamekaṃ vasetsvarge tato yāti paraṃ padam .. 17 ..
4.49.d: कल्पमेकं वसेत्स्वर्गे ततो याति परं पदम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.49.m: He dwells in heaven for one kalpa; thereafter he goes to the supreme abode.

4.49.s:
idamanagha śṛṇoti yaḥ smaredvā paripaṭhatīha sureśvarasya loke ..
matimapi ca dadāti yo janānāmamaravadhūjanakinnaraiḥ sa pūjyaḥ .. 18 .. ..
kamalāsaptamīvratavarṇanam
4.49.d:
इदमनघ शृणोति यः स्मरेद्वा परिपठतीह सुरेश्वरस्य लोके ॥
मतिमपि च ददाति यो जनानाममरवधूजनकिन्नरैः स पूज्यः ॥ 18 ॥ ॥
कमलासप्तमीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.49.m:
Whoever, sinless one, hears this, remembers it, or recites it fully in the world of the lord of the gods, / and whoever directs the minds of people [toward it], is worthy of honour by celestial women and kinnaras.
Description of the Votive Observance of Kamalāsaptamī

4.50.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ataḥparaṃ pravakṣyāmi tadvatkamalasaptamīm ..
yasyāḥ saṃkīrtanādeva tuṣyatīha divākaraḥ .. 1 ..
4.50.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अतःपरं प्रवक्ष्यामि तद्वत्कमलसप्तमीम् ॥
यस्याः संकीर्तनादेव तुष्यतीह दिवाकरः ॥ 1 ॥
4.50.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Hereafter I shall declare in like manner Kamalāsaptamī, / by the mere praise of which the maker of day is pleased in this world.

4.50.s:
vasaṃte'malasaptamyāṃ snātaḥ sangaurasarṣapaiḥ ..
tilapātre ca sauvarṇaṃ nidhāya kamalaṃ śubham .. 2 ..
4.50.d:
वसंतेऽमलसप्तम्यां स्नातः सन्गौरसर्षपैः ॥
तिलपात्रे च सौवर्णं निधाय कमलं शुभम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.50.m: In spring, on the bright seventh lunar day, having bathed with white mustard seeds, / and having placed an auspicious golden lotus in a vessel of sesame,

4.50.s:
vastrayugmavṛtaṃ kṛtvā gaṃdhapuṣpairathārcayet..
namaste padmahastāya namaste viśvadhāriṇe..3..
4.50.d:
वस्त्रयुग्मवृतं कृत्वा गंधपुष्पैरथार्चयेत्॥
नमस्ते पद्महस्ताय नमस्ते विश्वधारिणे॥3॥
4.50.m:
Having covered [it] with a pair of garments, one should then worship it with perfumes and flowers:
'Homage to you who hold a lotus in your hand! Homage to you who support the universe!

4.50.s:
divākara namastubhyaṃ prabhākara namo'stu te ..
tato dvikālavelāyāmudakuṃbhasamanvitam .. 4 ..
4.50.d:
दिवाकर नमस्तुभ्यं प्रभाकर नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
ततो द्विकालवेलायामुदकुंभसमन्वितम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.50.m:
O Sun, day-maker, homage to you! O light-maker, homage be to you!'
Then, at the time of dusk, accompanied by a water-jar,

4.50.s:
viprāya dadyātsaṃpūjya vastramālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
ahorātre gate paścādaṣṭamyāṃ bhojayeddvijān.. 5..
4.50.d:
विप्राय दद्यात्संपूज्य वस्त्रमाल्यविभूषणैः ॥
अहोरात्रे गते पश्चादष्टम्यां भोजयेद्द्विजान्॥ 5॥
4.50.m:
one should give [it] to a brāhmaṇa after honouring him with garments, garlands, and ornaments.
When the day and night have passed, on the subsequent aṣṭamī one should feed twice-born men.

4.50.s:
yathāśaktyātha bhuñjīta vimāṃsaṃ tailavarjitam ..
anena vidhinā śuklasaptamyāṃ māsimāsi ca .. 6 ..
4.50.d:
यथाशक्त्याथ भुञ्जीत विमांसं तैलवर्जितम् ॥
अनेन विधिना शुक्लसप्तम्यां मासिमासि च ॥ 6 ॥
4.50.m:
Then, according to one's capacity, one should eat without meat and without oil.
By this rule, on the bright saptamī, month after month,

4.50.s:
sarvaṃ samācaredbhaktyā vitta śāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ..
vratāṃte śayanaṃ dadyātsuvarṇakamalānvitam ..7..
4.50.d:
सर्वं समाचरेद्भक्त्या वित्त शाठ्यविवर्जितः ॥
व्रतांते शयनं दद्यात्सुवर्णकमलान्वितम् ॥7॥
4.50.m:
one should perform everything with devotion, free from deceit regarding wealth.
At the conclusion of the votive observance, one should give a bed furnished with a golden lotus.

4.50.s:
gāvaṃ sa dadyācchaktyā tu suvarṇāḍhyāṃ payasvinīm..
bhājanāsanadīpādīndadyādiṣṭānupaskarān .. 8 ..
4.50.d:
गावं स दद्याच्छक्त्या तु सुवर्णाढ्यां पयस्विनीम्॥
भाजनासनदीपादीन्दद्यादिष्टानुपस्करान् ॥ 8 ॥
4.50.m:
According to one's ability, he should give a milch cow adorned with gold,
and should give dishes, seats, lamps, and other desirable domestic utensils.

4.50.s:
anena vidhinā yastu kuryātkamalasaptamīm ..
lakṣmīmanantāmabhyetya sūryaloke ca modate .. 9 ..
4.50.d:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु कुर्यात्कमलसप्तमीम् ॥
लक्ष्मीमनन्तामभ्येत्य सूर्यलोके च मोदते ॥ 9 ॥
4.50.m:
Whoever performs the Kamalāsaptamī according to this rule,
having attained infinite fortune, rejoices in the world of the sun.

4.50.s:
kalpekalpe tathā lokānsapta gatvā pṛthakpṛthak ..
apsarobhiḥ parivṛtastato yāti parāṅgatim .. 4.50.10 ..
4.50.d:
कल्पेकल्पे तथा लोकान्सप्त गत्वा पृथक्पृथक् ॥
अप्सरोभिः परिवृतस्ततो याति पराङ्गतिम् ॥ 4.50.10 ॥
4.50.m:
Having gone individually to the seven worlds in eon after eon,
surrounded by apsarases, he then goes to the supreme state.

4.50.s:
yaḥ paśyatīdaṃ śṛṇuyānmuhūrtaṃ paṭhecca bhaktyā sumatiṃ dadāti ..
so'pyatra lakṣmīmacalāmavāpya gandharvavidyādharalokameti .. 11 .. ..
śubhasaptamīvratavarṇanam
4.50.d:
यः पश्यतीदं शृणुयान्मुहूर्तं पठेच्च भक्त्या सुमतिं ददाति ॥
सोऽप्यत्र लक्ष्मीमचलामवाप्य गन्धर्वविद्याधरलोकमेति ॥ 11 ॥ ॥
शुभसप्तमीव्रतवर्णनम्

4.51.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
anyāmapi pravakṣyāmi śobhanāṃ śubhasaptamīm ..
yāmupoṣya naro rogācchokaduḥkhātpramucyate .. 1 ..
4.51.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अन्यामपि प्रवक्ष्यामि शोभनां शुभसप्तमीम् ॥
यामुपोष्य नरो रोगाच्छोकदुःखात्प्रमुच्यते ॥ 1 ॥
4.51.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
I shall explain another auspicious [observance], the Śubhasaptamī,
by fasting on which a man is freed from disease, sorrow, and misery.

4.51.s:
puṇya āśvayuje māsi kṛtasnānaḥ payaḥ śuciḥ ..
vācayeta tato viprānārabhecchubhasaptamīm .. 2 ..
4.51.d:
पुण्य आश्वयुजे मासि कृतस्नानः पयः शुचिः ॥
वाचयेत ततो विप्रानारभेच्छुभसप्तमीम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.51.m:
In the holy month of Āśvayuja, having bathed and purified himself with water,
he should then have the brāhmaṇas recite blessings and begin the Śubhasaptamī.

He should devoutly worship a brown cow with perfumes, garlands, and ointments:
'I bow to you, born of the sun, abode of all the worlds;

4.51.s:
tvāmahaṃ śubhakalyāṇaśarīrāṃ sarvasiddhaye ..
athāhṛtya tilaprasthaṃ tāmrapātreṇa saṃyutam .. 4 ..
4.51.d:
त्वामहं शुभकल्याणशरीरां सर्वसिद्धये ॥
अथाहृत्य तिलप्रस्थं ताम्रपात्रेण संयुतम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.51.m:
to you whose body is auspicious and benevolent, for the sake of all accomplishments.'
Then, having procured a prastha of sesame together with a copper vessel,

as well as a golden bull, accompanied by garments, garlands, and raw sugar,
he should give it at the time of dusk, saying, 'May Aryaman be pleased.'

4.51.s:
pañcagavyaṃ ca saṃprāśya svapyādbhūmau vimatsaraḥ ..
tataḥ prabhāte saṃjāte bhaktyā saṃtarpayeddvijān .. 6 ..
4.51.d:
पञ्चगव्यं च संप्राश्य स्वप्याद्भूमौ विमत्सरः ॥
ततः प्रभाते संजाते भक्त्या संतर्पयेद्द्विजान् ॥ 6 ॥
4.51.m:
Having consumed the five products of the cow, free from malice, he should sleep on the ground.
Then, when morning has arrived, he should devoutly satisfy the twice-born men.

4.51.s:
anena vidhinā dadyānmāsimāsi sadā naraḥ ..
vāsasī vṛṣabhaṃ haimaṃ tadvaddhenostu pūjanam .. 7 ..
4.51.d:
अनेन विधिना दद्यान्मासिमासि सदा नरः ॥
वाससी वृषभं हैमं तद्वद्धेनोस्तु पूजनम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.51.m:
According to this procedure, a man should constantly give month after month
two garments, a golden bull, and likewise worship the cow.

At the end of a year, [he should give] a bed accompanied by sugarcane stalks and raw sugar,
provided with a pillow and couch, along with dishes and a seat,

4.51.s:
tāmrapātraṃ tilaprasthaṃ sauvarṇavṛṣasaṃyutam ..
dadyādvedavide sarvaṃ viśvātmā prīyatāmiti .. 9 ..
4.51.d:
ताम्रपात्रं तिलप्रस्थं सौवर्णवृषसंयुतम् ॥
दद्याद्वेदविदे सर्वं विश्वात्मा प्रीयतामिति ॥ 9 ॥
4.51.m:
a copper vessel, a prastha of sesame, together with a golden bull—
he should give all this to a knower of the Veda, saying, 'May the Soul of the Universe be pleased.'

4.51.s:
anena vidhinā rājankuryādyaḥ śubhasaptamīm ..
tasya śrīrvimalā kīrtirbha vejanmanijanmani .. 4.51.10 ..
4.51.d:
अनेन विधिना राजन्कुर्याद्यः शुभसप्तमीम् ॥
तस्य श्रीर्विमला कीर्तिर्भ वेजन्मनिजन्मनि ॥ 4.51.10 ॥
4.51.m:
O king, whoever performs the Śubhasaptamī according to this rule,
his spotless fortune and fame will endure birth after birth.

4.51.s:
apsarogaṇagandharvaiḥ pūjyamānaḥ surālaye ..
vasedgaṇādhipo bhūtvā yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 11 ..
4.51.d:
अप्सरोगणगन्धर्वैः पूज्यमानः सुरालये ॥
वसेद्गणाधिपो भूत्वा यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.51.m:
Being worshipped in the abode of the gods by troops of apsarases and gandharvas,
he shall dwell as a troop-leader until the dissolution of all elements.

4.51.s:
sa kalpādavatīrṇastu saptadvīpādhipo bhavet..
brahmahatyāsahasrasya bhrūṇahatyāśatasya ca .. 12 ..
4.51.d:
स कल्पादवतीर्णस्तु सप्तद्वीपाधिपो भवेत्॥
ब्रह्महत्यासहस्रस्य भ्रूणहत्याशतस्य च ॥ 12 ॥
4.51.m:
Having descended from that eon, he becomes the sovereign of the seven continents.
The destruction of a thousand slayings of a brāhmaṇa and a hundred abortions
is effected by this holy Śubhasaptamī when performed.

4.51.s:
imāṃ paṭhedyaḥ śṛṇuyā nmuhūrtaṃ vīkṣeta saṃgādapi dīyamānam ..
so'pyatra saṃbādhya vimuktadehaḥ prāpnoti vidyādharanāyakatvam ..18 .. ..
snapanasaptamīvratavarṇanam
4.51.d:
इमां पठेद्यः शृणुया न्मुहूर्तं वीक्षेत संगादपि दीयमानम् ॥
सोऽप्यत्र संबाध्य विमुक्तदेहः प्राप्नोति विद्याधरनायकत्वम् ॥18 ॥ ॥
स्नपनसप्तमीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.51.m:
Whoever reads this, listens to it for an instant, or even witnesses it being performed through association,
he too, having cast off his body [at death] without distress, attains the status of a lord of vidyādharas.
Description of the Snapanasaptamī Votive Observance

4.52.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ..
kimudvegādbhavetkṛtyamalakṣmīḥ kena hanyate ..
mṛtavatsādikāryeṣu duḥsvapne ca kimiṣyate .. 1 ..
4.52.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥
किमुद्वेगाद्भवेत्कृत्यमलक्ष्मीः केन हन्यते ॥
मृतवत्सादिकार्येषु दुःस्वप्ने च किमिष्यते ॥ 1 ॥
4.52.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
What should be done out of anxiety? By what is misfortune destroyed?
And what is prescribed in cases of stillbirth and the like, and in bad dreams?

4.52.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
purā kṛtāni pāpāni phalaṃtyatra yudhiṣṭhira..
rogardaurgatyarūpeṇa tathaiveṣṭavighātanaiḥ .. 2 ..
4.52.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पुरा कृतानि पापानि फलंत्यत्र युधिष्ठिर॥
रोगर्दौर्गत्यरूपेण तथैवेष्टविघातनैः ॥ 2 ॥
4.52.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Sins committed previously bear fruit here, O Yudhiṣṭhira,
in the form of illness, poverty, and likewise the obstruction of desired ends.

4.52.s:
tadvighātāya vakṣyāmi sadā kalyāṇasaptamīm ..
saptamīsnapanaṃ nāma vyādhipīḍāvināśanam .. 3 ..
4.52.d:
तद्विघाताय वक्ष्यामि सदा कल्याणसप्तमीम् ॥
सप्तमीस्नपनं नाम व्याधिपीडाविनाशनम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.52.m:
For their counteraction, I shall proclaim the ever-auspicious saptamī,
named Saptamī-snapana, which destroys the affliction of disease.

4.52.s:
bālānāṃ maraṇaṃ yatra kṣīrapānaṃ praśasyate ..
tadvadvṛddhāturāṇāṃ ca yauvane vāpi vartatām ..4..
4.52.d:
बालानां मरणं यत्र क्षीरपानं प्रशस्यते ॥
तद्वद्वृद्धातुराणां च यौवने वापि वर्तताम् ॥4॥
4.52.m:
Where there is the death of children, while drinking milk is praised,
and likewise for the elderly, the sick, or those remaining in their youth,

4.52.s:
śāntaye tatra vakṣyāmi mṛtavatsādike ca yat ..
etadevādbhutodvegaciṃtāvibhramamānasam ..5..
4.52.d:
शान्तये तत्र वक्ष्यामि मृतवत्सादिके च यत् ॥
एतदेवाद्भुतोद्वेगचिंताविभ्रममानसम् ॥5॥
4.52.m:
I shall proclaim that for pacification, and in matters such as stillbirth,
which causes unnatural anxiety, worry, and bewilderment in the mind.

4.52.s:
varāhakalpe saṃprāpte manorvaivasvateṃ'tare..
kṛte yuge mahārāja haihayo rūpavarddhanaḥ ..6..
4.52.d:
वराहकल्पे संप्राप्ते मनोर्वैवस्वतेंऽतरे॥
कृते युगे महाराज हैहयो रूपवर्द्धनः ॥6॥
4.52.m:
When the Varāha kalpa arrived, during the interval of Manu Vaivasvata,
in the Kṛta age, O great king, the handsome Haihaya,

4.52.s:
āsīnnṛpottamaḥ pūrvaṃ kṛtavīryaḥ pratāpavān ..
sa saptadvīpamakhilaṃ pālayāmāsa bhūtalam ..7..
4.52.d:
आसीन्नृपोत्तमः पूर्वं कृतवीर्यः प्रतापवान् ॥
स सप्तद्वीपमखिलं पालयामास भूतलम् ॥7॥
4.52.m:
the eminent king of old, Kṛtavīrya the powerful, lived;
he protected the entire earth with its seven continents,

4.52.s:
yāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi saptasaptati bhārata..
jātamātraṃ ca tasyātha śubhaṃ putraśataṃ kila ..8..
4.52.d:
यावद्वर्षसहस्राणि सप्तसप्तति भारत॥
जातमात्रं च तस्याथ शुभं पुत्रशतं किल ॥8॥
4.52.m:
for seventy-seven thousand years, O Bhārata.
And of him, indeed, a hundred auspicious sons, as soon as they were born,

4.52.s:
yavanasya tu śāpena vināśamagamatpurā ..
kṛtavīryaḥ samārādhya sahasrāṃśuṃ divākaram ..9..
4.52.d:
यवनस्य तु शापेन विनाशमगमत्पुरा ॥
कृतवीर्यः समाराध्य सहस्रांशुं दिवाकरम् ॥9॥
4.52.m:
went to destruction in the past through the curse of a Yavana.
Kṛtavīrya, having propitiated the thousand-rayed day-maker,

4.52.s:
upavāsavratairdivyairvedasūktaiśca bhārata ..
darśayāmāsa cātmānaṃ kṛtavīryasya bhānumat ..4.52.1 0..
4.52.d:
उपवासव्रतैर्दिव्यैर्वेदसूक्तैश्च भारत ॥
दर्शयामास चात्मानं कृतवीर्यस्य भानुमत् ॥4.52.1 0॥
4.52.m:
with divine fasting observances and Vedic hymns, O Bhārata,
the radiant [sun] revealed himself to Kṛtavīrya.

4.52.s:
kṛtavīryeṇa vai pṛṣṭaḥ provācedaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ ..
atikleśena mahatā putrastava narādhipa ..11..
4.52.d:
कृतवीर्येण वै पृष्टः प्रोवाचेदं बृहस्पतिः ॥
अतिक्लेशेन महता पुत्रस्तव नराधिप ॥11॥
4.52.m:
Being asked by Kṛtavīrya, Bṛhaspati said this:
'Through great striving, O ruler of men, your son

4.52.s:
bhaviṣyati ciraṃjīvī kiṃ tu kalmaṣanāśanam ..
saptamīsnapanaṃ vāpyāṃ kuru pāpavinaṣṭaye .. 12 ..
4.52.d:
भविष्यति चिरंजीवी किं तु कल्मषनाशनम् ॥
सप्तमीस्नपनं वाप्यां कुरु पापविनष्टये ॥ 12 ॥
4.52.m:
shall be long-lived; but for the destruction of sin,
perform the Saptamī-snapana at a stepped reservoir to remove the taint.

4.52.s:
jātasya mṛtavatsāyāḥ saptame māsi bhūpate ..
gṛhatārābalaṃ labdhvā kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam ..13..
4.52.d:
जातस्य मृतवत्सायाः सप्तमे मासि भूपते ॥
गृहताराबलं लब्ध्वा कृत्वा ब्राह्मणवाचनम् ॥13॥
4.52.m:
For a woman whose children are stillborn, in the seventh month of the born child, O king,
having obtained the favourable strength of planetary houses and stars, and having brāhmaṇas recite blessings,

4.52.s:
bālasya janmanakṣatraṃ varjayettāṃ tithiṃ budhaḥ ..
sadvṛddhāturagāṇāṃ tu kṛtaṃ syāditi teṣu ca ..14..
4.52.d:
बालस्य जन्मनक्षत्रं वर्जयेत्तां तिथिं बुधः ॥
सद्वृद्धातुरगाणां तु कृतं स्यादिति तेषु च ॥14॥
4.52.m:
a wise person should avoid the birth-star and that lunar day of the child;
and it may be performed for those who are truly elderly, afflicted, or infirm.

4.52.s:
gomayenopaliptāyāṃ bhūmāvekāgracittavān ..
taṃḍulai raktaśāleyairvaruṇākṣīrasaṃyutam ..15..
4.52.d:
गोमयेनोपलिप्तायां भूमावेकाग्रचित्तवान् ॥
तंडुलै रक्तशालेयैर्वरुणाक्षीरसंयुतम् ॥15॥
4.52.m:
On ground smeared with cow dung, having a single-pointed mind,
with red śāli grains, accompanied by Varuṇa's water and milk,

4.52.s:
nirvapetsūryamudgābhyāṃ mātṛbhyopi vidhānataḥ ..
kīrtayetsūryadaivatyaṃ saptārciṣi ghṛtāhutīḥ ..16..
4.52.d:
निर्वपेत्सूर्यमुद्गाभ्यां मातृभ्योपि विधानतः ॥
कीर्तयेत्सूर्यदैवत्यं सप्तार्चिषि घृताहुतीः ॥16॥
4.52.m:
one should offer portions to the Sun and the bean-grains, and to the mothers according to the rule;
one should recite [the hymns] to the Sun deity, and offer oblations of clarified butter into the seven-flamed fire.

4.52.s:
juhuyādrudrasūktena tadvadrudrāya bhārata ..
hotavyāḥ samidhaścātra tatra vārkapalāśajāḥ ..17..
4.52.d:
जुहुयाद्रुद्रसूक्तेन तद्वद्रुद्राय भारत ॥
होतव्याः समिधश्चात्र तत्र वार्कपलाशजाः ॥17॥
4.52.m:
One should make oblations with the Rudrasūkta likewise unto Rudra, O Bhārata;
and sacrificial sticks of arka and palāśa should be offered here.

4.52.s:
yavakṛṣṇatilairhomaḥ kartavyoṣṭaśataṃ punaḥ ..
hutvā snānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ madhye gāṃgena dhīmatā .. 18 ..
4.52.d:
यवकृष्णतिलैर्होमः कर्तव्योष्टशतं पुनः ॥
हुत्वा स्नानं च कर्तव्यं मध्ये गांगेन धीमता ॥ 18 ॥
4.52.m:
Furthermore, a homa should be performed one hundred and eight times with barley and black sesame seeds.
Having sacrificed, a bath should be performed in the middle with water from the Gaṅgā by the wise man,

4.52.s:
vipreṇa vedaviduṣā vidhivaddarbhapāṇinā ..
sthāpayitvā catuṣkoṇe catuṣkuṃbhānpraśobhanān .. 19 ..
4.52.d:
विप्रेण वेदविदुषा विधिवद्दर्भपाणिना ॥
स्थापयित्वा चतुष्कोणे चतुष्कुंभान्प्रशोभनान् ॥ 19 ॥
4.52.m:
through a brāhmaṇa who knows the Veda, according to rule, with darbha-grass in his hand,
having established four splendid water-jars in the four corners.

4.52.s:
pañcamaṃ ca punarmadhye cākṣatena vibhūṣitam ..
sthāpayeddarpaṇākrāṃtaṃ saptarṣiṇābhimaṃtritam .. 4.52.20 ..
4.52.d:
पञ्चमं च पुनर्मध्ये चाक्षतेन विभूषितम् ॥
स्थापयेद्दर्पणाक्रांतं सप्तर्षिणाभिमंत्रितम् ॥ 4.52.20 ॥
4.52.m: And in the middle he should place a fifth [pot], adorned with unbroken rice, / covered with a mirror, and consecrated with the Saptarṣi mantra,

4.52.s:
saureṇa tīrthatoyena pūrṇacandramalānvitam ..
sarvānsarvauṣadhiyutānpañcabhaṃgajalānvitān .. 21 ..
4.52.d:
सौरेण तीर्थतोयेन पूर्णचन्द्रमलान्वितम् ॥
सर्वान्सर्वौषधियुतान्पञ्चभंगजलान्वितान् ॥ 21 ॥
4.52.m: Filled with sacred water of the sun, clear as the full moon. / All [the pots] should contain all herbs and water from five sprouts,

4.52.s:
paṃcaratnaphalairyuktāñchākhābhirapi veṣṭitān ..
gajāśvarathyārājadvārvalmīkāddhradagokulāt .. 22 ..
4.52.d:
पंचरत्नफलैर्युक्ताञ्छाखाभिरपि वेष्टितान् ॥
गजाश्वरथ्याराजद्वार्वल्मीकाद्ध्रदगोकुलात् ॥ 22 ॥
4.52.m: Supplied with the five jewels and fruits, and entwined with branches. / Having brought very pure soil from an elephant, a horse, a chariot road, a king's gate,

4.52.s:
suśuddhāṃ mṛdamānīya sarveṣveva vinikṣipet ..
caturṣvapi ca kuṃbheṣu ratnagarbheṣu madhyamam .. 23 ..
4.52.d:
सुशुद्धां मृदमानीय सर्वेष्वेव विनिक्षिपेत् ॥
चतुर्ष्वपि च कुंभेषु रत्नगर्भेषु मध्यमम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.52.m: An anthill, a deep pool, and a cow-pen, he should throw it into all of them. / Into all four pots containing jewels, and having taken the central one,

4.52.s:
gṛhītvā brāhmaṇaṃ cātra saurānmantrānudīrayet ..
nārībhiḥ saptasaṃkhyābhī rathāṅgāṅābhiratra ca .. 24 ..
4.52.d:
गृहीत्वा ब्राह्मणं चात्र सौरान्मन्त्रानुदीरयेत् ॥
नारीभिः सप्तसंख्याभी रथाङ्गाङाभिरत्र च ॥ 24 ॥
4.52.m: A brāhmaṇa should utter solar mantras over it. / And here, by seven women whose limbs are like the cakravāka bird,

4.52.s:
bhojitābhiryathāśakti mālyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
saviprābhiśca kartavyaṃ mṛtavatsābhiṣecanam.. 25 ..
4.52.d:
भोजिताभिर्यथाशक्ति माल्यवस्त्रविभूषणैः ॥
सविप्राभिश्च कर्तव्यं मृतवत्साभिषेचनम्॥ 25 ॥
4.52.m: Fed according to one's means, [adorned] with garlands, garments, and ornaments, / accompanied by brāhmaṇas, the consecration of the woman whose children have died should be performed:

4.52.s:
dīrghāyurastu bālo'yaṃ jīvaputrā ca bhāvinī ..
ādityacandramāsārdhaṃ grahanakṣatramaṇḍalam .. 26 ..
4.52.d:
दीर्घायुरस्तु बालोऽयं जीवपुत्रा च भाविनी ॥
आदित्यचन्द्रमासार्धं ग्रहनक्षत्रमण्डलम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.52.m: "May this boy be long-lived, and may this noble woman have living sons! / The sun, the moon, half a month, the sphere of planets and asterisms,

4.52.s:
śakraḥ salokapālo vai brahmā viṣṇurmaheśvaraḥ ..
ete cānye ca vai devāḥ sadā pāṃtu kumārakam .. 27 ..
4.52.d:
शक्रः सलोकपालो वै ब्रह्मा विष्णुर्महेश्वरः ॥
एते चान्ये च वै देवाः सदा पांतु कुमारकम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.52.m: Śakra along with the world protectors, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara— / may these and the other gods always protect the boy!

4.52.s:
māśanirmā sa hutabhuṅmā ca bālagrahā kvacit ..
pīḍāṃ kurvaṃtu bālasya mā mātṛjanakasya vai .. .. 28 ..
4.52.d:
माशनिर्मा स हुतभुङ्मा च बालग्रहा क्वचित् ॥
पीडां कुर्वंतु बालस्य मा मातृजनकस्य वै ॥ ॥ 28 ॥
4.52.m: May no lightning-bolt, may no fire, and may no infant-seizing spirits anywhere / bring torment upon the boy, nor upon his mother and father!"

4.52.s:
tataḥ śuklāmbaradharāḥ kumāraṃ patisaṃyutāḥ ..
saptakaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā puṣpairgandhaiḥ phalaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 29 ..
4.52.d:
ततः शुक्लाम्बरधराः कुमारं पतिसंयुताः ॥
सप्तकं पूजयेद्भक्त्या पुष्पैर्गन्धैः फलैः शुभैः ॥ 29 ॥
4.52.m: Then, clad in white garments and accompanied by their husbands, / with devotion they should worship the boy, the group of seven, with flowers, perfumes, and auspicious fruits.

4.52.s:
kāñcanīṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā tilapātropari sthitām ..
pratimāṃ dharmarājasya gurave vinivedayet .. 4.52.30 ..
4.52.d:
काञ्चनीं च ततः कृत्वा तिलपात्रोपरि स्थिताम् ॥
प्रतिमां धर्मराजस्य गुरवे विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 4.52.30 ॥
4.52.m: And then, having made a golden image of Dharmarāja / placed on a vessel of sesamum, he should present it to the preceptor.

4.52.s:
vastrakāñcanaratnaughairbhakṣyaiḥ saghṛtapāyasaiḥ ..
pūjayedbrāhmaṇāstadvadvittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet ..
bhuktvā ca guruṇā ceyamuccāryā maṃtrasaṃtatiḥ .. 31 ..
4.52.d:
वस्त्रकाञ्चनरत्नौघैर्भक्ष्यैः सघृतपायसैः ॥
पूजयेद्ब्राह्मणास्तद्वद्वित्तशाठ्यं विवर्जयेत् ॥
भुक्त्वा च गुरुणा चेयमुच्चार्या मंत्रसंततिः ॥ 31 ॥
4.52.m: He should likewise worship the brāhmaṇas with masses of garments, gold, and jewels, / and with foods accompanied by clarified butter and milk-rice, avoiding all deceit regarding wealth. / And after eating, this continuous series of mantras should be recited by the preceptor:

4.52.s:
dīrghāyurastu bālo'yaṃ yāvadvarṣaśataṃ sukhī ..
yatkiñcidasya duritaṃ tatkṣiptaṃ vaḍa vāmukhe .. 32 ..
4.52.d:
दीर्घायुरस्तु बालोऽयं यावद्वर्षशतं सुखी ॥
यत्किञ्चिदस्य दुरितं तत्क्षिप्तं वड वामुखे ॥ 32 ॥
4.52.m: "May this boy be long-lived and happy for up to a hundred years! / Whatever misfortune he may have, that is cast into the Submarine Fire!

4.52.s:
brahmā rudro viṣṇuḥ skando vāyuḥ śakro hutāśanaḥ ..
rakṣaṃtu sarve duṣṭebhyo varadā yāṃtu sarvadā ..33..
4.52.d:
ब्रह्मा रुद्रो विष्णुः स्कन्दो वायुः शक्रो हुताशनः ॥
रक्षंतु सर्वे दुष्टेभ्यो वरदा यांतु सर्वदा ॥33॥
4.52.m: May Brahmā, Rudra, Viṣṇu, Skanda, Vāyu, Śakra, and the Fire-God / protect [him] from all wicked beings, and, as givers of boons, always attend [him]!"

4.52.s:
evamādīni cānyāni vadataḥ pūjayedgurūn ..
śaktitaḥ kapilāṃ dattvā praṇipatya visarjayet ..34..
4.52.d:
एवमादीनि चान्यानि वदतः पूजयेद्गुरून् ॥
शक्तितः कपिलां दत्त्वा प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् ॥34॥
4.52.m: He should worship the preceptors while they speak these and other [blessings]. / Having given a tawny cow according to his ability, he should bow down and bid them farewell.

4.52.s:
caruṃ ca putrasahitā praṇamya raviśaṃkarau ..
hutaśeṣaṃ tadānīyādādityāya namo'stu te .. 35 ..
4.52.d:
चरुं च पुत्रसहिता प्रणम्य रविशंकरौ ॥
हुतशेषं तदानीयादादित्याय नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 35 ॥
4.52.m: Together with her son, having bowed to the Sun and Śaṅkara, / she should take the oblation that remains from the offering: "Homage be to you, O Sun!"

4.52.s:
ayamevādbhutaṃ yogo hyadbhuteṣu ca śasyate ..
karturjanmani vṛkṣāṇāṃ devāntsaṃpūjayettadā ..
śāṃtyarthaṃ śuklasaptamyāmetatkurvanna sīdati .. 36 ..
4.52.d:
अयमेवाद्भुतं योगो ह्यद्भुतेषु च शस्यते ॥
कर्तुर्जन्मनि वृक्षाणां देवान्त्संपूजयेत्तदा ॥
शांत्यर्थं शुक्लसप्तम्यामेतत्कुर्वन्न सीदति ॥ 36 ॥
4.52.m: This is an extraordinary conjunction, and it is praised during portentous portents. / At the birth of the performer, he should then worship the gods of the trees. / Performing this for the sake of pacification on the bright seventh lunar day, one does not suffer.

4.52.s:
puṇyaṃ pavitramāyuṣyaṃ saptamīsnapanaṃ raviḥ ..
kathayitvā naraśreṣṭha tatraivāṃtaradhīyata .. 37 ..
4.52.d:
पुण्यं पवित्रमायुष्यं सप्तमीस्नपनं रविः ॥
कथयित्वा नरश्रेष्ठ तत्रैवांतरधीयत ॥ 37 ॥
4.52.m: Having spoken of this bath on the seventh lunar day, which is meritorious, purifying, and conducive to long life, / O best of men, the Sun vanished right there.

4.52.s:
sa cānena vidhānena kārtavīryo'rjuno nṛpaḥ ..
saṃvatsarāṇāmayutaṃ śaśāsa pṛthivīmimām ..38..
4.52.d:
स चानेन विधानेन कार्तवीर्योऽर्जुनो नृपः ॥
संवत्सराणामयुतं शशास पृथिवीमिमाम् ॥38॥
4.52.m: And by this rite, King Arjuna, the son of Kṛtavīrya, / ruled over this earth for ten thousand years.

4.52.s:
ārogyaṃ bhāskārādiccheddhanamiccheddhutāśanāt ..
śaṃkarājjñānamicchettu gatimicchejjanārdanāt .. .. 39 ..
4.52.d:
आरोग्यं भास्कारादिच्छेद्धनमिच्छेद्धुताशनात् ॥
शंकराज्ज्ञानमिच्छेत्तु गतिमिच्छेज्जनार्दनात् ॥ ॥ 39 ॥
4.52.m: One should desire health from the Sun, wealth from the Fire-God, / knowledge from Śaṅkara, and salvation from Janārdana.

4.52.s:
etanmahāpātakanāśanaṃ syādapyakṣayaṃ vedavidaḥ paṭhaṃti ..
śṛṇoti yaścainamananyacetāstasyāpi siddhiṃ munayo vadaṃti .. 4.52.40 ..
acalāsaptamīvratavarṇanam
4.52.d:
एतन्महापातकनाशनं स्यादप्यक्षयं वेदविदः पठंति ॥
शृणोति यश्चैनमनन्यचेतास्तस्यापि सिद्धिं मुनयो वदंति ॥ 4.52.40 ॥
अचलासप्तमीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.52.m:
Those who know the Veda declare that this destroys the great sins and is imperishable; / and the sages say that even he who listens to it with undivided mind attains perfection.
Description of the Votive Observance of Acalāsaptamī

4.53.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ..
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa supakvenāpi kiṃ phalam ..
māghasnānavihīnena yattyaktaṃ yadunandana .. 1 ..
4.53.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥
अध्रुवेण शरीरेण सुपक्वेनापि किं फलम् ॥
माघस्नानविहीनेन यत्त्यक्तं यदुनन्दन ॥ 1 ॥
4.53.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / What is the use of this unstable body, even when fully ripened, / if it is abandoned without the bath in Māgha, O delight of the Yadus?

4.53.s:
prātaḥsnānāsamarthānāṃ śarīraṃ paśya dehinām ..
kiṃ tena vada kartavyaṃ māghe saṃsārabhīruṇā .. 2 ..
4.53.d:
प्रातःस्नानासमर्थानां शरीरं पश्य देहिनाम् ॥
किं तेन वद कर्तव्यं माघे संसारभीरुणा ॥ 2 ॥
4.53.m: Look at the body of embodied beings who are unable to take the morning bath: / tell me, what should be done in Māgha by one who fears worldly existence?

4.53.s:
kāyakleśasahā nāryo na bhavaṃti yadūttama ..
saukumāryaṃ śarīrasya acalatvāttathaiva ca .. 3 ..
4.53.d:
कायक्लेशसहा नार्यो न भवंति यदूत्तम ॥
सौकुमार्यं शरीरस्य अचलत्वात्तथैव च ॥ 3 ॥
4.53.m: Women are not capable of enduring physical affliction, O best of the Yadus, / because of the tenderness of their bodies and likewise on account of frailty.

4.53.s:
kathaṃ ca tāḥ surūpāḥ syuḥ subhagāḥ suprajāstathā ..
sukṛtasyeha puṇyasya sarvametatphalaṃ yataḥ .. 4 ..
4.53.d:
कथं च ताः सुरूपाः स्युः सुभगाः सुप्रजास्तथा ॥
सुकृतस्येह पुण्यस्य सर्वमेतत्फलं यतः ॥ 4 ॥
4.53.m: And how may they become beautiful, fortunate, and blessed with good offspring? / For all this is the fruit of well-performed meritorious deeds in this world.

4.53.s:
alpāyāsena sumahadyena puṇyamavāpyate ..
strībhirmāghe mama brūhi snānaṃ tattvaṃ ramādhava ..5..
4.53.d:
अल्पायासेन सुमहद्येन पुण्यमवाप्यते ॥
स्त्रीभिर्माघे मम ब्रूहि स्नानं तत्त्वं रमाधव ॥5॥
4.53.m: Tell me, O Lord of Ramā, the true nature of that bath in Māgha for women / by which very great merit is attained with little exertion.

4.53.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śrūyatāṃ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha rahasyamṛṣibhāṣitam..
yanmayā kasyacinnoktamacalāsaptamīvratam .. .. 6 ..
4.53.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
श्रूयतां पांडवश्रेष्ठ रहस्यमृषिभाषितम्॥
यन्मया कस्यचिन्नोक्तमचलासप्तमीव्रतम् ॥ ॥ 6 ॥
4.53.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Listen, O best of the Pāṇḍavas, to the secret spoken by the sages, / which I have not revealed to anyone: the votive observance of Acalāsaptamī.

4.53.s:
veśyā cendumatī nāma rūpaudāryaguṇānvitā ..
āsītkurukulaśreṣṭha magadhasya vilāsinī .. 7 ..
4.53.d:
वेश्या चेन्दुमती नाम रूपौदार्यगुणान्विता ॥
आसीत्कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ मगधस्य विलासिनी ॥ 7 ॥
4.53.m: O best of the Kuru lineage, there was a courtesan named Indumatī, / endowed with beauty, nobility, and virtues, a charming woman of Magadha,

4.53.s:
tanumadhyā sujaghanā pīnonnatapayodharā ..
samyagvibhaktāvayavā pūrṇacandranibhānanā .. 8 ..
4.53.d:
तनुमध्या सुजघना पीनोन्नतपयोधरा ॥
सम्यग्विभक्तावयवा पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना ॥ 8 ॥
4.53.m: Slender-waisted, with lovely hips, and full, prominent breasts, / with well-proportioned limbs and a face like the full moon.

4.53.s:
sauṃdaryaṃ saukumāryaṃ ca tasyāḥ kāmena gīyate ..
yasyāḥ saṃdarśanādeva kāmaḥ kāmāturo bhavet ..9..
4.53.d:
सौंदर्यं सौकुमार्यं च तस्याः कामेन गीयते ॥
यस्याः संदर्शनादेव कामः कामातुरो भवेत् ॥9॥
4.53.m: Her beauty and tenderness were sung of by Kāma himself, / at the mere sight of whom even Kāma would become afflicted with passion.

4.53.s:
mūrtiḥ śaśadharasyeva nayanānandakāriṇī ..
vaśīkaraṇavidyeva sarvalokamanoharā .. 4.53.10 ..
4.53.d:
मूर्तिः शशधरस्येव नयनानन्दकारिणी ॥
वशीकरणविद्येव सर्वलोकमनोहरा ॥ 4.53.10 ॥
4.53.m: She was like the visible form of the moon, bringing joy to the eyes, / delightful to all the world like the art of fascination.

4.53.s:
ekasmindivase prātaḥ sumukhasthitayā tayā ..
ciṃtitā hṛdaye rājantsaṃsārasyānavasthitiḥ .. 11 ..
4.53.d:
एकस्मिन्दिवसे प्रातः सुमुखस्थितया तया ॥
चिंतिता हृदये राजन्त्संसारस्यानवस्थितिः ॥ 11 ॥
4.53.m: One day at dawn, sitting in comfort, / the instability of worldly existence was contemplated in her heart, O king:

4.53.s:
sannimajya jagadidaṃ viṣaye kāyasāgare ..
janmamṛtyujarāgrāhaṃ na kaścidavabuddhyate .. 13 ..
4.53.d:
सन्निमज्य जगदिदं विषये कायसागरे ॥
जन्ममृत्युजराग्राहं न कश्चिदवबुद्ध्यते ॥ 13 ॥
4.53.m: "This world is deeply sunk in the ocean of the body, in sense objects; / seized by the sea-monster of birth, death, and old age, no one understands.

4.53.s:
apāko bhūtabhāṇḍānāṃ dhātṛśilpivinirmitam ..
svakarmeṃdhanasaṃvītaṃ pacyate bālavahninā .. 13 ..
4.53.d:
अपाको भूतभाण्डानां धातृशिल्पिविनिर्मितम् ॥
स्वकर्मेंधनसंवीतं पच्यते बालवह्निना ॥ 13 ॥
4.53.m: The unbaked clay-vessels of the elements, fashioned by the Creator-artisan, / wrapped in the fuel of their own deeds, are cooked by the fire of time.

4.53.s:
ye yāṃti divasāḥ puṃsāṃ dharmakāmārthavarjitāḥ ..
na te punarihāyāṃti harabhaktā narā yathā .. 14 ..
4.53.d:
ये यांति दिवसाः पुंसां धर्मकामार्थवर्जिताः ॥
न ते पुनरिहायांति हरभक्ता नरा यथा ॥ 14 ॥
4.53.m: The days of men that pass devoid of righteousness, pleasure, and wealth— / they do not return here, just as men devoted to Hara [do not return to saṃsāra].

4.53.s:
snānaṃ dānaṃ tapo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam ..
yasmindine na kriyate vṛthā sa divaso nṛṇām .. .. 15 ..
4.53.d:
स्नानं दानं तपो होमः स्वाध्यायः पितृतर्पणम् ॥
यस्मिन्दिने न क्रियते वृथा स दिवसो नृणाम् ॥ ॥ 15 ॥
4.53.m: Bathing, giving, austerity, fire offering, sacred recitation, and libation to the ancestors— / the day on which these are not performed is in vain for mortals.

4.53.s:
putrāṇāṃ dāragṛhakasamāsaktaṃ hi mānasam..
vṛkīvoraṇamāsādya mṛtyurdvārāya gacchati .. 16 ..
4.53.d:
पुत्राणां दारगृहकसमासक्तं हि मानसम्॥
वृकीवोरणमासाद्य मृत्युर्द्वाराय गच्छति ॥ 16 ॥
4.53.m: The mind is truly attached to sons, wives, and dwellings; / [then] death approaches the door, as a female wolf approaches a lamb."

4.53.s:
ityevaṃ ciṃtayitvā tu veśyā cendumatī tataḥ..
vaśiṣṭhasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ jagāma gajagāminī .. 17 ..
4.53.d:
इत्येवं चिंतयित्वा तु वेश्या चेन्दुमती ततः॥
वशिष्ठस्याश्रमं पुण्यं जगाम गजगामिनी ॥ 17 ॥
4.53.m: Having thus reflected, the courtesan Indumatī, / walking with the gait of an elephant, then went to the holy hermitage of Vasiṣṭha.

4.53.s:
vaśiṣṭhamṛṣimāsīnaṃ praṇamya vinayāttataḥ ..
kṛtāñjalipuṭā bhūtvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 1- ..
.. indumatyuvāca ..
daśasūnāsamaścakrī daśacakrisamo dhvajaḥ ..
daśadhvajasamā veśyā daśaveśyāsamo nṛpaḥ ..19..
4.53.d:
वशिष्ठमृषिमासीनं प्रणम्य विनयात्ततः ॥
कृताञ्जलिपुटा भूत्वा इदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥ 1- ॥
॥ इन्दुमत्युवाच ॥
दशसूनासमश्चक्री दशचक्रिसमो ध्वजः ॥
दशध्वजसमा वेश्या दशवेश्यासमो नृपः ॥19॥
4.53.m: Having bowed in humility to the seated sage Vasiṣṭha, / she folded her hands in reverence and spoke this word: / Indumatī said: / An oilman equals ten slaughter-houses; a tavern equals ten oilmen; / a courtesan equals ten taverns; and a king equals ten courtesans.

4.53.s:
mayā na dattaṃ na hutaṃ nopavāso vrataṃ kṛtam ..
bhaktyā na pūjitaḥ śambhuḥ śrito naiko dhanī naraḥ .. 4.53.20 ..
4.53.d:
मया न दत्तं न हुतं नोपवासो व्रतं कृतम् ॥
भक्त्या न पूजितः शम्भुः श्रितो नैको धनी नरः ॥ 4.53.20 ॥
4.53.m: I have not given gifts, nor offered oblations, nor observed fasts and votive observances; / I have not worshipped Śambhu with devotion, nor have I relied on one wealthy man [alone].

4.53.s:
sāṃprataṃ vartamānāyā vrataṃ kiṃcidvadasva me ..
yena duḥkhāṃbupāpaughāduttarāmi bhavārṇavāt .. 21 ..
4.53.d:
सांप्रतं वर्तमानाया व्रतं किंचिद्वदस्व मे ॥
येन दुःखांबुपापौघादुत्तरामि भवार्णवात् ॥ 21 ॥
4.53.m: Tell me of some votive observance for one who lives as I do now, / by which I may cross over the ocean of existence, away from the flood of sin and sorrowful waters.

4.53.s:
etadasyāḥ subahuśaḥ śrutvā dharmaṃ paraṃtapaḥ ..
vaśiṣṭhaḥ kathayāmāsa mahākāruṇiko muniḥ .. 22 ..
4.53.d:
एतदस्याः सुबहुशः श्रुत्वा धर्मं परंतपः ॥
वशिष्ठः कथयामास महाकारुणिको मुनिः ॥ 22 ॥
4.53.m: Having heard this repeatedly from her, the scorcher of foes, / the sage Vaśiṣṭha, exceedingly compassionate, expounded her duty:

4.53.s:
.. vaśiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
māghasya sitasaptamyāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ..
tapaḥsaubhāgyajananaṃ snānaṃ tava varānane ..23..
4.53.d:
॥ वशिष्ठ उवाच ॥ ॥
माघस्य सितसप्तम्यां सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ॥
तपःसौभाग्यजननं स्नानं तव वरानने ॥23॥
4.53.m: Vaśiṣṭha said: / On the bright seventh lunar day of Māgha, granting the fruits of all desires, / is a bath that produces austerity and good fortune for you, O fair-faced lady.

4.53.s:
kṛtvā ṣaṣṭhyāmekabhaktaṃ saptamyāṃ niścalaṃ jalam ..
rātryaṃte cālayethāstvaṃ dattvā śirasi dīpakam.. 24 ..
4.53.d:
कृत्वा षष्ठ्यामेकभक्तं सप्तम्यां निश्चलं जलम् ॥
रात्र्यंते चालयेथास्त्वं दत्त्वा शिरसि दीपकम्॥ 24 ॥
4.53.m: Having taken a single meal on the sixth lunar day, on the seventh, while the water is motionless / at the end of night, you should stir it after placing a lamp on your head.

4.53.s:
māghasya sitasaptamyāmacalaṃ cālitaṃ mayā ..
jalāmalānāṃ sarveṣāṃ kṛtaṃ na calanaṃ tathā .. 25 ..
4.53.d:
माघस्य सितसप्तम्यामचलं चालितं मया ॥
जलामलानां सर्वेषां कृतं न चलनं तथा ॥ 25 ॥
4.53.m: [Reciting:] 'On the bright seventh lunar day of Māgha, the still water was stirred by me; / likewise, no agitation has been caused to any of the pure waters.'

4.53.s:
vaśiṣṭhavacanaṃ śrutvā tasminnahani bhūpate ..
sarvaṃ cakārendumatī snānaṃ dānaṃ yathāvidhi .. 26 ..
4.53.d:
वशिष्ठवचनं श्रुत्वा तस्मिन्नहनि भूपते ॥
सर्वं चकारेन्दुमती स्नानं दानं यथाविधि ॥ 26 ॥
4.53.m: Having heard Vaśiṣṭha's words, on that day, O king, / Indumatī performed everything—bath and gift—according to the rule.

4.53.s:
tryahasnānaprabhāveṇa bhuktvā bhogyānyathepsitān ..
indralokepsaraḥsaṃghe nāyikātvamavāpa sā .. 27..
4.53.d:
त्र्यहस्नानप्रभावेण भुक्त्वा भोग्यान्यथेप्सितान् ॥
इन्द्रलोकेप्सरःसंघे नायिकात्वमवाप सा ॥ 27॥
4.53.m: By the power of the three-day bath, having enjoyed desired pleasures, / she attained leadership among the host of apsarases in the world of Indra.

4.53.s:
acalāsaptamīsnānaṃ kathitaṃ ca viśāṃpate ..
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sukhasaubhāgyavarddhanam .. 28 ..
4.53.d:
अचलासप्तमीस्नानं कथितं च विशांपते ॥
सर्वपापप्रशमनं सुखसौभाग्यवर्द्धनम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.53.m: Thus the bath of Acalāsaptamī has been spoken of, O lord of the earth, / pacifying all sins and increasing happiness and good fortune.

4.53.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ..
saptamīsnānamāhātmyaṃ śrutaṃ na ca viśeṣataḥ ..
sāṃprataṃ śrotumicchāmi vidhimaṃtrasamanvitam ..29..
4.53.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥
सप्तमीस्नानमाहात्म्यं श्रुतं न च विशेषतः ॥
सांप्रतं श्रोतुमिच्छामि विधिमंत्रसमन्वितम् ॥29॥
4.53.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / The greatness of the seventh-day bath has not been heard in detail; / I now wish to hear it along with its ritual and mantras.

4.53.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ekabhaktena saṃtiṣṭhetṣaṣṭhyāṃ saṃpūjya bhāskaram ..
saptamyāṃ tu vrajetprātaḥ sugaṃbhīraṃ jalāśayam .. 4.53.30 ..
4.53.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
एकभक्तेन संतिष्ठेत्षष्ठ्यां संपूज्य भास्करम् ॥
सप्तम्यां तु व्रजेत्प्रातः सुगंभीरं जलाशयम् ॥ 4.53.30 ॥
4.53.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / One should remain on a single meal on the sixth lunar day, having worshipped the Sun; / on the seventh lunar day, in the morning, one should go to a very deep body of water,

4.53.s:
saritsaṃgaṃ taḍāgaṃ ca devakhātamathāpi vā ..
sukhāvagāhasalilaṃ duṣṭasattvairadūṣitam .. 31..
4.53.d:
सरित्संगं तडागं च देवखातमथापि वा ॥
सुखावगाहसलिलं दुष्टसत्त्वैरदूषितम् ॥ 31॥
4.53.m: a river confluence, a reservoir, or an artificial pool made by the gods, / having water pleasant for plunging and untainted by malicious creatures.

4.53.s:
paśubhiḥ pakṣibhiścaiva jalajairmatsyakacchapaiḥ ..
na jalaṃ cālyate yāvattāvatsnānaṃ samācaret ..32..
4.53.d:
पशुभिः पक्षिभिश्चैव जलजैर्मत्स्यकच्छपैः ॥
न जलं चाल्यते यावत्तावत्स्नानं समाचरेत् ॥32॥
4.53.m: Before the water is stirred by beasts, birds, / or aquatic creatures such as fish and tortoises, one should perform the bath.

4.53.s:
namaste rudrarūpāya rasānāṃ pataye namaḥ ..
varuṇāya namaste'stu harivāsa namo'stu te .. 33 ..
4.53.d:
नमस्ते रुद्ररूपाय रसानां पतये नमः ॥
वरुणाय नमस्तेऽस्तु हरिवास नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 33 ॥
4.53.m: [Saying:] 'Homage to you who have the form of Rudra! Homage to the lord of waters! / Homage to Varuṇa! Homage to you, O abode of Hari!'

4.53.s:
yāvajjanma kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ mayā janmasu saptasu ..
tanme rogaṃ ca śokaṃ ca mākarī haṃtu saptamī .. 34 ..
4.53.d:
यावज्जन्म कृतं पापं मया जन्मसु सप्तसु ॥
तन्मे रोगं च शोकं च माकरी हंतु सप्तमी ॥ 34 ॥
4.53.m: 'Whatever sin has been committed by me in life throughout seven births, / may the seventh lunar day of Makara destroy that, along with my disease and sorrow.'

4.53.s:
jananī sarvabhūtānāṃ saptamī saptasaptike ..
sarvavyādhihare devi namaste ravimaṃḍale .. 35 ..
4.53.d:
जननी सर्वभूतानां सप्तमी सप्तसप्तिके ॥
सर्वव्याधिहरे देवि नमस्ते रविमंडले ॥ 35 ॥
4.53.m: 'O mother of all beings, O seventh lunar day, O rider of seven steeds, / O goddess who removes all afflictions, homage to you in the disc of the sun!'

4.53.s:
jaloparitaraṃ dīpaṃ snātvā saṃtarpya devatāḥ ..
caṃdanena likhetpadmamaṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam ..36..
4.53.d:
जलोपरितरं दीपं स्नात्वा संतर्प्य देवताः ॥
चंदनेन लिखेत्पद्ममष्टपत्रं सकर्णिकम् ॥36॥
4.53.m: Having bathed, floating a lamp on top of the water and gratifying the deities, / one should draw with sandalwood an eight-petalled lotus with a pericarp.

4.53.s:
madhye śarvaṃ sapatnīkaṃ praṇavena tu pūjayet ..
bhānuṃ śakre dale pūjya raviṃ vaiśvānare dale..37..
4.53.d:
मध्ये शर्वं सपत्नीकं प्रणवेन तु पूजयेत् ॥
भानुं शक्रे दले पूज्य रविं वैश्वानरे दले॥37॥
4.53.m: In the center one should worship Śarva along with his wife using the Praṇava; / having worshipped Bhānu on Indra's petal, and Ravi on Agni's petal,

4.53.s:
yāmye vivasvānnairṛtye bhāskarasyeti pūjayet ..
paścime savitā pūjyaḥ pūjyorko vāyunā jale ..38..
4.53.d:
याम्ये विवस्वान्नैरृत्ये भास्करस्येति पूजयेत् ॥
पश्चिमे सविता पूज्यः पूज्योर्को वायुना जले ॥38॥
4.53.m: Vivasvat in the south, and one should worship [saying] 'To Bhāskara' in the southwest; / in the west Savitṛ should be worshipped, and Arka in the wind's quarter on the water;

4.53.s:
saumye sahasrakiraṇaḥ śeṣe sarvātmaneti ca ..
pūjyāḥ praṇavapūrvāstu namaskārāṃtayojitāḥ ..39..
4.53.d:
सौम्ये सहस्रकिरणः शेषे सर्वात्मनेति च ॥
पूज्याः प्रणवपूर्वास्तु नमस्कारांतयोजिताः ॥39॥
4.53.m: in the north Sahasrakiraṇa, and on the remaining [petal] as 'the Soul of All'; / they should be worshipped preceded by the Praṇava and ending with 'namas'.

4.53.s:
puṣpaiḥ sugandhadhūpaiśca vastreṇācchādya bhāskaram..
visarjayettataḥ paścātsvasthānaṃ gamyatāmiti .. 4.53.40 ..
4.53.d:
पुष्पैः सुगन्धधूपैश्च वस्त्रेणाच्छाद्य भास्करम्॥
विसर्जयेत्ततः पश्चात्स्वस्थानं गम्यतामिति ॥ 4.53.40 ॥
4.53.m: Having covered the Sun with flowers, fragrant incense, and a cloth, / one should afterwards dismiss him, saying: 'Go to your own abode.'

4.53.s:
tāmrapātre suvistīrṇe mṛnmaye vā yudhiṣṭhira ..
sthāpayettilacūrṇaṃ ca saghṛtaṃ saguḍaṃ tathā .. 41 ..
4.53.d:
ताम्रपात्रे सुविस्तीर्णे मृन्मये वा युधिष्ठिर ॥
स्थापयेत्तिलचूर्णं च सघृतं सगुडं तथा ॥ 41 ॥
4.53.m: In a very broad copper vessel or in an earthen one, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / one should place sesame powder along with ghee and jaggery.

4.53.s:
kāñcanaṃ tālakaṃ kṛtvā hyasiktastilacūrṇakam ..
saṃsthāpya raktavastraistu puṣpairdhūpaistathārcayet .. 42 ..
4.53.d:
काञ्चनं तालकं कृत्वा ह्यसिक्तस्तिलचूर्णकम् ॥
संस्थाप्य रक्तवस्त्रैस्तु पुष्पैर्धूपैस्तथार्चयेत् ॥ 42 ॥
4.53.m: Having made a golden lock, unmoistened sesame powder / having been placed, one should worship with red clothes, flowers, and incenses.

4.53.s:
tatastaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyāddattvā maṃtreṇa tālakam ..
ādityasya prasādena prātaḥ snānaphalaṃ bhajet .. 43 ..
4.53.d:
ततस्तं ब्राह्मणे दद्याद्दत्त्वा मंत्रेण तालकम् ॥
आदित्यस्य प्रसादेन प्रातः स्नानफलं भजेत् ॥ 43 ॥
4.53.m: Then one should give it to a brāhmaṇa, having given the lock with the mantra; / by the grace of Āditya, one partakes of the fruit of the morning bath.

4.53.s:
duṣṭadaurbhāgyaduḥkhebhyo mayā dattaṃ tu tālakam ..
tatastattālakaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāyopapādayet.. 44 ..
4.53.d:
दुष्टदौर्भाग्यदुःखेभ्यो मया दत्तं तु तालकम् ॥
ततस्तत्तालकं कृत्वा ब्राह्मणायोपपादयेत्॥ 44 ॥
4.53.m: [Saying:] 'The lock is given by me to ward off evil misfortunes and sorrows'; / then having made that lock, one should present it to a brāhmaṇa,

4.53.s:
saputrapaśubhṛtyāya me'rkoyaṃ prīyatāmiti ..
tato vratopadeṣṭāraṃ pūjayedvastragotilaiḥ .. 45 ..
4.53.d:
सपुत्रपशुभृत्याय मेऽर्कोयं प्रीयतामिति ॥
ततो व्रतोपदेष्टारं पूजयेद्वस्त्रगोतिलैः ॥ 45 ॥
4.53.m: [saying:] 'May this Sun be pleased with me, who have sons, cattle, and servants!' / Then one should worship the instructor of the votive observance with garments, cattle, and sesame.

4.53.s:
viprānanyānyathāśaktyā pūjayitvā gṛhaṃ vrajet ..
etatte kathitaṃ kāryaṃ rūpasaubhāgyakārakam .. 46 ..
4.53.d:
विप्रानन्यान्यथाशक्त्या पूजयित्वा गृहं व्रजेत् ॥
एतत्ते कथितं कार्यं रूपसौभाग्यकारकम् ॥ 46 ॥
4.53.m: Having worshipped other brāhmaṇas according to one's ability, one should return home. / This duty has been declared to you, bringing about beauty and good fortune,

4.53.s: acalāsaptamīsnānaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam .. 47 ..
4.53.d: अचलासप्तमीस्नानं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ॥ 47 ॥
4.53.m: the bath of Acalāsaptamī, bestowing the fruit of all desires.

4.53.s:
iti paṭhati ya itthaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti prasaṃgātkalikaluṣaharaṃ vai sapta mīsnānametat ..
matimapi nayanānāṃ yo dadāti prasaṃgātsurabhavanagato'sau pūjyate devasaṃghaiḥ .. 48 .. ..
budhāṣṭamīvratavarṇanam
4.53.d:
इति पठति य इत्थं यः शृणोति प्रसंगात्कलिकलुषहरं वै सप्त मीस्नानमेतत् ॥
मतिमपि नयनानां यो ददाति प्रसंगात्सुरभवनगतोऽसौ पूज्यते देवसंघैः ॥ 48 ॥ ॥
बुधाष्टमीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.53.m:
Whoever reads or hears thus in proper course this bath of the seventh lunar day that removes the taints of the Kali age, / and whoever directs the minds of people to it in proper course, goes to the abode of the gods and is worshipped by hosts of deities.
Description of the Votive Observance of Budhāṣṭamī

4.54.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
budhāṣṭamīvrataṃ bhūyo bravīmi śṛṇu pāṃḍava ..
yena cīrṇena narakaṃ naraḥ paśyati na kvacit .. 1 ..
4.54.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
बुधाष्टमीव्रतं भूयो ब्रवीमि शृणु पांडव ॥
येन चीर्णेन नरकं नरः पश्यति न क्वचित् ॥ 1 ॥
4.54.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Again I tell you of the votive observance of Budhāṣṭamī; listen, O Pāṇḍava, / by performing which a man never sees hell.

4.54.s:
purā kṛtayugasyādau ilo rājā babhūva ha ..
bahubhṛtyasuhṛnmitramaṃtribhiḥ parivāritaḥ .. 2 ..
4.54.d:
पुरा कृतयुगस्यादौ इलो राजा बभूव ह ॥
बहुभृत्यसुहृन्मित्रमंत्रिभिः परिवारितः ॥ 2 ॥
4.54.m: Long ago, at the beginning of the Kṛta age, there was a king named Ila, / surrounded by many servants, well-wishers, friends, and ministers.

4.54.s:
jagāma himavatpārśve mahādevena vāritaḥ ..
yo'nyaḥ praviśate bhūmau sā strī bhavati niścitam .. 3 ..
4.54.d:
जगाम हिमवत्पार्श्वे महादेवेन वारितः ॥
योऽन्यः प्रविशते भूमौ सा स्त्री भवति निश्चितम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.54.m: He went to the slope of the Himālaya, forbidden by Mahādeva: / 'Whatever other person enters this land certainly becomes a woman.'

4.54.s:
sa rājā mṛgasaṃgena prāviśattadumāvane ..
ekākī turagopetaḥ kṣaṇātstrītvaṃ jagāma ha .. 4 ..
4.54.d:
स राजा मृगसंगेन प्राविशत्तदुमावने ॥
एकाकी तुरगोपेतः क्षणात्स्त्रीत्वं जगाम ह ॥ 4 ॥
4.54.m: Attracted by a deer, that king entered that grove of Umā; / alone, accompanied only by his horse, in an instant he became a woman.

4.54.s:
sā babhrāma vane śūnye pīnonnatapayodharā ..
kuto'hamāgatetyevaṃ na tvabudhyata kiṃcana .. 5 ..
4.54.d:
सा बभ्राम वने शून्ये पीनोन्नतपयोधरा ॥
कुतोऽहमागतेत्येवं न त्वबुध्यत किंचन ॥ 5 ॥
4.54.m: She wandered in the empty forest, with full and high breasts, / not knowing anything at all, wondering, 'Where have I come from?'

4.54.s:
tāṃ dadarśa budhaḥ saumyāṃ rūpaudāryaguṇānvitām ..
aṣṭamyāṃ budhavāreṇa tasyāstuṣṭo budho grahaḥ .. 6 ..
4.54.d:
तां ददर्श बुधः सौम्यां रूपौदार्यगुणान्विताम् ॥
अष्टम्यां बुधवारेण तस्यास्तुष्टो बुधो ग्रहः ॥ 6 ॥
4.54.m: Budha saw her, gentle and endowed with the qualities of beauty and generosity; / on an aṣṭamī falling on a Wednesday, the planet Budha was pleased with her.

4.54.s:
dadhau garbhaṃ tadudare ilāyā rūpatoṣitaḥ ..
putramutpādayāmāsa yo'sau khyātaḥ purūravāḥ .. 7 ..
4.54.d:
दधौ गर्भं तदुदरे इलाया रूपतोषितः ॥
पुत्रमुत्पादयामास योऽसौ ख्यातः पुरूरवाः ॥ 7 ॥
4.54.m: Pleased with her beauty, he placed an embryo in the womb of Ilā; / he begot a son, who became renowned as Purūravas,

4.54.s:
caṃdravaṃśakaro rājā ādyaḥ sarvamahīkṣitām..
tataḥ prabhṛti pūjyeyamaṣṭamī budhasaṃyutā .. 8 ..
4.54.d:
चंद्रवंशकरो राजा आद्यः सर्वमहीक्षिताम्॥
ततः प्रभृति पूज्येयमष्टमी बुधसंयुता ॥ 8 ॥
4.54.m: the king who founded the Lunar Dynasty, the first of all rulers of the earth. / From that time onward, this aṣṭamī joined with a Wednesday is to be worshipped,

4.54.s:
sarvapāpapraśamanī sarvopadravanāśinī ..
athānyadapi te vacmi dharmarāja kathānakam .. 9 ..
4.54.d:
सर्वपापप्रशमनी सर्वोपद्रवनाशिनी ॥
अथान्यदपि ते वच्मि धर्मराज कथानकम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.54.m: pacifying all sins and destroying all afflictions. / Now I will tell you another story as well, O king of righteousness.

4.54.s:
āsīdrājā videhānāṃ mithilāyāṃ sa vairibhiḥ ..
saṃgrāme nihato vīrastasya bhāryā daridriṇī .. 4.54.10 ..
4.54.d:
आसीद्राजा विदेहानां मिथिलायां स वैरिभिः ॥
संग्रामे निहतो वीरस्तस्य भार्या दरिद्रिणी ॥ 4.54.10 ॥
4.54.m: There was a king of the Videhas in Mithilā; that hero was slain in battle / by enemies, and his wife, reduced to poverty,

4.54.s:
ūrmilā nāma babhrāma mahīṃ bālakasaṃyutā ..
avaṃtī viṣayaṃ prāptā brāhmaṇasya niveśane .. 11 ..
4.54.d:
ऊर्मिला नाम बभ्राम महीं बालकसंयुता ॥
अवंती विषयं प्राप्ता ब्राह्मणस्य निवेशने ॥ 11 ॥
4.54.m: named Ūrmilā, wandered the earth together with her children; / having arrived in the region of Avantī, at the house of a brāhmaṇa,

4.54.s:
cakārodarapūrtyarthaṃ nityaṃ kaṃḍanapeṣaṇe ..
hṛtvā sā stokagodhūmāndadau bālakayostadā .. 12 ..
4.54.d:
चकारोदरपूर्त्यर्थं नित्यं कंडनपेषणे ॥
हृत्वा सा स्तोकगोधूमान्ददौ बालकयोस्तदा ॥ 12 ॥
4.54.m: she constantly pounded and ground grain for the sake of filling her belly. / Having taken a small amount of wheat, she gave it then to the two children,

4.54.s:
kāruṇyānmātṛvātsalyātkṣudhāsaṃpīḍyamānayoḥ ..
kālena bahunā sādhvī pañcatvamagamacchubhā ..13..
4.54.d:
कारुण्यान्मातृवात्सल्यात्क्षुधासंपीड्यमानयोः ॥
कालेन बहुना साध्वी पञ्चत्वमगमच्छुभा ॥13॥
4.54.m: out of compassion and maternal affection, as they were tormented by hunger. / After much time, that virtuous, auspicious woman met her death.

4.54.s:
putrastasyā videhāyāṃ gatvā svapiturāsane ..
upaviṣṭaḥ sattvayogādbubhuje gāmanākulaḥ .. 14 ..
4.54.d:
पुत्रस्तस्या विदेहायां गत्वा स्वपितुरासने ॥
उपविष्टः सत्त्वयोगाद्बुभुजे गामनाकुलः ॥ 14 ॥
4.54.m: Her son, having gone to Videhā, sat upon his father's throne / by virtue of his innate strength and enjoyed the earth undisturbed.

4.54.s:
anviṣya dharmarājño vai sā kanyā mithivaṃśajā ..
vivāhitā hitā bhartuḥ sā mahānāyikā'bhavat .. 15 ..
4.54.d:
अन्विष्य धर्मराज्ञो वै सा कन्या मिथिवंशजा ॥
विवाहिता हिता भर्तुः सा महानायिकाऽभवत् ॥ 15 ॥
4.54.m: Having sought her out, that maiden born of Mithi's lineage was indeed married to Dharmarāja; beneficial to her husband, she became his chief queen.

4.54.s:
śyāmalā nāma cārvaṃgī prasiddhā śrūyate śrutau ..
tāmuvāca varārohāṃ dharmarājaḥ svayaṃ priyām .. 16 ..
4.54.d:
श्यामला नाम चार्वंगी प्रसिद्धा श्रूयते श्रुतौ ॥
तामुवाच वरारोहां धर्मराजः स्वयं प्रियाम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.54.m: Known by the name Śyāmalā, lovely of limb, she is celebrated in sacred lore. / Dharmarāja himself spoke to that fair-hipped, beloved woman:

4.54.s:
vahasva sarvavyāpāraṃ śyāmale tvaṃ gṛhe mama ..
kuru svajanabhṛtyānāṃ dānakṣepaṃ yathepsitam .. 17 ..
4.54.d:
वहस्व सर्वव्यापारं श्यामले त्वं गृहे मम ॥
कुरु स्वजनभृत्यानां दानक्षेपं यथेप्सितम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.54.m: "O Śyāmalā, manage all affairs in my household! / Distribute gifts to kinsmen and servants as you desire.

4.54.s:
kiṃ tvete paṃjarāḥ sapta kīlakairatiyaṃtritāḥ ..
kadācidapi noddhāṭyāstvayā vaidehanaṃdini .. 18 ..
4.54.d:
किं त्वेते पंजराः सप्त कीलकैरतियंत्रिताः ॥
कदाचिदपि नोद्धाट्यास्त्वया वैदेहनंदिनि ॥ 18 ॥
4.54.m: However, these seven cages are firmly locked with bolts; / they must never be opened by you, O daughter of Videha!"

4.54.s:
evamastviti sāpyuktā nijaṃ karma cakāra ha ..
kadācidvyākulībhūte dharmarāje videhajā ..
uddhāṭayitvā prathamaṃ dadarśa jananīṃ svakām.. 19..
4.54.d:
एवमस्त्विति साप्युक्ता निजं कर्म चकार ह ॥
कदाचिद्व्याकुलीभूते धर्मराजे विदेहजा ॥
उद्धाटयित्वा प्रथमं ददर्श जननीं स्वकाम्॥ 19॥
4.54.m: Saying 'Let it be so,' she too went about her own tasks. / Once, while Dharmarāja was preoccupied, the daughter of Videha / unlocked the first [cage] and beheld her own mother.

4.54.s:
sā pacyamānā kraṃdaṃtī bhīṣaṇairyamakiṃkaraiḥ ..
helayā kṣipyate baddhvā taptataile punaḥpunaḥ .. 4.54.20 ..
4.54.d:
सा पच्यमाना क्रंदंती भीषणैर्यमकिंकरैः ॥
हेलया क्षिप्यते बद्ध्वा तप्ततैले पुनःपुनः ॥ 4.54.20 ॥
4.54.m: Boiled and weeping aloud, she was bound / and cast sportively into hot oil again and again by terrifying attendants of Yama.

4.54.s:
tathaiva tālakaṃ dattvā vrīḍitā sā manasvinī ..
dvitīye paṃjare tadvatsā tāmevaṃ dadarśa ha .. 21 ..
4.54.d:
तथैव तालकं दत्त्वा व्रीडिता सा मनस्विनी ॥
द्वितीये पंजरे तद्वत्सा तामेवं ददर्श ह ॥ 21 ॥
4.54.m: Securing the lock again in the very same way, that high-minded woman, feeling ashamed, / beheld her in the second cage in like manner.

4.54.s:
sudhāvallipyamānāṃ tāṃ śilātalpeṣṭakena tu ..
tṛtīyapañjare tadvattāṃ dadarśa svamātaram ..
krakacaiḥ pāṭyate mūrdhni ghaṇṭāyuktaiḥ karolbaṇaiḥ .. 22 ..
4.54.d:
सुधावल्लिप्यमानां तां शिलातल्पेष्टकेन तु ॥
तृतीयपञ्जरे तद्वत्तां ददर्श स्वमातरम् ॥
क्रकचैः पाट्यते मूर्ध्नि घण्टायुक्तैः करोल्बणैः ॥ 22 ॥
4.54.m: She saw her smeared with lime on a bed of stones with bricks. / Likewise in the third cage she saw her own mother: / she was being sawn through the head with bell-decked saws in fierce hands.

4.54.s:
caturthe pañjare sthāne bhīṣaṇairdāruṇānanaiḥ ..
bhakṣyamāṇāṃ śvāpadaiśca kraṃdaṃtīṃ tāṃ punaḥ punaḥ... 23 ..
4.54.d:
चतुर्थे पञ्जरे स्थाने भीषणैर्दारुणाननैः ॥
भक्ष्यमाणां श्वापदैश्च क्रंदंतीं तां पुनः पुनः॥। 23 ॥
4.54.m: In the place of the fourth cage, she saw her being eaten / by terrifying wild beasts with ferocious muzzles, crying out again and again.

4.54.s:
pañcame nihitā bhūmau kaṇṭhe pādena pīḍitā ..
saṃdaṃśairvanaghātaiśca vidīrṇā kriyate ruṣā .. 24 ..
4.54.d:
पञ्चमे निहिता भूमौ कण्ठे पादेन पीडिता ॥
संदंशैर्वनघातैश्च विदीर्णा क्रियते रुषा ॥ 24 ॥
4.54.m: In the fifth, she was cast upon the ground, pressed on the throat with a foot, / and torn apart in anger with tongs and blows like heavy hammers.

4.54.s:
ṣaṣṭhe cekṣuyantragatāṃ mastake mudgarāhatām ..
saṃpīḍyamānāmaniśaṃ sudṛḍhāmikṣukhaṃḍavat .. 25 ..
4.54.d:
षष्ठे चेक्षुयन्त्रगतां मस्तके मुद्गराहताम् ॥
संपीड्यमानामनिशं सुदृढामिक्षुखंडवत् ॥ 25 ॥
4.54.m: And in the sixth, placed in a sugarcane press, struck upon the head with a mallet, / she was being constantly crushed, firmly, like a stalk of sugarcane.

4.54.s:
saptame pañjare cīrṇasvanāṃ pūtikagaṃdhinīm ..
dṛṣṭvā tathā gatāṃ tāṃ tu mātaraṃ duḥkhakarṣitā ..
śyāmalā mlānavadanā kiṃcinnovāca bhāminī .. 26 ..
4.54.d:
सप्तमे पञ्जरे चीर्णस्वनां पूतिकगंधिनीम् ॥
दृष्ट्वा तथा गतां तां तु मातरं दुःखकर्षिता ॥
श्यामला म्लानवदना किंचिन्नोवाच भामिनी ॥ 26 ॥
4.54.m: In the seventh cage, seeing her mother emitting a withered cry and smelling of putrefaction, / reduced to such a state, afflicted with grief, / Śyāmalā, the indignant lady with downcast face, said nothing.

4.54.s:
athāgataṃ yamaṃ prāha saroṣā śyāmalā patim ..
kiṃ tavāpahṛtaṃ rājanmama mātrā sudāruṇam ..
yeneyaṃ vividhairghātairvadhyate bahudhā tvayā .. 27 ..
4.54.d:
अथागतं यमं प्राह सरोषा श्यामला पतिम् ॥
किं तवापहृतं राजन्मम मात्रा सुदारुणम् ॥
येनेयं विविधैर्घातैर्वध्यते बहुधा त्वया ॥ 27 ॥
4.54.m: Then, to Yama her husband who had arrived, Śyāmalā said angrily: / "What dread thing was stolen from you, O King, by my mother, / on account of which she is being tortured in many ways with various blows by you?"

4.54.s:
yamaḥ prāha priyāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhadre hyudghāṭitāstvayā ..
ete pañjarakāḥ sapta niṣiddhā tvaṃ mayā purā .. 28 ..
4.54.d:
यमः प्राह प्रियां दृष्ट्वा भद्रे ह्युद्घाटितास्त्वया ॥
एते पञ्जरकाः सप्त निषिद्धा त्वं मया पुरा ॥ 28 ॥
4.54.m: Looking at his beloved, Yama said: "O gentle lady, you have indeed opened / these seven cages, though you were forbidden by me before.

4.54.s:
tava mātrā sutasnehādgodhūmā ye hṛtāḥ kila ..
kiṃ na jānāsi tadbhadre yena ruṣṭā mamopari .. 29 ..
4.54.d:
तव मात्रा सुतस्नेहाद्गोधूमा ये हृताः किल ॥
किं न जानासि तद्भद्रे येन रुष्टा ममोपरि ॥ 29 ॥
4.54.m: The wheat grains that were stolen by your mother out of affection for her child— / do you not know about that, O gentle lady, on account of which you are angry with me?

4.54.s:
brahmasvaṃ praṇayādbhuktaṃ dahatyāsaptamaṃ kulam..
tadeva cauryarūpeṇa dahatyācaṃdratārakam .. 4.54.30 ..
4.54.d:
ब्रह्मस्वं प्रणयाद्भुक्तं दहत्यासप्तमं कुलम्॥
तदेव चौर्यरूपेण दहत्याचंद्रतारकम् ॥ 4.54.30 ॥
4.54.m: A brāhmaṇa's property consumed out of affection burns up to the seventh generation; / that very same [property taken] in the form of theft burns as long as the moon and stars endure.

4.54.s:
godhūmāsta ime bhūtāḥ kṛmirūpāḥ sudāruṇāḥ ..
ye purā brāhmaṇagṛhe hṛtāstava kṛte'nayā ..31..
4.54.d:
गोधूमास्त इमे भूताः कृमिरूपाः सुदारुणाः ॥
ये पुरा ब्राह्मणगृहे हृतास्तव कृतेऽनया ॥31॥
4.54.m: Those wheat grains that were formerly stolen by her in the brāhmaṇa's house for your sake / have turned into these dread worms."

4.54.s:
.. śyāmalovāca .. ..
jānāmi tadahaṃ sarvaṃ yanme mātrā kṛtaṃ purā ..
tathāpi tvāṃ samāsādya sā ca jāmātaraṃ śubham ..
mucyate kṛmirāśitvādyathā tadadhunā kuru .. 32 ..
4.54.d:
॥ श्यामलोवाच ॥ ॥
जानामि तदहं सर्वं यन्मे मात्रा कृतं पुरा ॥
तथापि त्वां समासाद्य सा च जामातरं शुभम् ॥
मुच्यते कृमिराशित्वाद्यथा तदधुना कुरु ॥ 32 ॥
4.54.m: Śyāmalā said: / "I know all that which was done formerly by my mother. / Even so, now that she has gained you as an auspicious son-in-law, / act now so that she may be released from being a heap of worms."

4.54.s:
tacchrutvā cintayāviṣṭaściraṃ sthitvā jagāda tām ..
dharmarājaḥ sahāsīnāṃ priyāṃ prāṇadhaneśvarīm .. 33 ..
4.54.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा चिन्तयाविष्टश्चिरं स्थित्वा जगाद ताम् ॥
धर्मराजः सहासीनां प्रियां प्राणधनेश्वरीम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.54.m: Having heard that, seized with contemplation, Dharmarāja paused for a long time / and then spoke to her, his seated beloved, the mistress of his life and wealth:

4.54.s:
itaśca saptame'tīte janmani brāhmaṇī śubhā ..
āsīstasmiṃstvayā saṃgātsakhīnāṃ paryupāsitā ..
budhāṣṭamī susaṃpūrṇā yathoktaphaladāyinī .. 34 ..
4.54.d:
इतश्च सप्तमेऽतीते जन्मनि ब्राह्मणी शुभा ॥
आसीस्तस्मिंस्त्वया संगात्सखीनां पर्युपासिता ॥
बुधाष्टमी सुसंपूर्णा यथोक्तफलदायिनी ॥ 34 ॥
4.54.m: "Seven births ago from this one, you were a virtuous brāhmaṇa woman; / in that birth, out of company with friends, you observed / the complete Budhāṣṭamī, which bestows the spoken fruits.

4.54.s:
tatphalaṃ yaddadāsyasyai satyaṃ kṛtvā mamāgrataḥ ..
tena mucyeta te mātā narakātpāpasaṃkaṭāt .. 35 ..
tacchrutvā tvaritaṃ snātvā dadau puṇyaṃ svakaṃ kṛtam ..
svamātuḥ śyāmalā tuṣṭā tena mokṣaṃ jagāma sā .. 35 ..
4.54.d:
तत्फलं यद्ददास्यस्यै सत्यं कृत्वा ममाग्रतः ॥
तेन मुच्येत ते माता नरकात्पापसंकटात् ॥ 35 ॥
तच्छ्रुत्वा त्वरितं स्नात्वा ददौ पुण्यं स्वकं कृतम् ॥
स्वमातुः श्यामला तुष्टा तेन मोक्षं जगाम सा ॥ 35 ॥
4.54.m:
If you give that fruit to her, swearing an oath of truth before me, / by that your mother will be freed from hell and from the distress of sin."
Hearing that, having bathed swiftly, Śyāmalā, well-pleased, gave her own accumulated merit / to her mother; by that, she attained liberation.

4.54.s:
ūrmilā rūpasaṃpannā divyadehadharā śubhā ..
vimānavaramārūḍhā divyamālyāṃbarāvṛtā .. 36 ..
4.54.d:
ऊर्मिला रूपसंपन्ना दिव्यदेहधरा शुभा ॥
विमानवरमारूढा दिव्यमाल्यांबरावृता ॥ 36 ॥
4.54.m: Ūrmilā, endowed with beauty, bearing a celestial body, auspicious, / mounted upon a magnificent celestial chariot, adorned with celestial garlands and garments,

4.54.s:
bhartuḥ samīpe svargasthā dṛśyate'dyāpi sā janaiḥ ..
budhasya pārśve nabhasi mithirājasamīpataḥ ..
visphuraṃtī mahārāja budhāṣṭamyāḥ prabhāvataḥ .. 37 ..
4.54.d:
भर्तुः समीपे स्वर्गस्था दृश्यतेऽद्यापि सा जनैः ॥
बुधस्य पार्श्वे नभसि मिथिराजसमीपतः ॥
विस्फुरंती महाराज बुधाष्टम्याः प्रभावतः ॥ 37 ॥
4.54.m: stationed in heaven beside her husband, is seen even today by people / beside Budha in the sky, near the king of Mithi, / shining brightly, O great king, by the power of Budhāṣṭamī.

4.54.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
yadyevaṃ pravarā kṛṣṇa sā tithirvai budhāṣṭamī ..
tasyā eva vidhiṃ brūhi yadi tuṣṭosi me prabho .. 38 ..
4.54.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
यद्येवं प्रवरा कृष्ण सा तिथिर्वै बुधाष्टमी ॥
तस्या एव विधिं ब्रूहि यदि तुष्टोसि मे प्रभो ॥ 38 ॥
4.54.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / If that lunar day, Budhāṣṭamī, is so pre-eminent, O Kṛṣṇa, / declare the ritual for that very observance, if you are pleased with me, O Lord.

4.54.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu pāṃḍava yatnena budhāṣṭamyā vidhiṃ śubham ..
yadāyadā sitāṣṭamyāṃ budhavāro bhavedyadi ..
tadātadā ca sā grāhyā ekabhaktāśanairnṛbhiḥ .. 39 ..
4.54.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु पांडव यत्नेन बुधाष्टम्या विधिं शुभम् ॥
यदायदा सिताष्टम्यां बुधवारो भवेद्यदि ॥
तदातदा च सा ग्राह्या एकभक्ताशनैर्नृभिः ॥ 39 ॥
4.54.m: The Blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Listen attentively, O Pāṇḍava, to the auspicious ritual of Budhāṣṭamī: / Whenever Wednesday should fall on an aṣṭamī of the bright fortnight, / then and then it should be observed by men eating only one meal a day.

4.54.s:
snātvā nadyāṃ tu pūrvāhne gṛhītvā kalaśaṃ navam ..
jalapūrṇaṃ tu sadravyaṃ pūrṇapātrasamanvitam .. 4.54.40 ..
4.54.d:
स्नात्वा नद्यां तु पूर्वाह्ने गृहीत्वा कलशं नवम् ॥
जलपूर्णं तु सद्रव्यं पूर्णपात्रसमन्वितम् ॥ 4.54.40 ॥
4.54.m: Having bathed in a river in the forenoon, taking a new water jar / filled with water, along with valuable articles, and accompanied by a filled bowl,

4.54.s:
aṣṭavārānprakartavyā vidhānaistu pṛthakpṛthak ..
prathamā modakaiḥ kāryā dvitīyā pheṇakaistathā .. 41 ..
4.54.d:
अष्टवारान्प्रकर्तव्या विधानैस्तु पृथक्पृथक् ॥
प्रथमा मोदकैः कार्या द्वितीया फेणकैस्तथा ॥ 41 ॥
4.54.m: it should be performed eight times with distinct rituals: / the first is to be performed with modakas, the second likewise with pheṇakas,

4.54.s:
tṛtīyā ghṛtapūpaiśca caturthī vaṭakairnṛpa ..
pañcamī śubhrakāraiśca ṣaṣṭhī sohālakaistathā ..42..
4.54.d:
तृतीया घृतपूपैश्च चतुर्थी वटकैर्नृप ॥
पञ्चमी शुभ्रकारैश्च षष्ठी सोहालकैस्तथा ॥42॥
4.54.m: the third with cakes fried in clarified butter, and the fourth with vaṭakas, O king; / the fifth with śubhrakāras, and the sixth likewise with sohālakas;

4.54.s:
aśokavartibhiḥ śubhraiḥ saptamī khaṃḍasaṃyutaiḥ..
aṣṭamī phalapuṣpaiśca kevalākhaṇḍapheṇikaiḥ ..
evaṃ krameṇa kartavyā suhṛtsvajanabāṃdhavaiḥ ..43..
4.54.d:
अशोकवर्तिभिः शुभ्रैः सप्तमी खंडसंयुतैः॥
अष्टमी फलपुष्पैश्च केवलाखण्डफेणिकैः ॥
एवं क्रमेण कर्तव्या सुहृत्स्वजनबांधवैः ॥43॥
4.54.m: the seventh with white aśokavartis accompanied by sugar candies; / the eighth with fruits and flowers, and whole, unbroken pheṇikas alone. / In this manner, in proper order, it should be performed by friends, relatives, and kinsmen.

4.54.s:
saha kṛtvā sthitairbhojyaṃ bhoktavyaṃ svasthamānasaiḥ ..
upoṣyāṇāmidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kathayadbhiḥ śanaiḥśanaiḥ ..44..
4.54.d:
सह कृत्वा स्थितैर्भोज्यं भोक्तव्यं स्वस्थमानसैः ॥
उपोष्याणामिदं श्रेष्ठं कथयद्भिः शनैःशनैः ॥44॥
4.54.m: Assembling together, they should partake of the food with tranquil minds, / this being the best of fasts, while recounting [the sacred story] quietly.

4.54.s:
śrutvāṣṭamī budhasyāpi māhātmyaṃ bhojanaṃ tyajet ..
tāvadeva na bhoktavyaṃ kathā yāvatsamāpyate .. 45 ..
4.54.d:
श्रुत्वाष्टमी बुधस्यापि माहात्म्यं भोजनं त्यजेत् ॥
तावदेव न भोक्तव्यं कथा यावत्समाप्यते ॥ 45 ॥
4.54.m: Having heard the greatness of the aṣṭamī and of Budha, one should forgo eating; / one must not eat for as long as the story has not concluded.

4.54.s:
tathā bhuktvā budhasyāgre ācamya ca punaḥpunaḥ ..
viprāya vedaviduṣe taṃ bruvanpratipādayet .. 46 ..
4.54.d:
तथा भुक्त्वा बुधस्याग्रे आचम्य च पुनःपुनः ॥
विप्राय वेदविदुषे तं ब्रुवन्प्रतिपादयेत् ॥ 46 ॥
4.54.m: After eating in that manner, having sipped water repeatedly in front of Budha, / uttering that [formula], one should present [the gift] to a brāhmaṇa learned in the Vedas:

4.54.s:
sākṣataṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca jātarūpamayaṃ śubham ..
arcitaṃ vividhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpadīpaiḥ sugaṃdhibhiḥ ..47 ..
4.54.d:
साक्षतं सहिरण्यं च जातरूपमयं शुभम् ॥
अर्चितं विविधैः पुष्पैर्धूपदीपैः सुगंधिभिः ॥47 ॥
4.54.m: an auspicious [image] made of gold, with unbroken grains of rice and with gold, / worshipped with various flowers, and fragrant incenses and lamps,

4.54.s:
pītavastraiḥ samācchannaṃ budhaṃ somātmajākṛtim ..
māṣakeṇa suvarṇena tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ ..48..
4.54.d:
पीतवस्त्रैः समाच्छन्नं बुधं सोमात्मजाकृतिम् ॥
माषकेण सुवर्णेन तदर्धार्धेन वा पुनः ॥48॥
4.54.m: covered with yellow garments, [an image of] Budha having the form of Soma's son, / weighing a māṣaka of gold, or half of that, or a quarter of that.

4.54.s:
oṃ budhāya namaḥ ..
oṃ somātmajāya namaḥ ..
oṃ durbuddhināśanāya namaḥ ..
oṃ subuddhipradāya namaḥ ..
oṃ tārājātāya namaḥ ..
oṃ saumyagrahāya namaḥ ..
oṃ sarvasaukhyapradāya namaḥ .. ete pūjāmantrāḥ ..
aṣṭamī tu yadā pūrṇā tadā rājarṣisattama ..
brāhmaṇānbhojayedaṣṭau gāṃ dadyācca savatsikām ..49..
4.54.d:
ओं बुधाय नमः ॥
ओं सोमात्मजाय नमः ॥
ओं दुर्बुद्धिनाशनाय नमः ॥
ओं सुबुद्धिप्रदाय नमः ॥
ओं ताराजाताय नमः ॥
ओं सौम्यग्रहाय नमः ॥
ओं सर्वसौख्यप्रदाय नमः ॥ एते पूजामन्त्राः ॥
अष्टमी तु यदा पूर्णा तदा राजर्षिसत्तम ॥
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेदष्टौ गां दद्याच्च सवत्सिकाम् ॥49॥
4.54.m: "Om, reverence to Budha; / Om, reverence to the son of Soma; / Om, reverence to the destroyer of ill intellect; / Om, reverence to the bestower of good intellect; / Om, reverence to the son of Tārā; / Om, reverence to the gentle planet; / Om, reverence to the bestower of all happiness"—these are the mantras of worship. / When the aṣṭamī is completed, O best of royal sages, / one should feed eight brāhmaṇas and gift a cow along with her calf.

4.54.s:
vastrālaṃkaraṇaiḥ sarvairbhūṣaṇairvividhairapi ..
sapatnīkaṃ samabhyarcya karṇamātrāṃgulīyakaiḥ ..
mantreṇānena kauṃteya dadyādevaṃ samācaran .. 4.54.50 ..
4.54.d:
वस्त्रालंकरणैः सर्वैर्भूषणैर्विविधैरपि ॥
सपत्नीकं समभ्यर्च्य कर्णमात्रांगुलीयकैः ॥
मन्त्रेणानेन कौंतेय दद्यादेवं समाचरन् ॥ 4.54.50 ॥
4.54.m: Having thoroughly worshipped him together with his wife with all clothes and ornaments, with various jewels, and with ear-ornaments and finger-rings, / one should give [the gift] with this mantra, performing it thus, O son of Kuntī:

4.54.s:
budho'yaṃ pratigṛhṇātu dravyastho'yaṃ budhaḥ svayam ..
dīyate budharājāya tuṣyatāṃ ca budho mama .. 51 .. .. (iti dānamaṃtra .) .. ..
4.54.d:
बुधोऽयं प्रतिगृह्णातु द्रव्यस्थोऽयं बुधः स्वयम् ॥
दीयते बुधराजाय तुष्यतां च बुधो मम ॥ 51 ॥ ॥ (इति दानमंत्र ।) ॥ ॥
4.54.m: “May this Budha accept; this Budha himself abides in the wealth. / It is given to the king Budha, and may Budha be pleased with me.” (Thus the mantra of donation.)

4.54.s:
budhaḥ saumyastārakeyo rājaputra ilāpatiḥ ..
kumāro dvijarājasya yaḥ purūravasaḥ pitā .. 52 .. .. ( iti pratigrahaṇamaṃtraḥ .) ..
4.54.d:
बुधः सौम्यस्तारकेयो राजपुत्र इलापतिः ॥
कुमारो द्विजराजस्य यः पुरूरवसः पिता ॥ 52 ॥ ॥ ( इति प्रतिग्रहणमंत्रः ।) ॥
4.54.m: “Budha, gentle, son of Tārā, prince, lord of Ilā, / youth [begotten] by the king of the twice-born, who is the father of Purūravas.” (Thus the mantra of acceptance.)

4.54.s:
durbuddhibādhajanitaṃ nāśayitvā ca me budhaḥ ..
saukhyaṃ ca saumanasyaṃ ca karotu śaśinaṃdanaḥ .. 53 ..
4.54.d:
दुर्बुद्धिबाधजनितं नाशयित्वा च मे बुधः ॥
सौख्यं च सौमनस्यं च करोतु शशिनंदनः ॥ 53 ॥
4.54.m: “Having destroyed [the distress] born from the affliction of wicked intellect, / may Budha, the son of the Moon, grant me happiness and contentment of mind.”

4.54.s:
ityuccārya gṛhītvā tu dadyānmaṃtrapuraḥsaram ..
saptajanmani rājendra jāto jātismaro bhavet ..54..
4.54.d:
इत्युच्चार्य गृहीत्वा तु दद्यान्मंत्रपुरःसरम् ॥
सप्तजन्मनि राजेन्द्र जातो जातिस्मरो भवेत् ॥54॥
4.54.m: Having uttered this and taken [the gift], he should bestow it preceded by the mantra. / Born in seven births, O king of kings, he becomes one who remembers past lives,

4.54.s:
dhanadhānyasamāyuktaḥ. putrapautrapravarddhanaḥ ..
dīrṣāyurvipulānbhogānbhuktvā caiva mahītalaṃ .. 55 ..
4.54.d:
धनधान्यसमायुक्तः। पुत्रपौत्रप्रवर्द्धनः ॥
दीर्षायुर्विपुलान्भोगान्भुक्त्वा चैव महीतलं ॥ 55 ॥
4.54.m: Endowed with wealth and grain, increasing sons and grandsons, / long-lived, and having enjoyed vast pleasures and indeed the surface of the earth,

4.54.s:
tataḥ sutīrthe maraṇaṃ dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ vibhum ..
mṛto'sau svargamāpnoti purandarasamo naraḥ .. 56 ..
4.54.d:
ततः सुतीर्थे मरणं ध्यात्वा नारायणं विभुम् ॥
मृतोऽसौ स्वर्गमाप्नोति पुरन्दरसमो नरः ॥ 56 ॥
4.54.m: Thereafter, dying at an auspicious sacred ford, having meditated on the all-pervading Nārāyaṇa, / he, having died, reaches heaven, a man equal to Purandara.

4.54.s:
vasate yāvadāsṛṣṭeḥ punarābhūtasaṃplavam ..
evametanmayā khyātaṃ vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam .. 57 ..
4.54.d:
वसते यावदासृष्टेः पुनराभूतसंप्लवम् ॥
एवमेतन्मया ख्यातं व्रतानामुत्तमं व्रतम् ॥ 57 ॥
4.54.m: He dwells [there] for as long as creation lasts until the universal dissolution. / Thus has been proclaimed by me the supreme votive observance among votive observances.

4.54.s:
eṣaivaṃ ca mayākhyātā guhyā pārtha budhāṣṭamī ..
yāṃ śrutvā brahmahā goghnaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 58 ..
4.54.d:
एषैवं च मयाख्याता गुह्या पार्थ बुधाष्टमी ॥
यां श्रुत्वा ब्रह्महा गोघ्नः सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥ 58 ॥
4.54.m: This secret Budhāṣṭamī has thus been proclaimed by me, O Pārtha, / hearing which the killer of a Brahmin or the killer of a cow is freed from all sins.

4.54.s:
yaścāṣṭamīṃ budhayutāṃ samavāpya bhaktyā sampūjayedvidhusutaṃ kanapṛṣṭhasaṃ stham ..
pakvānnapātrasahitaiḥ sahiṇyavastraiḥ paśyedasau yamapuraṃ na kadācideva .. 59 ..
janmāṣṭamīvarṇanam
4.54.d:
यश्चाष्टमीं बुधयुतां समवाप्य भक्त्या सम्पूजयेद्विधुसुतं कनपृष्ठसं स्थम् ॥
पक्वान्नपात्रसहितैः सहिण्यवस्त्रैः पश्येदसौ यमपुरं न कदाचिदेव ॥ 59 ॥
जन्माष्टमीवर्णनम्
4.54.m:
And he who, having obtained the aṣṭamī conjoined with Budha, worships with devotion the son of the Moon seated on the back of an elephant, / with vessels of cooked food, together with gold and garments, shall never see the city of Yama.
Description of Janmāṣṭamī

4.55.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
janmāṣṭamīvrataṃ brūhi vistareṇa mamācyuta ..
kasminkāle samutpannaṃ kiṃ puṇyaṃ ko vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ .. 1 ..
4.55.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
जन्माष्टमीव्रतं ब्रूहि विस्तरेण ममाच्युत ॥
कस्मिन्काले समुत्पन्नं किं पुण्यं को विधिः स्मृतः ॥ 1 ॥
4.55.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Tell me in detail, O Acyuta, the Janmāṣṭamī votive observance: / at what time did it arise, what is the merit, and what is the prescribed procedure?

4.55.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
hate kaṃsāsure duṣṭe mathurāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ..
devakī māṃ pariṣvajya kṛtvotsaṃge ruroda ha .. 2 ..
4.55.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
हते कंसासुरे दुष्टे मथुरायां युधिष्ठिर ॥
