अब्दपञ्चकमेकं वा एवं यः कुरुते नरः ॥
उभाभ्यां लोकमासाद्य पदं यास्यत्यनामयम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.59.m: A man who performs this for five years, or even for one year, / having reached the world of both, shall go to the disease-free abode.

4.59.s:
ā dehapatanādyastu nityametatsamācaret ..
ihaiva sa hariḥ sākṣānnararūpo vibhāvyate .. 14 ..
4.59.d:
आ देहपतनाद्यस्तु नित्यमेतत्समाचरेत् ॥
इहैव स हरिः साक्षान्नररूपो विभाव्यते ॥ 14 ॥
4.59.m: And he who should constantly practice this until the fall of his body, / is regarded in this very world as Hari manifest in human form.

4.59.s:
na spṛśaṃtyāpadastasya na duḥkhī bhavati kvacit ..
jvaragrahādibhirnaiva pīḍyate'sau kadācana .. 15 ..
4.59.d:
न स्पृशंत्यापदस्तस्य न दुःखी भवति क्वचित् ॥
ज्वरग्रहादिभिर्नैव पीड्यतेऽसौ कदाचन ॥ 15 ॥
4.59.m: Calamities do not touch him; he never becomes miserable; / he is never afflicted by fevers, planetary afflictions, and the like.

4.59.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
atha vā tena mārgeṇa tāmavehi sitāṣṭamīm ..
saṃprāpyādityayogena prāgvidhānena cābhyaset .. 16 ..
4.59.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अथ वा तेन मार्गेण तामवेहि सिताष्टमीम् ॥
संप्राप्यादित्ययोगेन प्राग्विधानेन चाभ्यसेत् ॥ 16 ॥
4.59.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Or know that same bright aṣṭamī in that manner: / when it coincides with Sunday, one should practice it according to the previous rule.

4.59.s:
kiṃtu dakṣiṇataṃtrasthaṃ bhāskaraṃ vārcayedbudhaḥ ..
padmarāgeṇa divyena suvarṇena ca pārvatīm .. 17 ..
4.59.d:
किंतु दक्षिणतंत्रस्थं भास्करं वार्चयेद्बुधः ॥
पद्मरागेण दिव्येन सुवर्णेन च पार्वतीम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.59.m: However, the wise man should worship the Sun residing in the southern tantra, / [worshipping him] with a divine ruby, and Pārvatī with gold.

4.59.s:
kuṃkumena samālabhya candanena śivaṃ tathā ..
abhāve sarvaratnānāṃ hema sarvatra yojayet .. 18 ..
4.59.d:
कुंकुमेन समालभ्य चन्दनेन शिवं तथा ॥
अभावे सर्वरत्नानां हेम सर्वत्र योजयेत् ॥ 18 ॥
4.59.m: Having anointed Śiva with saffron and likewise with sandalwood; / in the absence of all gems, he should use gold everywhere.

4.59.s:
rudrabījaṃ paraṃ pūtaṃ priyaṃ rudrasya sarvadā ..
raktamālyāṃbaradharaṃ naivedyaṃ ghṛtapācitam .. 19 ..
4.59.d:
रुद्रबीजं परं पूतं प्रियं रुद्रस्य सर्वदा ॥
रक्तमाल्यांबरधरं नैवेद्यं घृतपाचितम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.59.m: The seed of Rudra is supremely pure, always dear to Rudra; / [the deity] wears a red garland and garment, and the food offering is cooked in clarified butter.

4.59.s:
śeṣaḥ pūrvavidhānena kartavyo vidhivistaraḥ ..
tithau pūrṇe ca kurvīta gavyenānagha pāraṇam .. .. 4.59.20 ..
4.59.d:
शेषः पूर्वविधानेन कर्तव्यो विधिविस्तरः ॥
तिथौ पूर्णे च कुर्वीत गव्येनानघ पारणम् ॥ ॥ 4.59.20 ॥
4.59.m: The rest of the ritual details are to be performed according to the previous injunction. / And when the lunar day is fulfilled, O sinless one, he should break the fast with cow-products.

4.59.s:
etatprākca vidhāyābdaṃ pañcābdānevameva ca ..
kṛtvā sūryādilokeṣu bhuktvā bhogānvrajetparam .. 21 ..
4.59.d:
एतत्प्राक्च विधायाब्दं पञ्चाब्दानेवमेव च ॥
कृत्वा सूर्यादिलोकेषु भुक्त्वा भोगान्व्रजेत्परम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.59.m: Having performed this previously for one year, and likewise for five years, / having enjoyed pleasures in the worlds of the Sun and others, he reaches the supreme.

4.59.s:
pataṃgavatpratāpī syādadīnaśca jana priyaḥ ..
asminrogo na bādheta dhanavānputravānbhavet .. 22 ..
4.59.d:
पतंगवत्प्रतापी स्याददीनश्च जन प्रियः ॥
अस्मिन्रोगो न बाधेत धनवान्पुत्रवान्भवेत् ॥ 22 ॥
4.59.m: He becomes majestic like the sun, noble, and beloved of the people; / disease does not torment him in this world; he becomes wealthy and possesses sons.

4.59.s:
yadyaṣṭamī bhavati somayutā kadācidarkeṇa vā kurukulodvaha tāmupoṣya ..
pūjyo mayā saha haraṃ hariṇāṃkacihnaṃ bhaktyāyuṣāṃ padamupaiti padaṃ purāreḥ .. 23 .. ..
śrīvṛkṣanavamīvratavarṇanam
4.59.d:
यद्यष्टमी भवति सोमयुता कदाचिदर्केण वा कुरुकुलोद्वह तामुपोष्य ॥
पूज्यो मया सह हरं हरिणांकचिह्नं भक्त्यायुषां पदमुपैति पदं पुरारेः ॥ 23 ॥ ॥
श्रीवृक्षनवमीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.59.m:
If the aṣṭamī falls on a Monday, or at any time with the Sun, O uplifter of the Kuru race, having fasted on it, / Hara, who bears the emblem of the hare-marked [moon], is to be worshipped together with me; through devotion he attains the realm of the long-lived, the realm of the enemy of Pura.
Description of the Śrīvṛkṣanavamī Votive Observance

4.60.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
samutpanneṣu ratneṣu kṣīrodamathane purā ..
daityānāṃ mohanārthāya yoṣidbhūte janārdane .. 1 ..
4.60.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
समुत्पन्नेषु रत्नेषु क्षीरोदमथने पुरा ॥
दैत्यानां मोहनार्थाय योषिद्भूते जनार्दने ॥ 1 ॥
4.60.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / In ancient times, when the jewels arose during the churning of the Ocean of Milk, / and Janārdana assumed the form of a woman to delude the Daityas,

4.60.s:
bilve vṛkṣe kṣaṇaṃ śrāṃtā viśrāṃtā kamalālayā ..
yāmevamiti vānyonyaṃ yuyudhurdevadānavāḥ .. 2 ..
4.60.d:
बिल्वे वृक्षे क्षणं श्रांता विश्रांता कमलालया ॥
यामेवमिति वान्योन्यं युयुधुर्देवदानवाः ॥ 2 ॥
4.60.m: she whose abode is the lotus, weary, rested for a moment on a bilva tree. / Saying 'She is mine! [She is mine!]', the gods and the Dānavas fought one another.

4.60.s:
jitāḥ sarve purā pārtha yuddhe kṛṣṇena cakriṇā ..
pātālaṃ gamitā daityāḥ saśrīkaḥ svayamāyayau .. 3 ..
4.60.d:
जिताः सर्वे पुरा पार्थ युद्धे कृष्णेन चक्रिणा ॥
पातालं गमिता दैत्याः सश्रीकः स्वयमाययौ ॥ 3 ॥
4.60.m: All were conquered in ancient times, O son of Pṛthā, in battle by Kṛṣṇa the discus-wielder; / the Daityas were driven to the netherworld, and he himself returned accompanied by Śrī.

4.60.s:
śrīḥ samāvāsitā yasmācchrīvṛkṣastu tataḥ smṛtaḥ ..
tasmādbhādrapadasyaiva śuklapakṣe kurūttama .. 4 ..
4.60.d:
श्रीः समावासिता यस्माच्छ्रीवृक्षस्तु ततः स्मृतः ॥
तस्माद्भाद्रपदस्यैव शुक्लपक्षे कुरूत्तम ॥ 4 ॥
4.60.m: Because Śrī made her dwelling there, it is known as the 'Śrīvṛkṣa'. / Therefore, in the bright fortnight of Bhādrapada, O best of Kurus,

4.60.s:
navamyāmarcayedbhaktyā īṣatsūryodaye nagam ..
śrīvṛkṣaṃ vividhaiḥ puṣpairanagnipācitaiḥ phalaiḥ .. 5 ..
4.60.d:
नवम्यामर्चयेद्भक्त्या ईषत्सूर्योदये नगम् ॥
श्रीवृक्षं विविधैः पुष्पैरनग्निपाचितैः फलैः ॥ 5 ॥
4.60.m: on the navamī, at the slight rising of the sun, one should worship the tree with devotion, / the Śrīvṛkṣa, with various flowers and fruits not cooked over fire,
with sesame flour, cooked food, wheat, incense, fragrant pastes, garlands, and garments, / when the expanse of the sky has been slightly reddened by the red rays of the sun.

4.60.s:
maṃtreṇānena rājendra kṛtvā brāhmaṇabhojanam ..
tato bhuñjīta maunena tailakṣāravivarjitaḥ ..
anagnipākaṃ bhūpātre dadhipuṣpaphalaiḥ śubham .. 7 ..
4.60.d:
मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र कृत्वा ब्राह्मणभोजनम् ॥
ततो भुञ्जीत मौनेन तैलक्षारविवर्जितः ॥
अनग्निपाकं भूपात्रे दधिपुष्पफलैः शुभम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.60.m: With this mantra, O king of kings, having fed brāhmaṇas, / he should then eat in silence, avoiding oil and alkaline food, / [eating] auspicious food not cooked over fire from an earthen vessel, with curd, flowers, and fruits.

4.60.s:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha śrīvṛkṣasyārcanaṃ naraḥ ..
nārī vā duḥkhaśokābhyāṃ mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 8 ..
4.60.d:
एवं यः कुरुते पार्थ श्रीवृक्षस्यार्चनं नरः ॥
नारी वा दुःखशोकाभ्यां मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ॥ 8 ॥
4.60.m: A man who thus performs the worship of the Śrīvṛkṣa, O son of Pṛthā, / or a woman, is freed from misery and sorrow; of this there is no doubt.

4.60.s:
saptajanmāṃtaraṃ yāvatsukhasaubhāgyasaṃyutā ..
śrīmatī phalinī dhanyā martyaloke mahīyate... 9 ..
4.60.d:
सप्तजन्मांतरं यावत्सुखसौभाग्यसंयुता ॥
श्रीमती फलिनी धन्या मर्त्यलोके महीयते॥। 9 ॥
4.60.m: For seven successive births she is endowed with happiness and good fortune; / prosperous, fruitful, and blessed, she is honored in the mortal world.

4.60.s:
śrīvṛkṣamakṣataphalaṃ vasitaṃ navamyāṃ naivedyapuṣpaphalavastravicitradhānyaiḥ ..
pūjyaḥ prabhātasamaye puruṣottameṣṭaḥ saṃprāpnuvaṃti puruṣāḥ puruṣendravandyām .. 4.60.10 .. ..
dhvajanavamīvratavarṇanam
4.60.d:
श्रीवृक्षमक्षतफलं वसितं नवम्यां नैवेद्यपुष्पफलवस्त्रविचित्रधान्यैः ॥
पूज्यः प्रभातसमये पुरुषोत्तमेष्टः संप्राप्नुवंति पुरुषाः पुरुषेन्द्रवन्द्याम् ॥ 4.60.10 ॥ ॥
ध्वजनवमीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.60.m:
Having on the navamī draped the bilva tree, which bears uninjured fruit, with offerings of food, flowers, fruits, garments, and various grains, / and having worshipped [it] at the time of dawn, men beloved of the Supreme Spirit attain [fortune] praised by the lord of men.
Description of the Dhvajanavamī Vrata.
